title: Site Reliability Engineer- Kenya
description:
Location - Nairobi, Kenya
Experience - 1 to 3 years
Type - Full Time Consultant
Department - Engineering



About Us

Qure.ai is a global health tech company using artificial intelligence to improve disease detection and patient outcomes at scale. Our solutions are deployed across hospitals, diagnostic networks, and public health programs worldwide.

Today, our technology has impacted 40M+ lives across 105+ countries, deployed across 5,200+ sites, and powered by one of the world’s largest real-world medical imaging datasets. With 26 FDA-cleared indications, we are helping shape the future of AI-driven healthcare.



The Opportunity

Qure.ai is seeking a talented and experienced Site Reliability Engineer to join our team. As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our software systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build and maintain a highly available and efficient infrastructure that supports our artificial intelligence-based healthcare solutions. This role is based in Kenya and requires frequent travel within Kenya and across African countries based on business requirements. Additionally, you will regularly engage with client teams on-site, necessitating strong communication and soft skills.



What You’ll Own & Drive
  • Deploy and distribute Qure.ai's AI and computer vision software across customer environments, supporting both Linux and Windows platforms following established deployment procedures.
  • Manage and maintain on-premise server infrastructure at hospital and clinic sites — covering provisioning, OS patching, configuration hardening, and capacity planning for GPU and compute-intensive AI workloads.
  • Work directly with customers to diagnose and resolve recurring issues in production deployments and updates, applying structured debugging across OS, network, and application layers.
  • Support the implementation and upkeep of highly reliable services using infrastructure-as-code tooling (Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent) to enable consistent and swift product delivery across customer sites.
  • Monitor and analyse system performance across cloud and on-premise environments, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to optimise throughput and ensure high availability.
  • Maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging systems (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or equivalent) to detect and respond to issues proactively, covering both cloud and on-premise deployments.
  • Participate in incident response and post-mortem processes — supporting root cause analysis and implementing fixes to prevent recurrence.
  • Collaborate with security teams to maintain infrastructure hardening standards, manage access controls, and ensure compliance with healthcare data protection requirements.
  • Translate technical findings into clear communication for non-technical hospital stakeholders, requiring strong interpersonal and written skills.
  • Work within a culture that champions deep technical ownership, operating closely alongside Dev, Product, and Customer Success teams to ensure reliability is a shared responsibility across the organisation.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required to support customer deployments and on-site engagements.



Our Values

  • Humble: Curious, open to feedback, and focused on team success over individual credit.
  • Hungry: High ownership, relentless drive, and a constant push for better outcomes.
  • Smart: Structured thinking with empathy, solving complex problems with clarity and strong collaboration.

description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

Job Description:

The Impact You'll Make in this Role

As an Advanced Packaging Engineer – VAVE within the Packaging Engineering team based in Bengaluru, India, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with global cross-functional teams to develop innovative, cost-effective, and sustainable packaging solutions that enhance operational efficiency across the end-to-end supply chain.

Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Leading Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) initiatives to identify and implement packaging cost optimization opportunities across manufacturing, logistics, suppliers, and distribution networks.
  • Driving packaging optimization projects focused on unitization, pallet utilization, warehouse cube efficiency, and transportation optimization to improve overall supply chain performance.
  • Collaborating with Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Quality, R&D, Marketing, and external suppliers to deliver packaging improvements that reduce total cost while maintaining product quality and customer satisfaction.
  • Designing, developing, and validating innovative packaging solutions by optimizing materials, structural designs, and packaging specifications to improve performance, manufacturability, and sustainability.
  • Leading investigations into packaging quality issues, transportation damage, and customer complaints by conducting root cause analysis and implementing robust corrective and preventive actions.
  • Identifying and evaluating new packaging materials, technologies, and sustainable alternatives that support environmental goals while meeting business and regulatory requirements.
  • Planning and executing packaging validation activities, including transportation and distribution testing, ensuring compliance with ISTA and internal packaging standards.
  • Managing multiple engineering projects simultaneously while delivering results on schedule and within budget.

Your Skills and Expertise

title: Sr. Network Security Engineer
description:
Roles & Responsibilities :

We are seeking a Senior IT/OT Network Engineer with a world-class foundation in Core Networking (Layer 2/3) and Secure Site-to-Site Connectivity who would be working on customer products/projects

SKILLS Needed:

Networking (L2/L3): Switching, STP, VLANs, BGP, OSPF, VRF, routing protocols

Firewall & Security: Cisco ASA / FTD / FMC, DMZ, Context design, segmentation

Zero Trust: ZPA / ZIA / Cisco ZTA, MFA, privileged access

Cloud — AWS (Mandatory): VPC, EC2, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, virtual firewall

Standards (Awareness): IEC 62443, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, Purdue Model

Certifications (Preferred): CCNP / CCIE, AWS Advanced Networking, CISSP

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

• Layer 2 / Layer 3 Networking — VLANs, STP, BGP, OSPF, VRF — must have designed in real environments, hands-on configuration experience on Cisco devices (Switches/Routers/Firewalls)

• Firewall Architecture — Hands-on Cisco ASA / FTD / FMC, DMZ, Context and segmentation design

• Zero Trust — Replaced VPN with ZTA, experience with Zscaler or Cisco ZTA

• AWS Cloud Networking — VPC, EC2, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Security Groups, virtual firewall on EC2 — mandatory, not optional

• Standards Awareness — Knows IEC 62443, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, Purdue Model at a conceptual level — does not need deep implementation experience

CLOUD NETWORKING DETAIL

Candidate must have hands-on AWS experience. Azure or GCP knowledge is a bonus but AWS is required.

• VPC & Subnets — Design public/private subnets, route tables, internet gateway, NAT gateway

• EC2 — Launch and configure instances, assign ENIs, Elastic IPs, IAM roles, Auto Scaling

• Virtual Firewall on EC2 — Deploy Cisco FTDv, Palo Alto VM-Series, or FortiGate as EC2 instances

• Virtual Router on EC2 — Deploy software routers (Cisco CSR 1000V / VyOS), BGP peering in AWS

• Connectivity — Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, Transit Gateway for hybrid and multi-site

• Security — Security Groups, NACLs, AWS Network Firewall, VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail

STANDARDS — AWARENESS LEVEL IS ENOUGH

Candidate should be able to discuss these standards in an interview — not implement them from scratch.

IEC 62443: Industrial cybersecurity standard — security zones, conduits, and security levels

NIST CSF: Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover — risk-based security framework

ISO / IEC 27001: Information security management system (ISMS) — how security is governed

Purdue Model: Layered industrial network model — why OT/IT segmentation is designed in levels

NERC CIP: Power grid cybersecurity compliance — awareness is fine for energy sector projects

EXPERIENCE EXPECTATIONS - Mandatory

• Experience — 8 to 10 years in network engineering

• Ownership — Has owned design and implementation decisions — not just followed instructions

• Leadership — Can review team designs, mentor engineers, and drive technical direction along with hands-on demonstration of core skills mentioned above

• Communication — Comfortable speaking to executives, customers, and compliance teams

• Certifications: CCNP

WHAT TO LOOK FOR IN A RESUME

• Job Titles — Sr. Network Security Engineer

• Cloud Projects — VPC designs, hybrid connectivity, virtual firewall/router deployments on EC2

• Certifications (Good-to-have) — CCIE, AWS Certified Advanced Networking, AWS Solutions Architect, CISSP

GOOD TO HAVE — NOT MANDATORY

• Any OT / SCADA exposure — even at project or client level

• Azure or GCP networking — as an addition to AWS

• Infrastructure as Code — Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible for network automation

QUALIFICATIONS

BTech / BCA / MCA

Experience: 8 yrs - 10 yrs

title: Päätoiminen tuntiopettaja, äidinkieli ja kirjallisuus, suomi toisena kielenä, Veromäen koulu
description:
Vantaan kaupunki, Kasvatus ja oppiminen, Perusopetus
Veromäen koulu

Veromiehentie 2, 01510 Vantaa

Työsuhteen kesto: Määräaikainen 17.08.2026 - 31.07.2027

Hei sinä työstäsi innostunut äidinkielen (suomi) opettaja! Tervetuloa loistoporukkaamme työskentelemään yhteisten oppilaittemme hyväksi! Haemme Veromäen kouluun opettajaa opettamaan suomea toisena kielenä sekä suomea äidinkielenä.

Työpaikan kuvaus:

Veromäen koulu on 1-9 vuosiluokkien yhtenäiskoulu. Koulussamme on n. 870 oppilasta ja sata henkilökunnan jäsentä. Koulumme sijaitsee hyvien liikenneyhteyksien äärellä Aviapoliksen suuralueella Pakkalassa kauppakeskus Jumbon ja lentokentän läheisyydessä.

Työyhteisömme on positiivinen, toisiaan tukeva ja ilmapiirimme on innostunut. Henkilökunnallamme on sosiaalista pääomaa, joka näkyy mm. hyvänä yhteishenkenä. Opettajien yhteissuunnittelu ja tiimityöskentely ovat toimintamme kulmakiviä. Toteutamme yhdessä yhteisopettajuuden erilaisia muotoja. Yhdessä luomamme oppimiskulttuuri toimii toimintamme punaisena lankana, jossa opettelemme itseohjaututuutta kehittäviä työtapoja. Opetusjärjestelymme perustuvat joustavuuteen huomioiden oppilaiden erilaiset oppimisen tarpeet.

Tutustu [Veromäen](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/palveluhakemisto/toimipiste/veromaen-koulu) koulun toimintaan.

Tehtävän kuvaus:

Etsimme kouluumme päätoimista tuntiopettajaa opettamaan sekä suomea toisena kielenä että suomea äidinkielenä oppimääriä.

Työskentelet neljän vastaavan aineyhdistelmän opettajan ainetiimissä suunnitellen ja toteuttaen opetustyötäsi.

Yläluokilla suomen kielen tunnit ovat aina palkissa, jolloin yhteisopettajuuden eri muodot ovat toteutettavissa. Opetustunteja on 18, joista 6h on s1-opetusta ja 12h s2-opetusta yläkoululaisille.

Etsimme opettajaa, jolla on oppilaita yksilöinä huomioivia työskentelytapoja, näkemystä yhteisopettajuudesta, hyvät yhteistyötaidot ja kehittävä työote.

Jos kiinnostuit, katso vielä esittelyvideomme ja -materiaalimme ja laita hakemusta tulemaan.

Miksi valita Vantaa?

Vantaa on maamme neljänneksi suurin kaupunki, jossa on rohkeutta tehdä asioita uudella tavalla ja taitoa toimia yhteistyössä erilaisissa verkostoissa. Kaupunki on turvallinen työnantaja, joka tarjoaa henkilöstölle laajat mahdollisuudet osaamisen kehittämiseen. Nykyaikaisissa oppilaitoksissamme arvostetaan laadukkaan kasvatuksen ja opetuksen lisäksi kansainvälisyyttä, monikulttuurisuutta ja yhteisöllisyyttä.

title: Field Service Engineer - Netherlands
description:
Are you an experienced Field Service Engineer who enjoys working independently or as part of a small team, investigating technical problems in depth and working with innovative installations?

Then this could be the right next step for you.

At Bright Renewables, you will not work on the same machine at the same location every day. You will visit different customer sites throughout the Netherlands and work on installations related to biogas, gas upgrading, CO₂ liquefaction and carbon capture.

This is an independent technical position offering plenty of freedom, responsibility and variety. It is ideally suited to someone who feels at home in field service and enjoys being on the road.

The role

Bright Renewables supplies technologies for renewable gas and CO₂ capture. We provide worldwide solutions covering the complete lifecycle of an installation, from production and installation to service and maintenance.

Bright Renewables is part of HoSt Group, a Dutch family-owned company operating worldwide in renewable energy technology.

For our Service & Maintenance department, we are looking for an experienced Field Service Engineer who will help keep our customer installations safe, reliable and operating at their best.

Following a thorough onboarding and training period, you will mainly work at customer sites throughout the Netherlands. Occasionally, you may visit locations elsewhere in the Benelux, and in some cases an assignment may take you further abroad.

The role offers a high level of freedom and independence. Once fully trained, you will organise and plan much of your work independently from home and travel to customers in your own fully equipped service van.

What makes this role interesting?

You will work with modern and newly developed installations involving biogas upgrading, CO₂ liquefaction and carbon capture.

This gives you the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems while working with innovative technologies that contribute directly to the energy transition.

What will you do?

As a Field Service Engineer, you will play an important role in maintaining the reliability and performance of our installations.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on biogas installations, gas upgrading systems and CO₂ systems;

  • Analysing, diagnosing and resolving mechanical and electrical faults;

  • Commissioning, inspecting and optimising installations;

  • Identifying recurring technical issues and proposing structural improvements;

  • Reporting completed work and relevant technical observations;

  • Providing technical advice to customers and colleagues;

  • Participating in an on-call and breakdown support rotation.

You will often work independently, but you will never be on your own. You will work closely with an experienced technical team and can rely on colleagues from different technical disciplines when dealing with complex issues.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a Field Service Engineer who is comfortable in an independent and varied technical role.

You enjoy being on the road, are able to work independently and understand what it means to perform service and maintenance at customer locations.

You have experience as a Field Service Engineer, Service Engineer, Field Technician, Mobile Service Technician or Maintenance Technician, preferably within an industrial or technical environment.

Experience with the maintenance and repair of compressors, industrial installations, process installations, commissioning, rotating equipment or the start-up of new installations would be an excellent match for this position.

Thanks to your technical experience, you are able to analyse faults independently, identify the underlying cause and implement an appropriate solution.

What do you bring?

title: IT/디지털 프로젝트 디자이너 (Web·App·XR 등)
description:
About

[GOOD ATTITUDE MAKES GOOD PERFORMANCE]

기획을 시작으로 크리에이티브를 지나 제작에 이르기까지- 우리는 각자의 영역에서 치열하게 고민하는, 좋은 태도를 지닌 동료들과 함께합니다. 언제 어디서나 탐구하는 자세로 최선의 아이디어를 찾기 위한 노력이 훌륭한 결과물로 이어진다는 사실을 알고 있는 동료들과 함께 성취감을 공유하며 우리가 할 수 있는 일의 영역을 넓혀가고 있습니다. 훌륭한 결과물을 통한 성취감의 가치와 그 힘을 누구보다 잘 알고 있는 동료들이 있기에, 우리의 성장은 멈추지 않습니다.



[MAKE IT WORK]

우리가 하는 모든 일의 출발은 ‘브랜드를 이해하는 것’입니다. 좋은 브랜드, 좋은 제품, 좋은 서비스가 더 많은 사람들에게 공감과 지지를 얻을 수 있도록 브랜드가 가진 이야기를 다양한 방법으로 표현하기 위해 끊임없이 탐구합니다. 온라인과 오프인의 경계를 구분 짓지 않고 브랜드의 이야기를 효과적으로 전달할 수 있는 모든 플랫폼과 결과물을 고민합니다. 브랜드를 위한 크리에이티브에 한계를 두지 않는 자세, 이것이 몽규가 말하는 좋은 태도입니다.



[CREATIVE SOLUTION FOR SUSTAINABLE GROWTH]

우리는 브랜드의 지속가능한 성장을 위한 크리에이티브 솔루션을 제안합니다. 광고를 비롯한 애드-테크 기반의 인터렉션 콘텐츠, 크리에이티브 전략을 바탕으로 디지털 환경에서 높은 효과를 달성하는 캠페인까지. 브랜드의 목적에 따라 솔루션의 모습은 다양하지만, 그 모든 시작은 브랜드의 진정성을 발견하고 브랜드와 같은 마음 — 하나의 팀으로 움직이는 태도입니다.

Responsibilities

• Web·App·XR(AR/VR) 등 디지털 서비스의 UX/UI 및 시각 디자인
• 서비스 컨셉 및 사용자 경험 중심의 화면 기획
• 개발자, 기획자와의 협업을 통한 서비스 완성도 향상
• 프로젝트별 아트디렉션 및 비주얼 가이드 제작
• 클라이언트 제안서(PPT) 및 프로젝트 비주얼 콘셉트 디자인

Requirements

• 디지털 서비스/UI·UX 디자인 경력 5년 이상
• Web/App 서비스 UI/UX 디자인 및 기획 경험
• Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator 등 디자인 툴 숙련자
• 프로젝트 중심의 커뮤니케이션 및 협업 능력 보유자

Preferred

• XR(AR/VR) 콘텐츠 또는 인터랙티브 미디어 디자인 경험
• 프론트엔드(HTML, CSS, JS)에 대한 이해(소통)
• 브랜딩/광고 크리에이티브 경험 보유자
• 감각적 비주얼과 체계적 구조 설계를 함께 고려할 수 있는 분
• 클라이언트 제안서(PPT) 및 프로젝트 비주얼 콘셉트 디자인 경험
• 다양한 산업군(공공, 기업, 브랜드 등)의 제안서 디자인 경험

Benefits

• 딱딱한 직위 체계를 생략한 수평적 '성명 + 님' 호칭으로 커뮤니케이션의 효율을 높여요
• 주 4일제 근무로 나아가기 위한 매월 첫째 주 금요일 4.5 DAY (오전 근무) 운영
• 사내 라운지 무제한 스낵바 제공 / 업무 관련 필요 장비 무제한 지원
• 명절에 두 손은 무겁고, 퇴근은 빠르게! 명절 선물과 연휴 전 마지막 근무일 반차를 지원해요
• 생일에는 축하의 마음을 담아 생일축하금+당일 반차를 지원합니다
• 체력이 국력! 연 1회 100만원 상당의 종합건강검진 지원
• 1 · 3 · 5 · 7년 근속 시 리프레시 휴가 및 우수 사원 해외 연수 지원
• 팀 단합을 위해 인당 5만원(월)의 회식비를 지원해요
• 직접 따낸 프로젝트, 수주 방식과 금액에 따라 최대 순이익의 3%까지 개인 영업 인센티브를 별도 지급해요

title: Maalari
description:
Onko sisämaalaus sinun vahvaa osaamistasi ja etsitkö uusia työkohteita Oulun alueelta? Haluatko työskennellä vaihtelevissa kohteissa ja hyödyntää ammattitaitoasi luotettavan työnantajan kautta?
Etsimme nyt osaavia maalareita asiakasyrityksillemme Oulun alueelle. Työtehtävät koostuvat pääasiassa sisäpuolen maalaustöistä erilaisissa kohteissa, kuten asuin- ja liiketiloissa. Työmaat sijaitsevat Oulun seudulla, ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on etu, jotta työmaille kulkeminen on sujuvaa. Työ on käytännönläheistä ja vaatii huolellista työotetta sekä kykyä toimia itsenäisesti ja osana työporukkaa.
Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:
* Aiempaa kokemusta sisäpuolen maalaustöistä
* Alan työkokemusta vähintään 1–2 vuotta
* Reipas ja oma-aloitteinen asenne työntekoon
* Kyky työskennellä itsenäisesti ja ohjeiden mukaan
* Työturvallisuusajattelua ja huolellisuutta työn jäljessä
* Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti ja sujuva suomen kielen taito
Hienoa (muttei välttämätöntä) on, jos sinulla on lisäksi:
* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus
* Monipuolista kokemusta erilaisista maalauskohteista
Me tarjoamme sinulle:
* TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 15,40-20 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja aiemman työkokemuksesi mukaan
* Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet
* Mukavan ja rennon työporukan
* Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian!

Huomioithan, että otamme vastaan ainoastaan hakupainikkeen kautta lähetetyt hakemukset. Emme käsittele esimerkiksi sähköpostilla, WhatsAppilla tai tekstiviestillä lähetettyjä työhakemuksia.

Please note that we only accept applications submitted via the application button. We do not process job applications sent, for example, by email, WhatsApp, or text message.

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:
Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.
Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:
* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.
* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.
* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.
* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

title: K-뷰티 MD 글로벌 커머스 매니저
description:
About

· https://www.hypercape.com
· 150+ K-뷰티 브랜드 / 9,000+ 글로벌 셀러 / 80+ 국가
· 2022년 이후 매년 3배 이상 성장, 2025년 흑자 전환

하이퍼케이프는 전 세계 인플루언서 및 리셀러들과 구매자를 연결하고, 판매부터 구매자 직배송(D2C)까지 밸류체인의 최대 효율을 만들어갑니다.

하이퍼케이프는 좋은 브랜드를 인플루언서/셀러와 연결해 전 세계 소비자에게 전달합니다. 우리는 브랜드의 글로벌 몰을 직접 구축하고 운영하며, 브랜드의 가치가 인플루언서/셀러를 통해 소비자에게 가장 자연스럽게 닿을 수 있는 '지점'을 설계하고 기술로 구축합니다.

K-뷰티를 시작으로 글로벌 시장에서 이 세 축(브랜드 — 인플루언서/셀러 — 소비자)이 유기적으로 맞물려 돌아가는 생태계를 만드는 것, 그것이 우리가 정의하는 사업의 본질입니다.

**우리가 함께 일하는 방식**
• Love Your Customers: 모든 것을 고객의 관점에서 바라봅니다. 내부/외부 고객 모두의 목소리에 집중합니다.
• Extreme Ownership: 내 일에 무한한 책임을 가집니다. 문제가 보이면 지적하기보다 내가 먼저 해결합니다.
• Data + Judgement: 데이터로 시작해 판단으로 완성합니다. 겉도는 이야기보다 '핵심'을 파악합니다.
• Default to Being Open: 모든 업무 과정은 문서화하여 투명하게 공유합니다. 치열하게 토론하되, 결정은 철저히 따릅니다.
• Frugal Innovation: 부족한 상황이 혁신을 만듭니다. '안 되는 이유'보다 '되게 할 방법'을 집요하게 찾습니다.
• One Team: 우리는 모두 한 곳을 바라봅니다. 동료를 존중하며, 함께 성장하는 것을 최우선으로 합니다.

■ 직무 소개
K-뷰티의 글로벌 판매를 설계하고,성장의 전 과정을 이끕니다
K-뷰티 브랜드와 파트너 셀러가 하이퍼케이프를 통해 전 세계 고객과 만나는 여정을 함께합니다. 브랜드몰 구축과 상품 등록, 글로벌 셀러 연동을 통해 판매 기반을 마련하고, 데이터를 바탕으로 상품 구성과 가격, 프로모션을 최적화합니다. 브랜드와 파트너 셀러의 글로벌 성장을 가장 가까이에서 실행하며 실질적인 성과로 연결하는 역할입니다.

Responsibilities

• 글로벌 자사몰 구축·운영: 신규 브랜드 입점 및 자사몰 구축·운영, Shopify 기반 상품·컬렉션 등록 및 관리
• 데이터 기반 커머스 기획: 브랜드·파트너셀러 성과 분석 및 리포팅, 상품 구성·가격·프로모션 기획 및 운영
• 트렌드 리서치·소싱: K-뷰티 신상품 및 시장 트렌드 리서치·소싱
• 협업·운영 지원: 유관 부서 및 외부 파트너 협업, 파트너 셀러 대응 및 몰 운영 지원

Requirements

• 전자상거래(Shopify, Amazon 등)에 관심이 많고, 글로벌 뷰티 브랜드에 흥미가 있는 분
• 상품, 가격, 프로모션 운영을 End-to-End로 수행해 본 분
• Excel 또는 Google Sheets를 활용한 데이터 분석 및 리포팅 역량을 갖춘 분
• 커머스·마케팅 성과 지표를 이해하는 분
• 여러 시스템과 이해관계자가 연결된 업무를 체계적으로 관리할 수 있는 분
• 맡은 업무의 최종 완료와 운영 안정성까지 책임지는 분
• 꼼꼼하고 책임감 있게 업무를 진행할 수 있는 분

Preferred

• 생성형 AI 등 AI 도구를 활용한 업무 효율화 역량을 보유하신 분
• 이커머스 MD 또는 운영 실무 경험이 있으신 분
• Shopify 기반 글로벌 브랜드몰 운영 또는 구축 경험
• SQL을 활용한 데이터 추출 및 분석 경험
• K-뷰티, 라이프스타일 또는 글로벌 D2C 브랜드 운영 경험
• 할인, GWP, 무료배송, Rewards 등 복합 프로모션 설계 경험
• 파트너·리셀러 등 외부 셀러 채널의 모집 및 활성화 경험

Benefits

title: Customer Assistant - Food - Crystal Peaks Sheffield
description:
Work Pattern

Sunday 16:00 - 20:00
Friday 17:30 - 21:30
Saturday 17:00 - 21:00

Join M&S as a Customer Assistant in our Food section, where you'll become be at the frontline of the UK’s fastest growing retailer. We’re not just looking for someone to fill shelves – we need down-to-earth colleagues who thrive under pressure, deliver five-star service at pace, and embrace the transformation we're driving.

We're seeking passionate individuals who not only take pride in their knowledge of M&S Food products but are also ready to roll their sleeves up and go again, day in and day out, meeting strong customer demand head-on.

You'll be a resilient and committed brand ambassador who’s ready to raise the bar by confidently recommending and selling our newest food products to our customers. Through remarkable service you'll make sure our customers feel truly valued every time they shop with us.

At M&S, our customers don't wait. You’ll thrive in a high-pressure environment, staying sharp, fast, and focused when the store is at its busiest. You’ll go above and beyond, to serve, sell, fill and help drive growth in sales.

Being digitally confident is essential. You'll utilise our digital tools, such as the Sparks App and our in-store devices, to enhance the customer experience and ensure they get the products they want when they need them.

Being a team player is crucial. You’ll contribute to a positive, high-energy environment, where everyone works hard and supports each other in delivering a seamless customer experience.

Flexibility is also vital. You should be poised to work across various areas of the store, adapting to the changing demands of the retail environment. No two shifts will look the same – and you’ll embrace the challenge.

This is a frontline role, not for the faint-hearted. But for those who are ready to roll up their sleeves, there’s huge opportunity. Are you ready for it? Take Your Marks and apply today.

title: Montörer sökes till fordonsindustrin
description:
Dina arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker montörer för ett välkänt företag inom fordonsindustrin i Skövde. Som montör kommer du vara mycket på fötterna och jobba praktiskt, det är därför ett stort plus att du har en god fysik och tycker om att röra på dig. Är du dessutom en person som är driven att utvecklas och tycker det är roligt med högt tempo kommer det här jobbet vara för dig.

Arbetet innebär att du kommer arbeta i olika skift. Din bakgrund

Vi söker personer som är drivna, självständiga och ansvarstagande. Den här rollen kommer passa dig som är intresserad av teknik, har lätt att lära och kan vara både noggrann och snabb på samma gång. Det är viktigt att du är social, van vid att jobba i ett högt tempo och inte är rädd för att ta dig an andra arbetsuppgifter vid behov. Du ska trivas med att arbeta i team men även att klara av att ta på dig individuella uppgifter.

Krav

- B-körkort. - Godkänd gymnasieexamen, och en teknisk bakgrund. Exempelvis har du gått teknik, natur, lichron, el och energi, eller transport och fordon på gymnasiet.

Truckkort och tidigare erfarenhet av montering eller industriarbete är meriterande.

Om företaget

Företaget är välkänt i Skövde och en ledande aktör inom fordonsindustrin.

Urval

Vi använder oss av löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista dag för ansökan. Skicka därför in din ansökan redan idag!

title: Dot Net Developer
description:
Job Purpose

Job Purpose

We are looking for a .NET Developer with 3-5 years of experience to develop and maintain high-quality software solutions. As a member of our development team, you will work on various projects, contribute to all phases of the development life cycle, and enhance your skills in a collaborative and innovative setting.

About Product & Technology

Product & Technology plays a pivotal role in aligning the organization with its strategic objectives and enhancing shareholder value. Product & Technology is responsible for establishing unified standards and governance practices throughout the company. Additionally, we oversee the development and maintenance of core applications essential for the seamless operation of various functions across the organization. We are committed to driving and executing future roadmaps that are in line with the overall strategic direction of RWS.

With a global reach, Product & Technology provides support services to over 7500 end users worldwide. We take pride in managing the information security operation and safeguarding all our assets. Our core functions encompass Enterprise & Technical Architecture, Network & Voice, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Service Operations, Data & Analytics, Security & Quality Compliance, Transformation, Application Development, Enterprise Platforms, With a dedicated team of over 500 staff, Product & Technology ensures a strong presence across all regions, enabling efficient and effective support to our global operations.

Job Overview

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET technologies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Write clean, scalable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.
  • Troubleshoot and debug applications to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
  • Contribute to the documentation of software processes and code.

title: Director, Product Managerment
description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.

· Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience

· Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence

· Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

About the Role

The Car Audio Brand Experience Team creates innovative meaningful Branded Audio consumer experiences to make a positive impact on people’s lives with products, services, and technologies.

This role will lead the brand experience scope and planning, at the feature and brand + customer experience, product, and feature roadmaps and business model, for customers in their assigned region. He or she is responsible for formalized ideation, consumer studies, validation, market and competitive analysis, and the resulting prioritization of experience features at the hardware, software, and feature level. These roadmaps are organized and viewed from two perspectives:

1. Planning feature deliveries for experience packages of hardware, software and consumer-centric features into production-oriented, vehicle installed experiences, to be presented as in-region brand + customer proposals by you, the Brand Owner, and supporting teams.

2. Planning and translating the successful delivery and handover of the underlying ~80% reusable assets, specifications, and documentation for these customer + brand experience bundles in-region, from domain and asset teams, to customer project teams, for production program integration and validation, within the automotive environment, with market leading speed and quality.

This role will serve as the primary planning, feature validation, prioritization business analysis, and risk evaluation interface for in-region brand + customer experience packages, with internal and external stakeholders (both up and downstream), across global teams. Additionally, the role will work closely with consumer insights, benchmarking, marketing, controlling, the Brand Owner, Brand Technical Lead, Brand Delivery Manager and Business Analysts to insure a complete go to market path for each brand + customer package in-region, and these represent a healthy business model from which the Harman customer teams can build a customer proposal, and eventual RFQ or equivalent negotiations.

What you will do

  • Follow the Brand Owner’s overarching Brand Experience Precedent, Framework and Business Model to lead the brand experience scope and planning for multiple brand + customer combinations and adaptations in-region, including brand + customer experience product, feature roadmaps, and business model.
  • Support Harman customer teams in-region, in building proposals and eventual negotiations.
    • Act as local Brand Ambassador to translate the Brand Owner experience vision, development, customer relationship, business model, and direct plus cross-functional teams to define, match, and deliver compelling brand experience product bundles with customer partners
    • Serve as single Point of Contact for local customer and CAM teams for the brand – Support the jointly developed customer engagement strategy on pursuits
    • Represent & Promote brand and experience both internally and at the customer - build relationships, support tech day events, present brand and customer proposals
  • Formalize ideation, engage internal research and benchmarking teams, and conduct consumer studies, feature discovery and validation, and market and competitive analysis, in target region(s) to prioritize experience features at the hardware, software, and feature level.
    • Note: while the Regional Brand Product Manager’s role is focused in-region, reusable features and assets developed with global teams are in-scope for the role to insure efficiency at the overall SBU global Brand Owner level.
  • Drive the CAM, Build Creation Teams, and Brand Project Manager to insure feature deliveries for experience packages of hardware, software, and consumer-centric features into production-oriented, vehicle-installed experiences and internal and external demonstration events in-region.
  • Co-Create (with the CAM) and present in-region customer + brand proposals (including customer demonstrations) with oversight from the Brand Owner and in collaboration with supporting teams, for brand + customer combinations in-region.
  • Collaborate with Release Train Engineer (RTE), System Architect, and Product Owners as they translate your feature epics, user journeys, use cases, and technical requirements into detailed requirements at the sprint level.
  • Influence and collaborate on the delivery plans and roadmaps of reusable assets developed by domain and cross-brand asset managers; incorporate these into your feature level roadmaps.
  • Translate feature and asset deliveries to customer project teams via active teaching, facilitation of internal demonstrations, and by insuring proper document/specification deliveries from upstream teams to insure production program integration and validation within the automotive environment with the global teams and stakeholders.
  • Support the overall team that builds, tests, and delivers Brand Features to Project Teams, with market leading speed and quality
  • Oversee the creation of internal documentation for brand experience features and brand + customer adaptations through Brand Experience concept freeze and approval (PDM)
  • Serve as the primary interface for feature planning, validation, prioritization, business analysis, and risk evaluation for internal and external stakeholders on the global team, for 10-15 feature and customer + brand roadmaps.
  • Develop, Curate, and Manage 10-15 feature and customer + brand roadmaps across products in a bundle, at the level of feature, product, and bundle.
  • Collaborate closely with consumer insights, benchmarking, controlling, the Brand Owner, Brand Technical Lead, Brand Delivery Manager, and Business Analysts to validate and prioritize features leading up to and including pre-PI alignment, grooming, and approval, and larger activities in PI planning and execution.
  • Ensure all features within a customer + brand bundle have a clear go-to-market strategy (bundling, pricing, sales, messaging) and fit within the Brand Experience package, for customers in-region, and these represent a healthy business model.
  • Participate in ART-level events (PI Planning, System Demos, Inspect & Adapt), and Manage the feature backlog that addresses customer + brand experience packages in-region.
  • Engage with Product Marketing for feature input to create customer-facing assets for customer + brand combinations in-region
  • Drive development of demo cars integrating brand experience package and features in-region.

What You Need to Be Successful

  • Bachelor degree in Engineering and Business or related demonstrated technical expertise
  • 15+ years of combined brand, audio, product, and business related experience.
  • 8+ years in Product Management
  • A mature approach toward indirect leadership, influence, and soft skills: building trust and long term internal team relationships to influence consistent, positive outcomes.
  • Functional knowledge of automotive infotainment and audio systems.
  • Demonstrated acumen in business case development, program management, make/buy, commercial, and product bundling/sales strategy, feature ideation, and consumer validation.
  • Ability to communicate advanced and complex concepts and ideas persuasively and concisely, internally and externally, up to the executive level.
  • A "whatever-it-takes" attitude using diplomatic leadership skills within a collaborative teamwork environment to accomplish the necessary results.
  • Experience indirectly leading and managing teams to drive time critical projects to completion.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • A combination of Engineering and Business Degrees (eg. Ba ENG + MBA)
  • Functional knowledge of AGILE methodologies at the ART level
  • Strong recommendations from automotive industry colleagues
  • Automotive Business & Engineering Landscape Knowledge
  • Passion for the power of brand as a unifying concept for bundles of experience products
  • Passion for acoustics and sound reproduction

What Makes You Eligible

  • Be willing to travel up to 25%, domestic and international travel.
  • Be willing to work in the Novi or Garching office
  • Successfully complete a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment

What We Offer

  • HARMAN FlexConnect Program, offering a flexible hybrid work environment that fosters stronger collaboration, meaningful connections, and innovation through a minimum of three in-office days per week.

  • Access to employee discounts on world class HARMAN/Samsung products (JBL, Harman Kardon, AKG etc.)
  • Inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages career development opportunities
  • Flexible work schedule with a culture encouraging work life integration and collaboration in a global environment
  • On-site opportunities to focus on personal well-being and development such as, onsite café, fitness center, weekly massage, fitness classes, and other onsite events promoted by our employee resource groups
  • Professional development opportunities through HARMAN University’s business and leadership academies
  • Internal talent management leadership acceleration programs
  • “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program

title: Maintenance
description:
At ALS, we encourage you to dream big.

Our values are important to us, and shape how we work, how we treat each other and how we recognise excellence.

At ALS, you’ll be supported to develop new skills and reach your full potential. We invest in our people with programs and opportunities that help you build a diverse career with us.

We want everyone to have a safe, flexible and rewarding career that makes a positive impact on our people, the planet and our communities.

Everyone Matters

ALS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where the strengths and perspectives of each employee are both recognised and valued.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About the Role
As a Senior Data Scientist on the Fulfilment team at Gojek, you’ll join a cross-functional group spanning Singapore, India, and Indonesia, working together to solve some of the company’s most complex and impactful problems. Our mission is to fulfil our users' orders efficiently and balance the needs of the customers, drivers and merchants.
In this role, you’ll work closely with business leaders, product managers, engineers, and fellow data scientists who are deeply committed to building real-world solutions. Within your first six months, you’ll contribute to improving our dynamic driver incentives to drive reliability of our on demand services.
This is a high-impact role where core data science work directly shapes the user experience and driver earnings. If you're passionate about using data to solve real problems, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to see your work make a tangible difference at scale, this is the team for you.

What You Will Do

  • Translate complex business challenges into well-defined technical problems solvable with data, statistics, and machine learning.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to build and scale data science solutions that power driver allocations, surge pricing and driver incentives.
  • Own the full ML lifecycle—from ideation and research to model development, pipeline implementation, deployment, experimentation, and driving measurable business outcomes.
  • Improve the efficiency of our dynamic driver incentives using techniques from machine learning, causal inference, optimization and simulation
  • Design and interpret experiments to measure model impact, working with analysts and product teams to ensure rigorous evaluation and clear success metrics.
  • Monitor and evaluate model performance, identifying areas for improvement and proposing solutions
  • Communicate insights, trade-offs, and technical decisions effectively to cross-functional stakeholders, and operate with a high degree of autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces.

    • What You Will Need

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field
  • Solid understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals, with coursework or projects demonstrating practical application.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, and familiarity with data analysis or modeling libraries.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason from data and communicate findings clearly.
  • A willingness to learn fast, take initiative, and work collaboratively in a cross-functional team.
  • Curiosity, humility, and a drive to apply data science to real-world problems at scale.
    • About the Team
    The fulfilment team works on some of the most high-leverage problems in Gojek. Our real time engines power all of Gojek's on demand services - food delivery, ride-hailing and logistics - and ensure the timely fulfilment of millions of orders daily.
    We tackle complex, real-world challenges: What’s the best driver incentive scheme given budget and supply targets? How can pricing be adjusted to maximize revenue as well as balance customer demand and driver earnings? Why are drivers with certain characteristics more likely to complete long-distance trips than others? How long will a certain food order take for a restaurant to prepare and accordingly when should we dispatch a driver? And how do we take these decisions in real time, just a few milliseconds?
    Solving these problems requires not just data and models, but thoughtful product design, experimentation, and scale. We’re equipped with rich datasets, strong cross-functional partnerships, and modern MLOps infrastructure to build and deploy impactful solutions efficiently.
    As a team, we’re concerned not only with the growth of the company, but each other’s personal and professional growths, too. Along with keeping fit (via table tennis or other activities), our team bonds over our shared love of traveling and eating.

    About GoTo Group
    GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
    The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

    About Gojek
    Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

    About GoTo Financial
    GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

title: Asystent / Asystentka ds. sprzedaży
description:
Nasza sprzedaż pędzi do przodu, dlatego szukamy energii i zaangażowania – ambitnej osoby studiującej, która wejdzie do naszego teamu handlowego, odciąży naszą Team Leaderkę, przejdzie u nas prawdziwą szkołę biznesu i z czasem wyrośnie na samodzielnego asa międzynarodowej sprzedaży.

Dlaczego warto do nas dołączyć właśnie teraz?

  • Rośniemy jak szaleni: Od trzech lat co roku podwajamy nasze obroty (x2 rok do roku!). My nie stoimy w miejscu – my lecimy!
  • Szkoła biznesu w praktyce: Nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę bez koła ratunkowego. Będziesz pracować ramię w ramię z naszą Team Leaderką sprzedaży, ucząc się od podstaw, jak wygląda nowoczesny, międzynarodowy proces B2B.
  • Wychowamy własnego managera: Szukamy kogoś na dłużej. Chcemy Cię wyszkolić i dać Ci narzędzia, byś po studiach (lub w ich trakcie) stał/a się w pełni samodzielnym Account Managerem z własnym portfolio dużych, zagranicznych klientów.
  • Pełna elastyczność: Wiemy, czym są kolokwia i sesja. U nas bez problemu połączysz naukę z pracą – działamy zdalnie i dopasowujemy grafik do Twojego planu zajęć.

🔎 Kogo szukamy?

Szukamy osoby na starcie swojej drogi w biznesie, która ma w sobie naturalną ciekawość, "głód" wiedzy i chce szybko chłonąć praktyczne umiejętności. Nie musisz mieć wieloletniego doświadczenia – najważniejsza jest dla nas Twoja postawa, zaangażowanie i to, czy złapiemy wspólny vibe.


Będzie nam po drodze, jeśli:

  • Posiadasz status studenta i szukasz miejsca, w którym realnie rozwiniesz skrzydła (a nie tylko „odbębnisz” staż).
  • Swobodnie rozmawiasz i piszesz po angielsku oraz polsku (must-have) – działamy międzynarodowo, więc codzienny kontakt z zagranicznymi klientami to u nas standard.
  • Jesteś osobą świetnie zorganizowaną i skrupulatną – potrafisz samodzielnie zarządzać swoim czasem w pracy zdalnej, nie gubisz wątków i dbasz o porządek w dokumentach oraz systemach.
  • Chcesz się uczyć sprzedaży i obsługi klienta B2B – pierwsze doświadczenia w kontakcie z ludźmi (np. obsługa klienta, gastronomia, call center, wolontariaty) będą super atutem, ale najważniejsza jest chęć do nauki.
  • Stawiasz na szczerość i otwartą komunikację – pracujemy zdalnie, więc jasny przepływ informacji to dla nas podstawa. U nas mówi się wprost, co działa, a co nie.

title: Kock till skola och förskola i Österåker
description:
Vikariepoolen arbetar med uthyrning och rekrytering av pedagogisk personal och kökspersonal till förskola och skola. I över två decennier har vi stöttat upp och avlastat förskolans och skolans verksamheter i deras viktiga uppdrag – att lära, stärka och utveckla nya generationer av barn och unga för framtiden. Tillsammans arbetar vi mot vårt gemensamma mål – en bra skolgång för nästa generation.

Motiveras du av att laga god och näringsrik mat till barn och unga?

Vi på Vikariepoolen söker engagerade och erfarna kockar för uppdrag inom förskolor och skolor i Österåker under sommarlovet och läsåret 26/27. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta flexibelt och själv påverka när du vill ta uppdrag. Vi matchar uppdrag utifrån din kompetens, erfarenhet och tillgänglighet.

Som anställd hos Vikariepoolen blir du en del av ett engagerat team som värdesätter samarbete, kvalitet och service. Vi finns nära till hands och stöttar dig före, under och efter varje uppdrag.

Om jobbet

Som vikarie inom kök och måltidsservice spelar du en viktig roll i verksamheten när ordinarie personal är frånvarande. Du bidrar till att barn och elever får goda, näringsriktiga måltider i en trygg och välfungerande måltidsmiljö.

Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:

  • laga mat från grunden och servera frukost, lunch och mellanmål
  • tillaga näringsrik specialkost utifrån barns olika allergier
  • ansvara för att genomföra egenkontroll, hygien och att livsmedelshanteringen sker enligt gällande krav, disk och städning av köket
  • Bidra till en positiv och välorganiserad arbetsmiljö

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är kunnig, ansvarstagande och engagerad i ditt arbete. Du trivs med att ta eget ansvar, har god planeringsförmåga och kan snabbt sätta dig in i nya arbetsmiljöer och rutiner. Samtidigt är du samarbetsinriktad och lyhörd för verksamhetens behov.

För att vara aktuell för tjänsten ser vi att du:

  • Har utbildning från restaurang- och livsmedelsprogrammet eller annan likvärdig kockutbildning
  • Har minst sex månaders erfarenhet av självständigt arbete som kock i förskolekök eller skolkök
  • Har goda kunskaper om livsmedelssäkerhet och HACCP
  • Har mycket god kunskap om allergener och erfarenhet av att tillaga specialkost
  • Har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för matlagning och vill bidra till att barn och unga får en positiv måltidsupplevelse varje dag.

title: Etsivä nuorisotyöntekijä
description:
Rovaniemen kaupungin nuorisopalvelut hakee etsivää nuorisotyöntekijää toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan toimeen.

Etsivä nuorisotyö tarjoaa nuorisolain mukaista yksilöllistä tukea 15-28-vuotiaille nuorille, jotka kaipaavat apua elämäntilanteensa selkiyttämiseen, suunnitelmien tekemiseen tai palveluihin kiinnittymiseen. Työn tavoitteena on tavoittaa koulutuksen ja työelämän ulkopuolelle jääneet nuoret ja ohjata heidät tarpeitaan vastaavien tukimuotojen ja palvelujen piiriin. Etsivässä nuorisotyössä vahvistetaan nuorten kasvua, itsenäistymistä ja osallisuutta yhteiskuntaan varmistaen, ettei kukaan jää yksin.

Etsimme ammattilaista, joka kohtaa nuoret yksilöllisesti ja tunnistaa heidän vahvuutensa. Työssä painottuvat luottamuksen rakentaminen, arjen tukeminen ja osallisuuden vahvistaminen. Tehtävä edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, pitkäjänteisyyttä sekä kykyä kohdata nuoria erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa, myös ohjauksen ja palveluohjauksen osaaminen on tärkeää. Arvostamme kokemusta nuorten parissa työskentelystä, verkostoyhteistyöstä ja palvelujärjestelmän tuntemusta.

Työ sisältää nuorten yksilöohjausta, pienryhmätoimintaa, jalkautuvaa työtä sekä moniammatillista verkostoyhteistyötä. Etsivä nuorisotyöntekijä toimii osana kohdennetun nuorisotyön tiimiä, ja työ on liikkuvaa sekä sisältää ajoittain ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä. Tehtävä edellyttää oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta. Tehtävässä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Tarjoamme:

- Merkityksellisen työn nuorten parissa

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa mm. ryhmätoiminnan sisältöihin

- ePassi palvelun, jota voi käyttää mm. liikunta- ja kulttuuripalveluihin

Kelpoisuusehtona on soveltuva ohjaus-, kasvatus- tai sosiaalialan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi vastaava opistotason tutkinto. Eduksi katsotaan riittävä työkokemus nuorten kanssa tehtävästä työstä.

Työ alkaa 21.9.2026. Palkkaus ja muut palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät KVTES:n mukaisesti.

Tehtävään valitun on ennen työn aloittamista toimitettava nähtäväksi lain 504/2002 (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä) mukainen rekisteriote ja huumausainetestin tulos.

description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

Retail Program Management 조직은 Coupang Retail 전 카테고리의 지속적인 사업 성장과 운영 효율성 향상을 지원하기 위해, 개별 카테고리를 넘어 전사적·범조직적 프로그램을 기획, 설계, 운영하는 조직입니다.

주요 역할은 다음과 같습니다.

  • Retail 전반의 핵심 과제를 정의하고 우선순위를 수립하여 전략적 프로그램을 추진
  • 새로운 비즈니스 기회 발굴 및 확장 전략 수립을 통한 성장 동력 확보
  • 카테고리 간 공통 문제를 해결하고 표준 프로세스 및 운영 체계를 구축하여 확장성 확보
  • 데이터 기반 인사이트를 활용한 성과 관리 및 의사결정 체계 고도화
  • 고객 경험 개선과 사업 성과 향상을 동시에 달성할 수 있는 혁신 프로그램 설계 및 운영

이를 통해 Retail Program Management 조직은 단순한 프로젝트 관리 조직을 넘어, Coupang Retail의 성장 전략을 실행 가능한 프로그램으로 전환하고 조직 전반의 실행력을 높이는 핵심 엔진 역할을 담당하고 있습니다.

업무 내용

1. Premium Data & Brand Shop+ Program Operations Management

  • Premium Data 및 Brand Shop+ 프로그램의 End-to-End 운영 체계를 관리하며 안정적인 서비스 운영 지원
  • 구독(Subscription) 관리, KPI 모니터링 및 성과 리포팅을 통해 프로그램 운영 현황을 체계적으로 관리
  • 브랜드 및 내부 이해관계자의 문의, 이슈 및 고객 응대를 총괄하며 운영 품질 유지
  • 정책, 프로세스 및 시스템 변경사항에 대한 커뮤니케이션과 Change Management를 주도하여 원활한 운영 전환 지원
  • 운영 프로세스 표준화 및 지속적인 개선을 통해 운영 효율성과 확장성 확보

2. Brand Shop+ 운영 고도화 및 전략 프로젝트 리드

  • 브랜드 경험 향상 및 운영 효율화를 위한 신규 기능 및 프로세스 개선 프로젝트 추진
  • Product 및 Engineering 조직과 협업하여 기능 개발, 정책 개선 및 시스템 고도화 과제 리드
  • 운영 자동화 및 확장 가능한 운영 모델 구축을 통해 프로그램 경쟁력 강화

3. Retail Growth 지원을 위한 신규 비즈니스 및 혁신 프로그램 개발

  • Retail 사업 성장을 지원할 수 있는 신규 비즈니스 기회 및 전략적 프로그램 발굴
  • 고객 경험 개선과 운영 혁신을 동시에 달성할 수 있는 성장 이니셔티브 개발
  • 데이터 및 시장 인사이트를 기반으로 혁신 과제를 정의하고 실행 계획 수립
  • Cross-functional 조직과 협업하여 신규 프로그램을 기획·실행하고 조직 내 확산 주도

자격 요건

  • 이커머스, 유통 또는 관련 산업군에서 Program Management, Business Operations, Project Management 경력이 5년 이상이신 분
  • 정량적 데이터 분석을 통해 비즈니스 문제를 정의하고 개선안을 도출해 본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 표준 운영 절차(SOP) 수립 및 프로세스 개선 프로젝트를 주도하여 인력/비용/시간 효율화를 이끌어내신 분
  • 다양한 이해관계자(Product, Engineering, Business, Operations 등)와의 협업을 통해 프로젝트를 성공적으로 추진한 경험이 있으신 분
  • KPI 관리, 운영 성과 모니터링 및 리포팅 경험이 있으신 분

우대 사항

  • 신규 서비스, 기능 또는 비즈니스 프로그램을 기획하고 Launch한 경험이 있으신 분
  • Subscription, Membership, B2B Program 운영 경험을 보유하신 분
  • E-commerce, Marketplace, Digital Platform 산업 경험을 보유하신 분
  • SQL, Tableau, Power BI 등 데이터 분석 및 시각화 도구 활용 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Rakennustyöntekijöitä
description:
Haemme työmaan yleisosaajia eli monipuolisia RAKENNUSTYÖNTEKIJÖITÄ Pirkanmaan alueelle.

TEHTÄVÄNKUVA
Tehtävänä monipuoliset ja työvaiheen mukaisesti vaihtelevat rakennustyöt uudis- ja saneerauskohteissa. Tehtävänä esimerkiksi levytys, villoitus, väliseinien rakentaminen ja purkutyöt.

TOIVOMME SINULTA
Toivomme hyvää asennetta työntekoon, monipuolista osaamista ja valmiutta tarttua tehtävään kuin tehtävään työmaalla. Toivomme myös sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja työturvallisuuskorttia (tarvittaessa avustamme kortin hankinnassa). Eduksi katsomme B-ajokortin ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuuden.

TARJOAMME
Me NJC:llä tarjoamme ammattimaisen työsuhdeasioiden hoidon jo 30 vuoden kokemuksella, mahdollisuuden myös pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen, monipuoliset tehtävät sekä asialliset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Miksi töihin NJC:lle? Lue lisää täältä! <https://njc.fi/miksi-njc/>

Palkka määräytyy rakennusalan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti. Palkkaukseen vaikuttaa mahdollinen alan koulutus/aiempi työkokemus.

Työn kesto määräytyy asiakasyritystemme tilausten ja tarpeiden mukaisesti. Työaika on arkisin pääsääntöisesti klo 7 - 15.30.

Jätä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta. Lisääthän hakemukseen tiedon aiemmasta työhistoriasta ja koulutuksesta sekä mahdolliset voimassa olevat kortit (esim. työturvallisuuskortti, tulityökortti, tieturvakortti). Hakemuksia käsitellään jo haukaikana.
Lisätietoja saat tarvittaessa Jutalta arkisin klo 8-16, p. 040 964 8232.

Oululaislähtöinen NJC on tuottanut henkilöstö- ja työmaapalveluita joustavasti ja luotettavasti jo 30 vuoden ajan. Työllistämme vuosittain sadoilla työmailla ja kymmenissä tehtaissa noin 1000 rakennus- ja teollisuusalojen ammattilaista, joista jokainen on tärkeä osa NJC:n tarinaa. Lue työntekijöidemme kokemuksia osoitteesta<http://njc.fi/category/kokemuksia/> .

title: Grocery Vertical Lead
description:
Mr D, a division of takealot.com, is looking for a highly talented Grocery Vertical Lead to join our team in Cape Town.

We are a young, dynamic, hyper growth company looking for smart, creative, hard-working people with integrity to join us!

Think you’ve been challenged before? Think again!

  • Scale: Show the millions of Mr D customers what you can do
  • Learn: We work with the best of the best, and then some.
  • Grow: Expand your career in the fast-growing Takealot Group: takealot.com, Superbalist.com and Mr D. We like to promote from within: Here’s your chance.

This position reports to the Head Of Retail

The role will be key to implementing grocery channel strategies, driving performance accountability across cross-functional teams, optimizing customer experience, and managing commercial outcomes within the e-commerce grocery landscape

Key responsibilities: (What are you directly responsible to achieve within the scope of your role)

Section 1: Merchandising & Commercial Implementation
(35%)

  • Implement category merchandising, optimize product positioning/search, increase average basket size/frequency, and coordinate seasonal campaigns and promotional planning with Pick n Pay.

Section 2: Performance Management & Accountability
(40%)

  • Marketing Coordination: Align Mr D and Pick n Pay marketing teams; track customer acquisition/retention metrics.
  • Operations Oversight: Create visibility on delivery execution metrics; drive corrective actions and escalate operational issues with internal/external teams to preserve SLA KPIs
  • Utilize data analytics to evaluate the performance of the vertical and make data-driven recommendations.
  • Prepare regular reports on key metrics, trends, and insights for internal and external stakeholders.

Section 3: Project Management & Cross-Functional
Coordination (25%)

  • Responsible for cross functional project management on all Grocery related projects
  • Participate in all Grocery workstream sessions to capture project tasks and co ordinate delivery across the Grocery Vertical

Output: (What are you expected to deliver within the scope of your role)

  • Marketing - a successful joint marketing plan aligned to the Mr D and Pick n Pay Teams to drive Growth in active customer base, increased basket size, and purchase frequency
  • Product Roadmap - driving cross functional accountability to deliver to this roadmap
  • Grocery operational KPI delivery (SLA achievements, delivery standards)

Attributes required:

  • Cross-Functional Influence & Collaboration:Proven ability to lead project delivery, drive accountability, and influence outcomes across diverse teams (including Marketing, Operations, Merchandising, Product, and Engineering) without direct authority.
  • Strategic Stakeholder Engagement: Exceptional capability to operate on high-value corporate partnerships through facilitating effective collaboration, and align internal and external stakeholders toward shared performance goals.
  • Operational Change Management: Strong problem-solving and change management capabilities to identify performance gaps, implement corrective action plans, and drive structural optimizations when operational standards or SLAs are not met.
  • Data analysis and cross-functional project management: Ability to interpret performance metrics, generate actionable insights, and lead collaborative initiatives across multiple departments.
  • Strong understanding of online retail and its unique challenges and opportunities.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and derive actionable insights.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic plans.
  • Experience in managing cross-functional teams.
  • Results-oriented with a focus on achieving targets and KPIs

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Relevant Degree (business studies, marketing, retail management, etc).
  • Minimum 2-3 years work experience in an Ecommerce/Retail Environment
  • 3+ years of project management/cross-functional coordination experience
  • Experience in grocery/food retail, managing marketing partnership collaborations, knowledge of on-demand delivery metrics, and Project Management certification is preferred but not required

Let’s talk about life @ Mr D

  • The power is in your hands: We offer a market-related, Total Remuneration Package which allows full flexibility according to your needs. Go on, be the master of your own destiny.
  • No doors: We aren’t fans of stuffy offices or siloed work environments. See someone you like? High five, Collab and make something great.
  • Online Learning: Share ideas and grow with global industry leaders who are all just a Slack message away. Love to learn? Up-skill with free access to courses on MyAcademy and more.
  • Good times: Get to know the other extraordinary minds in the Takealot group during regular social events and out-of-office activities (think hikes, think mini golf, think good times).
  • Birthday leave: Cake Day all the way. Enjoy your day off - you deserve it.
  • Help when you need it most: Confidential counselling, legal support and financial guidance, for free, anytime, anywhere.
  • Free parking: No more 5km fun runs to your desk (unless you want to).

Like what you see?

If you meet the above you are an Extraordinary Mind. Apply today!!

Mr D is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants from previously disadvantaged groups and people with disabilities will be given preference

title: Säljande försäljningschef till MidSale!
description:
Vill du ta nästa steg från säljare till ledare – och fortsätta sälja samtidigt?

Vi söker nu en Säljande Försäljningschef till MidSale Consulting. Rollen passar dig som har erfarenhet av försäljning, visar starka resultat och nu vill utvecklas inom ledarskap. Du leder genom att vara ett föredöme i försäljningen och visar teamet hur jobbet ska göras – i praktiken.

Som försäljningschef ansvarar du för ett team som arbetar med uppsökande försäljning mot privatpersoner. Ditt fokus ligger på att coacha, stötta och utveckla säljare i deras vardag, samtidigt som du själv är aktiv i försäljningen och bidrar till teamets resultat.

Dina arbetsuppgifter:

  • Delta aktivt i försäljningen och visa vägen genom eget sälj
  • Coacha och stötta säljare dagligen för att höja deras resultat
  • Följa upp mål, resultat och aktivitet tillsammans med teamet
  • Skapa struktur, energi och motivation i försäljningsarbetet
  • Säkerställa att teamet når sin månadsbudget

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har erfarenhet av försäljning och vill ta nästa steg i karriären
  • Är driven, tävlingsinriktad och motiveras av tydliga mål
  • Vill utvecklas inom ledarskap och coachning
  • Är positiv, kommunikativ och trygg i dialog med andra
  • Kan ta ansvar och är tydlig när det behövs
  • Har god förståelse för siffror och resultat
  • Talar och skriver flytande svenska

Tidigare chefsroll är inget krav – det viktigaste är rätt inställning, vilja att lära och att du trivs i en roll där försäljning och ledarskap går hand i hand.


Om MidSale Consulting

MidSale Consulting är ett säljbolag som arbetar med välkända varumärken över hela Sverige. Vi är cirka 70 medarbetare som alla drivs av samma mål – att bli Sveriges främsta säljbolag.

Hos oss får du:

  • En tydlig karriärväg inom försäljning och ledarskap
  • Utbildning och löpande coaching i din roll
  • En energifylld och tävlingsinriktad arbetsmiljö

title: Business Systems Analyst (4+ Years in BA, configuration and complex testing, SQL, API, Agile)
description:
Business Systems Analyst, Assurant-GCC, India

This job is responsible for application configuration management within Assurant’s global Trade-In and Upgrade solution ecosystem; supporting Americas, LATAM, EU, AU and Japan regions. On projects of various complexity, the position participates in activities such as delivery planning, requirement definition, requirements analysis, software setup, test plan design and execution, training and documentation. Also responsible for data analytical and profiling functions, and creation of technical requirement documents.

This position will be in Hyderabad and Bengaluru at our India location.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Acts as the customer/IT liaison during analysis, requirements definition and planning activities; documenting business requirements to implementing software configurations. (10%)

  • Participates in the project management process; understands and applies the system development methodology; contributes to project deliverables including status reports, and project risk; and communicates status, business impacts and system changes to team members, business partners, sponsors, management and other interested parties; coordinates issues, tracking and resolution on high level, complex projects. (15%)

  • Coordinates and owns configuration management activities for project assignments; provides guidance for testing strategies, scope and scenarios; reviews and provides advice for testing-related estimates of effort, duration and resource utilization; prepares and reviews test plans; identifies testing risks and contributes to the overall management of project and risk plans; coordinates, manages and participates in complex testing efforts; perform data profiling and analytical tasks using Microsoft SQL Server. (40%)

  • Develops moderate to complex reports and file extracts using Power BI; publishing permission-controlled UI reports, subscription delivered reports, subscription delivered files extracts. Understands intricacies of reporting, including system data flows, data availability, data accessibility and data privacy, to gather critical details from stakeholders required to provide secure, compliant access to data. (20%)

  • Provides general customer and IT support for assigned business applications; works with business and technical staff to perform effective root-cause analysis and resolution. Gathers, compiles, interprets and summarizes systems and business process changes; maintains reference materials and standard-process documentations. (15%)

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • 4 years working with business users and stakeholders on business requirements, software setup and testing, technical documentation (including data-process flows), and systems analytics
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication soft skills, with a strong emphasis on clarity
  • Exceptional skills identifying subtle nuances in business requirements and translating them into precise technical requirements
  • Experience working in a high-paced, highly flexible, team environment
  • Aptitude for logical and analytical thinking, coupled with strong problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable with log-level data analysis of application behavior discrepancies
  • Applied understanding of languages: SQL, JSON, XML, HTML, YAML
  • Proficient with SQL queries, temp tables, procedures, etc. – able to build complex reports and data extracts
  • Utilization of API tools: SOAP UI, Postman, Swagger UI
  • Experience with agile management tools (ie: Azure DevOps, JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint)

What other the Preferred Experience, Skills, and Knowledge?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
  • Experience with any of the following: MS Power BI, MS Report Builder, MS Power Automate, Azure Storage Explorer, Azure Blob Storage, Twilio
  • Experience in a project management role
  • Experience with reverse logistics, device trade-in market, omni-channel support
  • Experience setting up interdependent configurations across multiple applications
  • Experience setting up customer email and sms communications

title: Contractmanager
description:
Wil jij bij Dura Vermeer impact maken op het succes van onze projecten? Als contractmanager speel je een cruciale rol binnen de vakgroep contractmanagement en draag je bij aan het versterken en professionaliseren van het vakgebied, vanaf de tenderfase tot en met de realisatie binnen de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Als contractmanager maak je deel uit van de vakgroep contractmanagement, waarbij je een sleutelrol vervult. Je analyseert en adviseert over inschrijvingsstrategieën in de tenderfase en je zorgt ervoor dat deze adviezen worden geïmplementeerd in de uitvoering. Risicomanagement is een integraal onderdeel van je verantwoordelijkheden. Je voert contractbeoordelingen en risicoanalyses uit, waarbij je nauw samenwerkt met de collega's van andere vakgroepen. De focus van werkzaamheden ligt op het beheren en optimaliseren van contracten, inclusief naleving en relatiebeheer met contractpartijen.

Je bent onder andere verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Analyseren van contracten en vertalen naar een heldere contractstrategie.

  • Adviseren van tender- en projectteams bij keuzes en beheersing van contractuele risico’s.

  • Borgen en verbeteren van contractmanagementprocessen in projecten en samenwerking met het interne projectteam, opdrachtgevers en ketenpartners.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Dit breng jij mee

• Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding, bij voorkeur een technische of juridische richting.

• Relevante werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie.

• Gevorderde kennis van diverse contractvormen in de bouwwereld.

• Jij kunt uitstekend een projectteam begeleiden op het gebied van contractmanagement.

• Jij bent nauwkeurig, analytisch sterk en communicatief zeer vaardig.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen € 5.005,- en € 6.256,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring.

  • Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra).

  • Met oog op een langdurige relatie bieden we je direct een onbepaalde tijd contract.

  • 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

  • Een laptop en een smartphone.

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap.

  • Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card.

  • Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike.

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit.

  • Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland.

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical

  • Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

  • Voor de generatie die een studieschuld heeft opgebouwd tijdens het nieuwe leenstelsel is er een voordelige regeling voor de aflossing van studieschuld. Je kunt jaarlijks een bedrag van je brutosalaris inleggen om je studieschuld af te lossen. Dura Vermeer verdubbelt jouw inleg.

Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen?

Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteren kan direct via onze website middels de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature.

Meer weten?

Wil je meer weten over deze vacature? Neem dan contact op met recruiter Elvira Haksteen via 06 - 18 67 08 04 of e.haksteen@duravermeer.nl.

Bij Dura Vermeer werven en selecteren we onze kandidaten graag zonder de goedbedoelde hulp van ‘onderaannemers’. Bij acquisitie behouden we ons het recht voor om meerwerk in rekening te brengen.

title: Senior HR-Admin Executive
description:
The Senior HR & Admin Executive is responsible for overseeing daily HR and administrative operations, including payroll, compensation & benefits, recruitment, employee lifecycle management, labor law compliance, employee engagement, and office administration. This role works closely with management and employees to ensure effective HR services and a productive workplace environment.
- Monthly salary process, compensation & benefits, and statutory compliance.
- Coordinate recruitment, onboarding/ offboarding.
- Manage employee records, labor contracts, insurance, and HR administration.
- Support employee relations, engagement programs, and performance management.
- Ensure compliance with labor laws, company policies, and HR audits.
- Maintain HR systems, databases, and reports.
- Organize training and development programs.
- Handle office administration, company events, and vendor coordination.
- +4–>6 years of experience in HR operations/generalist roles.
- Strong knowledge of labor law, payroll, C&B, and HR administration.
- Experience with recruitment and employee relations.
- Rich experience working with and supporting a young workforce (Gen Z/Young Generation employees) is highly preferred.
- Proficient in HRIS and Microsoft Office.
- Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
- Detail-oriented, trustworthy, and able to handle confidential information.
- Good command of English is preferred.
- Working hours: Monday - Friday, Saturday morning (work from home)
- Competitive salary package based on qualifications and experience.
- Annual performance review and bonus opportunities.
- Full statutory benefits in accordance with Vietnam Labor Law and additional insurance (24/07) from Company.
- Professional, international, and collaborative working environment.
- Birthday, holiday, and special occasion gifts.
- Convenient office location and modern working facilities.
