title: Schadehersteller/ Plaatwerker
description:
Als Schadehersteller/ Plaatwerker ga jij aan de slag met trucks, lichte bedrijfswagens en trailers. In onze gloednieuwe, modern uitgeruste werkplaats herstel je schades en voer je uiteenlopende plaatwerkzaamheden uit. Je werkt met de nieuwste technieken, waaronder een moderne richtbank, en professioneel gereedschap waarmee je nauwkeurig en efficiënt te werk gaat.

Wat ga je doen?

Jouw werk is gevarieerd en technisch uitdagend. Je repareert en herstelt carrosserieën en cabines, waarbij je beschadigde onderdelen terugbrengt naar originele staat. Ook stel je complete carrosserieën, cabines en chassis uit, zodat alles weer naadloos aansluit en voldoet aan de fabrieksspecificaties. Bij deukschade zorg jij dat carrosserieën en plaatwerk nauwkeurig worden uitgedeukt en strak afgewerkt. Waar nodig vervang of vernieuw je carrosserieonderdelen en overige componenten.

Daarnaast maak jij voertuigen klaar voor het spuitproces. Je schuurt en prepareert oppervlakken zorgvuldig, zodat het lakwerk strak en duurzaam kan worden aangebracht. Met jouw oog voor detail en kwaliteitsgevoel lever je vakwerk waar je trots op mag zijn.

Je komt terecht in een hecht team van 25 specialisten, waar samenwerking, vakmanschap en een goede sfeer centraal staan. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat elk voertuig onze werkplaats weer in topconditie verlaat. Bij BAS Truck Center lever je vakwerk en ga je elke dag met een goed gevoel naar huis!

Wij bieden jou

  • Een salaris ruim boven CAO, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring;

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals pensioen en opleidingsmogelijkheden;

  • Flexibele werktijden in overleg;

  • Geen avond- of weekenddiensten;

  • Een gezellig, informeel team van 25 collega's met een fijne werksfeer;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden en volop kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Werken in een moderne werkplaats met de nieuwste technieken;

  • Een recent verbouwde kantine met alle gemakken;

  • Regelmatig gezellige borrels en teamuitjes.

  • Je hebt ervaring met schadeherstel én plaatwerken;

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor detail;

  • Je bent een teamspeler en houdt van een gezellige werkomgeving.

Wij zijn BAS!

BAS Group is een wereldwijd opererend familiebedrijf waarin verschillende gespecialiseerde BAS-bedrijven samenkomen. Met expertise in inkoop, verkoop, onderhoud, lease, verhuur en wagenparkbeheer bieden wij complete oplossingen voor transport en logistiek. Of het nu gaat om trucks, trailers, bedrijfswagens of bouw- en landbouwmachines, onze bedrijven versterken elkaar en helpen klanten vooruit met efficiënte en innovatieve dienstverlening.

Binnen BAS Group ga jij aan de slag bij BAS Truck Center. Als officieel Volvo en Renault Truck dealer staan we dagelijks klaar om transportondernemers te ondersteunen met onderhoud, reparaties en service voor alle merken trucks, trailers en lichte bedrijfswagens. In onze moderne, volledig papierloze werkplaatsen werken we met de nieuwste technieken en zetten we ons in voor kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid. Met een gedreven team zorgen we ervoor dat klanten snel en met een goed gevoel weer de weg op kunnen.

Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s willen we winnen op kwaliteit en vakmanschap en worden we elke dag een beetje beter. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop.

För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss på Skatteverket behöver du vara lyhörd, tänka nytt och ta ansvar. I arbetet är gott omdöme och förståelse för rättssäkerhet och säkerhet viktigt. Du ska också leva upp till vår medarbetarpolicy.

I det här jobbet ska du:

  • ha god samarbetsförmåga, vara hjälpsam och ha ett gott bemötande
  • ha förmågan och viljan att lära dig nya saker, vara flexibel och öppen för förändringar
  • ta initiativ, tänka nytt och ta ställning i frågor
  • självständigt planera och driva ditt arbete framåt för att nå resultat
  • uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska

Du ska även ha:

  • något års aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet virtualisering
  • arbetslivserfarenhet inom nätverk (routing och switching)
  • relevant erfarenhet av containerteknik

Det är önskvärt om du har erfarenhet VCF och Infrastructure as Code. Automation är även önskvärt.

Bra att veta

Anställningen är tillsvidare och kan inledas med provanställning i sex månader.

En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.

På skatteverket.se/jobb kan du exempelvis läsa om vår samhällsbärande roll, fördelarna med att jobba hos oss och hur det går till när du söker våra jobb.

När du ansöker bifogar du ditt cv. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar och du ska därför inte bifoga det i din ansökan.

Ansvariga kontaktpersoner har begränsad tillgänglighet under semesterperioden. Om du önskar komma i kontakt med någon av oss, maila oss gärna så hjälper vi dig vidare. Intervjuer planeras att genomföras under vecka 36 och 37.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Skatteverket har en samhällsbärande roll. Vårt arbete berör alla privatpersoner och företag och genom vårt uppdrag bidrar vi till ett väl fungerande samhälle. Vår utveckling är kunddriven och vi samverkar med andra för att skapa effektiva lösningar. Tillsammans gör vi samhället möjligt.

title: Head of UK Credit Control
location: Leeds, West Yorkshire, England, United Kingdom
description:
MegaGroup Logistic Services UK is part of MegaGroup Trade Holding, a network of technical wholesalers providing water solutions across 10+ locations in Europe.

Become our new Head of UK Credit Control!

Availability: Full-time
Location: Unit C Manston Ln, Leeds LS15 8AH, United Kingdom

Are you an experienced credit control leader who enjoys stepping into a hands-on role where you can make an immediate impact? Join us during an important growth and transition phase, where you will help shape the UK credit control function and support the finance team as we prepare to onboard additional businesses.

YOUR MISSION

MegaGroup Trade Holding is an international technical wholesaler specializing in water solutions that improve people’s lives. We take pride in addressing global water challenges and supporting sectors such as Irrigation, Livestock, Swimming pools, Building services, and industry.

Being a Head of UK Credit Control at MegaGroup Logistic Services UK, you will take ownership of credit control across four UK trading companies. You will work closely with the UK finance team across two sites, learn the systems and processes, and develop strategies to optimise collections, reduce overdue balances, and improve working capital. This is an important moment to join: you will come on the learning journey with the team, getting up to speed before additional businesses are onboarded, so you can help create structure and ensure the team is ready for the next phase. You will report directly to the Head of UK Finance and collaborate closely with Sales and Finance to balance commercial objectives with credit risk.

HOW YOU'LL DRIVE SUCCESS

  • Develop and implement the UK credit control strategy, policies, and ways of working across four trading companies.

  • Monitor customer accounts and drive timely payment of outstanding invoices.

  • Review aged debt reports, identify risks, and implement clear action plans to reduce overdue balances.

  • Assess customer creditworthiness and approve credit limits within delegated authority.

  • Manage escalated collection cases, disputes, and legal recovery processes when required.

  • Build strong relationships with customers, Sales, and Finance to resolve payment issues effectively.

  • Produce regular reporting on collections performance, debtor days, bad debt provisions, and cash flow forecasts.

  • Support the UK finance team during a period of business change by quickly learning current processes, identifying priorities, and helping create structure before additional businesses are onboarded.

  • Identify opportunities to improve credit control processes through automation, better reporting, and continuous improvement.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Extensive experience in credit control, ideally within a multi-entity or complex business environment.

  • Strong knowledge of credit risk assessment, collections management, aged debt reporting, and cash flow impact.

  • Excellent negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, with the ability to balance customer relationships and credit risk.

  • Analytical mindset with a practical, hands-on approach to problem solving and process improvement.

  • Confidence working with ERP (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) and Microsoft Excel.

  • Experience working with multiple currencies is desirable but not essential.

  • Alignment with our core values: Client Obsession – Execution Excellence – Teamwork – Enjoy Together.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • The salary range for this role is £37,500–£40,000 gross per year, depending on experience.

  • Independent, versatile role in an international organization.

  • Personal development and career growth opportunities.

  • Training and coaching support.

  • Supportive team celebrating successes together.

  • Market-competitive salary, bonus scheme, pension plan, and a fun work environment.

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?
Advance your career in a professional, friendly, and dynamic environment—apply now and become a key player in MegaGroup Logistic Services UK’s success as our Head of UK Credit Control!

title: Packaging Engineering Compliance Supervisor
description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

Job Description:

The Packaging Engineering Compliance Supervisor is responsible for leading compliance documentation and data management activities that support the Packaging Engineering team. This role is primarily task-focused, with accountability for executing and overseeing the collection, validation, tracking, and maintenance of packaging compliance data and documentation to meet regulatory and business requirements. In addition, the role includes limited people leadership responsibilities to coordinate daily team activities, monitor workload, and support team performance.

Key responsibilities include managing compliance initiatives related to PPWR, UK RAM, and other applicable packaging regulations and reporting requirements. The supervisor will coordinate supplier outreach, monitor supplier responses, and ensure compliance-related data submissions are complete, accurate, and submitted on time. This role is also responsible for tracking progress, identifying missing or incomplete information, escalating issues as needed, and driving closure of data gaps.

In addition, this position will oversee the review, update, and cleansing of packaging data in PLM and related systems as new or revised information becomes available. The supervisor will work closely with Packaging Engineering, suppliers, and cross-functional partners to improve data quality, maintain documentation accuracy, and support ongoing compliance efforts. From a people leadership perspective, this role will provide day-to-day direction to team members, help prioritize work, and support consistent execution of team objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance and Operational Responsibilities

  • Lead day-to-day compliance documentation activities for the Packaging Engineering team
  • Support regulatory reporting and data requirements, including PPWR, UK RAM, and other packaging-related regulations
  • Coordinate supplier outreach to request compliance-related packaging data and documentation
  • Track supplier responses and follow up to ensure timely completion of required submissions
  • Review, validate, and organize submitted compliance information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency
  • Identify, monitor, and drive closure of packaging data gaps in PLM and other tracking tools
  • Coordinate data cleansing and updates of existing packaging records as new information is collected
  • Maintain trackers, reports, dashboards, and status updates for compliance documentation progress
  • Support data analysis and reporting to monitor compliance status, completion rates, and key issues
  • Partner with Packaging Engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve documentation, system, and data quality issues
  • Escalate compliance risks, delays, or recurring issues to leadership as appropriate
  • Support process improvements to enhance data accuracy, documentation efficiency, and reporting effectiveness

Team Leadership Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day work direction and task coordination for team members supporting packaging compliance activities
  • Assign and prioritize work to ensure deadlines and business requirements are met
  • Monitor team progress and provide follow-up to maintain execution quality and timeliness
  • Support onboarding and training of new team members
  • Coach team members on documentation processes, data quality expectations, and follow-up practices
  • Serve as a first point of contact for routine questions, issue resolution, and work coordination within the team
  • Support people manager activities such as performance input, workload planning, and identification of development needs
  • Promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team

​

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Packaging, Supply Chain, Business, Data Management, or a related field
  • Experience in data analysis, documentation management, compliance operations, or related work
  • Experience coordinating work or providing day-to-day guidance to others in a team environment
  • Strong Excel skills, including data organization, formulas, sorting, filtering, lookup functions, and basic reporting
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling data and documentation
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities across several workstreams
  • Good follow-up, problem-solving, and issue-tracking skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with suppliers and cross-functional teams
  • Experience working with PLM, SAP, or similar systems is an advantage
  • Background in packaging, regulatory compliance, or product data management is preferred

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting packaging compliance or regulatory data collection
  • Familiarity with packaging-related regulations such as PPWR, UK RAM, or similar requirements
  • Experience in data cleansing, gap analysis, and documentation tracking
  • Ability to analyze data trends and provide clear status reporting
  • Prior experience in a lead, coordinator, or supervisor-level role
  • Experience driving process improvement in documentation or compliance-related workflows

By providing testing support and delivering tools that streamline the testing process, you will directly impact the speed and quality of delivering business solutions.

Important things for you:

#goodtobehere means that:

Send us your CV and... see you at Allegro!

This is the right job for you if:

  • Have basic practical experience or strong foundational knowledge of Java and backend automation libraries/frameworks (e.g., REST Assured, JUnit, TestNG).

  • Are eager to continuously develop your skills in a modern Java backend environment.
  • Know English and Polish at B2 level or higher.

title: Commercial Pricing Analyst
description:
Fixed-term contract available immediately through to March 2027.

As a Commercial Pricing Analyst at TMS Global, part of DS Smith, you'll play a key role in supporting profitable growth across a diverse international customer portfolio. Working with stakeholders across EMEA, APAC, LATAM and North America, you'll transform complex commercial data into actionable insights, influence pricing strategy and support critical decision-making that drives business performance and long-term customer value.

Working closely with Sales, Procurement and Commercial Finance teams, you'll develop benchmarking models and provide commercial analysis to support contract renewals, RFP activity, raw material indexation and strategic pricing decisions across our global business.

Key Responsibilities:

Commercial Strategy & Planning

  • Analyse customer and supplier pricing data to provide actionable insights and support informed commercial decision making.
  • Ensure pricing decisions align with margin objectives, customer agreements and overall commercial strategy.
  • Monitor raw material indices and market trends, providing insight and recommendations on potential pricing impacts.
  • Identify opportunities to improve pricing performance, operational efficiency and commercial effectiveness.

Process & Systems Optimization

  • Drive automation initiatives and process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy and scalability across commercial operations.
  • Manage the implementation of contract events within internal systems, including contract anniversaries and raw material index (RMI) adjustments.
  • Develop, enhance and maintain pricing models, ensuring effective deployment and adoption across the business.

Internal Support & Governance

  • Partner with implementation and account teams on contract execution, onboarding and pricing-related issue resolution.
  • Provide data management, pricing administration and commercial policy support to sales and finance teams.
  • Equip Operations and Shared Service teams with tools and guidance to ensure accurate product pricing.
  • Ensure adherence to internal controls and commercial governance processes, reporting any identified risks to senior management.

About You

This role would suit someone who thrives in a fast-paced, matrix environment and enjoys collaborating across teams and geographies. You’ll bring strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

The ideal candidate will have experience in the following areas:

  • A background in the Packaging industry, with Print experience is essential.
  • Proven experience within pricing and commercial analytics
  • Strong experience developing and maintaining pricing models and analytical tools.
  • Strong understanding of commercial pricing methodologies, supply chain dynamics and operational delivery.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering across commercial, finance and operational teams.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including modelling and data analysis.
  • Experience using Power BI or similar visualisation tools would be advantageous.

If this role sounds like an exciting opportunity and you believe you have the skills and experience to succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

Our people come from diverse backgrounds, bring different perspectives, ideas and experiences to generate unique solutions focused on present and future sustainability challenges. We welcome all candidates to apply, even those not meeting all criteria.”

title: Verkort leertraject tot begeleider in de gehandicaptenzorg
description:
Wil jij een carrièreswitch maken naar de gehandicaptenzorg en wil je van betekenis zijn voor onze cliënten? Dan is dit verkorte leertraject misschien iets voor jou.

Als een volledige mbo-opleiding niet goed past bij jouw situatie, kan dit verkorte leertraject een goede keuze zijn. Binnen maximaal anderhalf jaar behaal je branche-erkende mbo-certificaten die nodig zijn om bij Cordaan te werken als ondersteunend begeleider of begeleider. Zo leer je wat je nodig hebt om goed en verantwoord te werken. Dit leertraject leidt niet op tot een volledig mbo-diploma en is geen BBL-opleiding.

Om mee te kunnen doen aan dit leertraject, heb je minimaal een mbo 2-diploma nodig. Ook als je een andere opleidingsachtergrond hebt op mbo-, hbo- of wo-niveau, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren.

Wat krijg je van ons?
Je arbeidsvoorwaarden vallen onder de cao Gehandicaptenzorg (FWG 35 of FWG 40). Cordaan vergoedt de kosten van het leertraject volledig. Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een verkort leertraject van maximaal anderhalf jaar (afhankelijk van aantal certificaten);

  • Een startdatum en contractomvang (24-32 uur per week) in overleg;

  • Een contract voor de duur van jouw leertraject met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;

  • Een salaris van €2.597,- tot €3.902,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 36 uur), afhankelijk van werkervaring en competenties, ook buiten de zorg;

  • Onregelmatigheidstoeslag;

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en 8% vakantietoeslag;

  • Een fietsplan en fietsreparatievergoeding;

  • Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Draag je een collega aan? Dan ontvang je een netto aanbrengbonus van €500.

Hoe ziet het traject eruit?
Op basis van jouw kennis, vaardigheden, ervaring, diploma's, sollicitatiegesprekken, meeloopdiensten en een talentanalyse stellen we jouw persoonlijke leertraject vast en het aantal te behalen certificaten.

We vinden het fijn als je minimaal één maand vóór de start van het leertraject begint, zodat je Cordaan, je team en je werkomgeving alvast leert kennen. Het eerstvolgende startmoment van dit leertraject is op 10 november. Tijdens het traject volg je wekelijks een lesdag en besteed je daarnaast tijd aan zelfstudie. Je wordt begeleid door een vaste werkbegeleider.

Wat ga je doen?
Je werkt op een van de locaties van Cordaan. Als (ondersteunend) begeleider ondersteun je cliënten vanuit hun individuele zorg- en begeleidingsvragen. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • ADL-zorg, zoals wassen, aankleden en ondersteunen bij eten en drinken;

  • Samen met collega's uit andere disciplines werken aan ontwikkeldoelen van cliënten;

  • Werken volgens een persoonlijk ondersteuningsplan;

  • Professionele begeleiding bieden, gericht op een zo gewoon mogelijk leven voor cliënten.

Wie ben jij?
Je hebt hart voor de zorg, bent sociaal vaardig, leergierig en staat stevig in je schoenen. Daarnaast:

  • Heb je minimaal 6 jaar relevante werk- en/of levenservaring (niet per se in de zorg);

  • Beschik je over minimaal mbo-2 werk- en denkniveau of heb je een mbo-, hbo- of wo opleidingsachtergrond;

  • Ben je bereid een intensief leertraject te volgen;

  • Ben je bereid ADL-zorg te verlenen;

  • Ben je flexibel inzetbaar voor avond-, weekend- en nachtdiensten;

  • Beheers je de Nederlandse taal minimaal op B1-niveau. Dit is noodzakelijk voor de lessen, voor het contact met cliënten en collega’s en voor het lezen en schrijven van rapportages.

  • Beschik je over een eigen laptop en ben je digitaal vaardig.

Enthousiast?
Solliciteer direct online. Voor vragen kun je contact opnemen met Eliza Khalil via ekhalil@cordaan.nl of 06-14307315, of met Tim Huider via thuider@cordaan.nl of 06-14307319. Controleer na je sollicitatie altijd of je een ontvangstbevestiging hebt ontvangen, ook in je spamfolder.

Kleurrijk en betekenisvol met elkaar
Cordaan vindt inclusiviteit belangrijk. We waarderen verschillen, stimuleren talentontwikkeling en streven naar een organisatie waarin cliënten en medewerkers zich herkennen. Daarom zetten we ons actief in voor een goede vertegenwoordiging van mensen met diverse achtergronden.

title: Chief Trades Supervisor
description:
About Our Job

Note: This job posting is open to current City and County of Denver employees ONLY and employees, including those impacted by the 2025 layoffs.

With competitive pay, great benefits, and endless opportunities, working for the City and County of Denver (CCD) means seeing yourself working with purpose — for you, and those who benefit from your passion, skills and expertise. Join our diverse, inclusive and talented workforce of more than 11,000 team members who are at the heart of what makes Denver, Denver. Click here to find out about all the amazing benefits and reasons to work for CCD!

What We Offer

The City and County of Denver offers a competitive salary commensurate with education and experience. The salary range for this position is $80,217 – $132,358 annually. Hiring pay will be based on qualifications, experience, and the City's pay policies. We also offer generous benefits for full-time employees which include but are not limited to:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance (effective within 1 month of start date, City pays majority of premiums)

  • Pension Plan for Life (Employee contributes 8.45%, Employer matches 17.95%)

  • 457 (b) Retirement Plan (no early withdrawal fee!)

  • PTO (over 3 weeks in your first year) and 14 paid holidays

  • Merit Increases

  • STD, LTD, HSA, FSA, Life Insurance

  • CARE Bank, Family Leave Benefits

  • Employee Assistance Program, Employee Volunteer Program

  • Tuition Reimbursement (up to $2000/year), We Qualify for Student Loan Forgiveness Program

  • Learning and Development Opportunities; Courses and Career Development Resources

  • EcoPass (unlimited free RTD bus/train rides)

Location & Schedule

This position is based at the Wellington E. Webb Municipal Building, located at 201 W. Colfax Ave., Denver, CO 80202. This position is not eligible for a hybrid work schedule. Employees are expected to work on-site five (5) days per week. Work is performed at the Webb Municipal Building and at construction sites throughout the City and County of Denver as business needs require. The normal work schedule is Monday through Friday, 6:30 a.m. – 3:00 p.m., although occasional alternative hours may be required.

The selected candidate must provide their own vehicle to perform field inspections. Mileage is paid in accordance with the standard IRS rate.

Please note: Downtown parking expenses are the responsibility of the employee. We offer a flexible spending account option specifically for parking; if you choose this option, you can use pretax dollars for parking. We also offer an RTD ‘eco pass’ to all City employees– allowing the use of public transportation for free as a City Employee.

Who We Are & What You’ll Do

BUILDING COMMUNITY: Denver Community Planning and Development is responsible for visionary city planning and ensuring safe, responsible, sustainable building. CPD regulates planning, zoning, development and maintenance of private property in Denver. We're working hard to make Denver a great place to live, work and play! Visit DenverGov.org/CPD.

The City and County of Denver's Community Planning and Development Department (CPD) is seeking an experienced and collaborative Chief Trades Supervisor to lead Construction Trades Inspectors responsible for enforcing the Denver Building Code and applicable International Codes. This position provides technical leadership, employee development, operational oversight, and official code interpretation while supporting safe construction and exceptional customer service throughout Denver.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Consults with architects, engineers, contractors, departmental supervisors, and others to provide official building code interpretation and coordinates inspections and projects with other city agencies and/or state and federal agencies

  • Serves on code committees and panels, originates amendments to code, and recommends adoption of standards

  • Supervises the training of inspection personnel in technical inspection procedures and advises and assists subordinates with difficult technical inspections. Keeps informed of new technical developments and trade practices and recommends improved inspection methods and amendments to existing code regulations

  • Implements safety standards and develops procedures to ensure compliance

  • Develops or modifies work plans, methods, and procedures, determines work priorities, and develops work schedules to provide adequate staff coverage

  • Assigns and distributes work, reviews work for accuracy and completeness, and returns assignments with recommendations for proper completion

  • Resolves problems encountered during daily operations and determines standards for problem resolution

  • Develops the performance enhancement plan, documents performance, provides performance feedback, and formally evaluates the work of employees

  • Responds to formal and informal employee grievances and prepares a written response.

  • Documents cause for disciplinary action and initiates letters of reprimand and formal recommendations for disciplinary action.

  • Comply with standard safety rules and procedures common to the trade.

What You’ll Bring

We value diversity of ethnicity, race, socioeconomic status, sexual identity, gender, religion, language, ability, and experience, and we believe those diverse perspectives strengthen our team and the services we provide to the Denver community.

Our ideal candidate has experience, skills, and characteristics that include:

  • Demonstrated leadership, coaching, and employee development with the ability to build and lead high-performing teams.

  • Extensive knowledge of construction inspection practices, building codes, construction methods, plan review, and code enforcement.

  • Experience inspecting construction projects to ensure compliance with the Denver Building Code and applicable International Codes.

  • Experience investigating construction and code complaints, interpreting code requirements, and recommending appropriate corrective or enforcement actions.

  • Strong technical judgment with the ability to consistently interpret and apply building codes while resolving complex technical and operational issues.

  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and customer service skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with inspectors, contractors, design professionals, property owners, and partner agencies.

  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities, make sound decisions under pressure, and develop practical solutions to complex problems.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accountability and continuous improvement.

  • Proficiency with standard business software and the ability to quickly learn department-specific systems, including permit tracking and document management applications.

  • Ability to read, interpret, and navigate construction plans, specifications, blueprints, and other technical documents.

Required Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Graduation from high school or the possession of a GED, HiSET or TASC Certificate.

  • Experience: Three (3) years of experience working as an inspector in the specific trade area.

  • Education/Experience Equivalency: A combination of appropriate education and experience may be substituted for the minimum education and experience requirements

  • This job requires driving. Requires a valid Driver's License at the time of application

  • Possession of specific trades licenses and/or certifications listed below at the time of application depending on the opening

  • Construction: (Must possess at least two of the listed certifications.)

    • International Code Council Certification as a Building Inspector

    • International Code Council Certification as a Residential Combination Inspector

    • International Code Council Certification as a Commercial Inspector

    • International Code Council Certification as a General Contractor

    • Supervisor Certificate – Construction A issued by the City and County of Denver

  • Additional licenses or certifications that are legally required to perform a specific position's duties and responsibilities may be required at the time of application or by the end of probation (or within 6 months of hire) depending on the staffing needs of the hiring department or agency

  • Licensure in another state with reciprocity may be accepted in lieu of this requirement, provided that the applicant has Colorado licensure at completion of probation

Application Deadline

title: Engineer, Web Apps
description:
Join Notability and shape the future of learning. We’re building the next generation of tools designed not just to capture notes, but to fundamentally improve how people learn, think, and collaborate. Our app brings the natural expressiveness of paper into the digital age, empowering millions of students, educators, and professionals worldwide to organize their ideas, deepen their understanding, and achieve their goals. Our mission is simple: we help you learn.


As part of our team, you’ll help create experiences driven by empathy, exceptional design, and the belief that great ideas can come from anywhere—including you. Come help us make learning better for everyone.

With Notability Web, users on any web-capable platform can collaboratively author, capture, and import dynamic content in real-time, then learn, review, and master the content using our AI study tools. Notability has remained a top-seller in the App Store in the years since its debut, and is used by millions of passionate, active users.

We’re seeking an early-career software engineer to join us in evolving the Notability web app. We direct AI coding tools daily, and our craft heavily involves specifying problems clearly, reviewing critically, and owning outcomes. You'll be part of a team building value and delight for our users through rapid iteration, sound judgment, and clear, generous communication.

Your responsibilities

  • Communicate clearly, concisely and proactively in writing, conversation and use of AI: crisp problem statements and messages, readable PR descriptions, well-timed questions, honest status
  • Drive your work to completion: you find a way around ambiguity, review feedback, and edge cases
  • Ship stable, readable, well-tested code serving efficient and delightful user experiences
  • Jump into unfamiliar areas to solve tough problems
  • Operate with respect for the ideas, victories, mistakes, and time of your collaborators
  • Take in feedback from mentors and peers to continuously self-improve
  • Bring ideas and opinions: balance product and tech needs through open collaboration

Requirements

  • Clear, concise communication, written and verbal: you make complex things simple for the people around you, and teammates are energized by working with you
  • Good judgment, and ownership of outcomes rather than tasks
  • Genuine care for the people you work with: you build trust, give and receive feedback well, and treat collaboration as the job rather than an interruption to it
  • Evidence you've shipped something real, professionally or on your own
  • Comfort reading and reasoning about React, TypeScript, and modern web code
  • Solid grasp of web fundamentals (browser, network, async behavior, application state)
  • Daily fluency with AI coding tools
  • Demonstrated curiosity: something you built, wrote, or figured out on your own initiative

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Redux or similar global state management
  • Experience with canvas/WebGL, or rendering engines e.g. Three.js or PixiJS
  • Knowledge of web performance optimization techniques
  • Experience building with LLM APIs, agents, or AI-assisted developer workflows
  • Writing, teaching or learning in public via a blog, repo, etc

For this position we are targeting a base pay between $120,000-$175,000. Actual compensation offered will be determined by factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

This role follows a hybrid model, with a minimum of two days onsite at our downtown San Francisco office and flexibility to work remotely from home the rest of the week.

How We Work

Each member of our team contributes to all parts of our products. We trust each other to make decisions independently while also considering our common goals and values. We share ideas openly, and we collaborate across disciplines to ensure that our decisions make sense from all perspectives.

When We Work

We actively promote work-life balance. Our schedules are flexible, our hybrid policy supports remote work when it makes sense, and we have a “as long as you get your work done” approach to time off.

Why You'd Love Working Here

We work in downtown SF near Market Street, just a short walk from two BART/Muni stations. Our office has height-adjustable desks to help us stay limber, spacious conference rooms for both small and large team meetings, and a well-stocked kitchen full of goodies to enjoy :). Our team is growing, collaborative and down to earth. We want everyone to do their best work and find passion in what they do.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation that includes base salary, bonuses and profit sharing
  • Equity Awards in the form of Stock Options
  • Comprehensive healthcare fully covered for you and your family including medical, dental, and vision
  • Flexible work and vacation schedules
  • 401k with matching contributions
  • Matching gifts to nonprofits
  • Lunch Stipend (When Working from HQ)

Intake Care Representative- Evernorth (Infusion/Enteral)

Make a Meaningful Difference in Patient Care

At CarepathRx, part of Evernorth Health Services, we are ambitious, compassionate experts dedicated to advancing specialty pharmacy and infusion services. As an Intake Care Representative, you will be a trusted first point of contact for patients, providers, hospitals, and referral partners. This role involves handling inbound calls from patients, helping them navigate the referral and intake process while ensuring accurate information is collected and care can begin without delay. If you are organized, compassionate, and thrive in a customer-focused healthcare environment, we encourage you to apply.

Hours: Monday-Friday 9am-6pm EST, rotating shift (some weekend/holiday coverage 8am-4:30pm EST)

• Help patients understand next steps, gather required information, and connect them with the appropriate care teams to support a positive patient experience.

• Handle inbound and outbound communication with patients, providers, hospitals, physician offices, and healthcare facilities regarding referrals and care coordination.

• Facilitate the accurate transfer of insurance information to Insurance Verification teams.

• Deliver exceptional service to internal and external customers while maintaining patient confidentiality.

• Contribute to a collaborative, team-oriented environment focused on quality, accuracy, and patient-centered care.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

• Strong organizational skills and commitment to providing excellent customer service.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive patient information appropriately.

title: Principal Engineer, Application Platforms – Head of Engineering
description:
The CTO Platform Engineering & Architecture (CTOp) organisation sits within the Chief Technology Office (CTO) and is responsible for building next-gen application and AI platforms that remove toil and reduce operational overhead through integrated controls and open-source solutions – making software delivery faster, safer, and more reliable every time. CTOp also sets architecture and engineering standards, builds core application, developer and AI platforms, and automates controls so teams can move code (or containers) to production quickly and consistently.

The Principal Engineer, Application Platforms – Head of Engineering is a hands-on role accountable for engineering leadership, delivery execution, and control outcomes for Application Platform Engineering, working in close partnership with the Head of Application Platforms. The role provides end-to-end ownership, ensuring strategy is translated into an actionable roadmap, priorities are governed transparently, and delivery is executed predictably with clear measures of success.

The expectation is that candidates will be comb-shaped – capable of handling the big picture architecture, whilst simultaneously leading by example with hands-on code and implementation where needed. A core focus of the role is to accelerate adoption of the standard application platform, targeting ~80% application migration, and to lead the consolidation of six hosting platforms into a simplified, resilient, and well-controlled estate. This includes establishing consistent engineering patterns, strengthening observability and operational readiness, and embedding automated run controls to reduce operational risk, improve resilience, and increase time-to-market. The role sets and enforces measurable engineering standards, drives continuous improvement, and ensures platform outcomes meet the needs of application teams and the wider technology organisation.

title: Lähihoitaja, Keravan arviointi- ja kuntoutusyksikkö Helmi ja Miina
description:
Vammaisten ja vanhusten palvelujen toimiala, Hoiva-asumisen palvelut
Keravan arviointi- ka kuntoutusyksikkö Helmi ja Miina
Metsolantie 2 , 04200 Kerava

Me VAKEssa rakennamme yhdessä rohkeasti hyvinvointialuetta, johon asukkaamme voivat luottaa. Haluamme olla vakaa edelläkävijä, joka uudistaa toimintaa avoimesti ja ihmislähtöisesti. Arvomme oikeudenmukaisuus, vastuullisuus ja rohkeus ohjaavat arjen työtämme. Tunnistatko näistä myös omat arvosi?

Tule sinäkin Hyvantekijät-joukkueeseemme!

Miltä kuulostaisi lähihoitajan vakituinen tehtävä Keravan arviointi- ja kuntoutusyksikkö Miinassa?

Arviointi- ja kuntoutusyksikkö Miinassa kartoitetaan asiakkaan toimintakykyä laaja-alaisesti ja moniammatillisesti. Jakson aikana asiakkaita tuetaan ja autetaan päivittäisissä toimissa ja elämisen hallinnassa sekä huomioidaan kuntouttava työote. Tavoitteena on asiakkaiden kotiutuminen. Jakson pituus on keskimäärin yksi kuukausi. Yksikössä on asiakaspaikkoja 36.

Lähihoitajan työ on monipuolista, pääset perushoidon lisäksi toteuttamaan lääkehoitoa ja tekemään erilaisia toimintakykyarvioita. Yhteistyö asiakkaiden ja heidän läheisten kanssa on päivittäistä. Toimit osana moniammatillista tiimiä, jossa työpanostasi arvostetaan. Tässä tehtävässä pääset hyödyntämään jo sinulla olemassa olevaa osaamista sekä oppimaan lisää.

Arvostamme positiivista ja asiakaslähtöistä asennetta työntekoon sekä aitoa kiinnostusta työskennellä ikäihmisten parissa.

Toivomme, että suhtaudut myönteisesti toiminnan kehittämiseen ja uskallat rohkeasti tuoda ideoitasi esiin! Edellytämme hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja. Suomen kielen suullisen ja kirjallisen taidon tulee olla hyvä, sillä suullinen ja kirjallinen viestintä on hyvin merkittävässä osassa yksikön arjessa.

Meidän tiimissämme työskentelee sairaanhoitajia, fysioterapeutteja, toimintaterapeutti, toiminnanohjaaja, lähihoitajia, hoiva-avustajia ja hoitoapulaisia sekä lähijohtaja ja apulaisosastonhoitaja.

Työyhteisömme on iloinen ja energinen joukko osaajia. Meille on tärkeää työssä viihtyvyys ja työnteko saa olla hauskaa. Meillä persoonasi ja erityisosaamisesi saa näkyä.

Arviointi- ja kuntoutusyksiköt sijaitsevat hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella terveysaseman tiloissa Keravalla. Käytössämme on maksuton pysäköinti työntekijöillemme.

Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian. Varmista haastattelukutsu kattavalla hakemuksella, missä kerrot koulutuksestasi, työkokemuksesta ja osaamisestasi!

Miksi Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue?

Meillä hyvinvointi ja arjen sujuvuus ovat aidosti tärkeitä. Tarjoamme lounasedun sekä 300 euron Epassi-edun liikuntaan, kulttuuriin, hyvinvointiin tai työmatkoihin. Lisäksi hyvinvointiasi tukevat lakisääteiset työterveyspalvelumme.

Olemme ihmisläheinen organisaatio, jossa kehitämme toimintaa rohkeasti ja yhdessä. Meillä johtaminen on lupaus selkeistä tavoitteista, arvostavasta kohtaamisesta ja rohkeasta yhdessä uudistamisesta.

Saat selkeän näkymän omaan työhösi sekä mahdollisuuksia kokeilla ja kehittää uusia tapoja tehdä työtä. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia myös oman osaamisesi vahvistamiseen ja urasi kehittämiseen. Teemme merkityksellistä työtä joka päivä: autamme, hoidamme ja pelastamme.

title: Change Management Lead - People Technology
description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

WPP is undertaking a major global People Technology transformation to deploy Workday HCM across the organisation, simplifying the People landscape, improving data consistency, strengthening core People capabilities, and enabling scalable adoption of AI- and data-led insights.
The move from multiple local HR systems to a centrally governed global platform represents a significant shift in ways of working across markets, functions, and agencies.

We are seeking an experienced Change Lead to drive adoption, communication, and change delivery across our global People Technology landscape, with a particular focus on Workday Core HCM, Talent Acquisition and Payroll. This role will play a critical part in ensuring successful deployment and adoption of global solutions through structured change management, stakeholder engagement, and scalable frameworks.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead change management activities across Workday Core HCM, Talent Acquisition, and Payroll.
  • Create engaging communication and adoption plans that support colleagues through change.
  • Partner with business leaders, HR teams, and programme stakeholders to build awareness, readiness, and engagement.
  • Develop practical change frameworks, toolkits, and playbooks that can be used across the organisation.
  • Support training, business readiness, and post-go-live adoption to ensure lasting success.

What you'll need:

  • Experience leading change, communication, or adoption activities within HR, People Technology, or Workday transformation programmes.
  • Knowledge of Workday Core HCM, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, or similar enterprise HR platforms.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and influence at all levels.
  • Excellent communication skills and a talent for turning complex change into clear, engaging messages.
  • A collaborative mindset and passion for helping people navigate change successfully.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Information Security Manager
description:
We built our speech-to-text engine to understand every voice, in every accent, in every language, across customers who trust us with their audio and their data. That same care extends to how we protect that data and our own systems, and that's where you come in. We're hiring an Information Security Manager to make sure the rigour we put into understanding speech is matched by the rigour we put into keeping it safe.

What you'll do

  • Leading security triage as the first port of call, assessing new CVEs, vulnerabilities and supply-chain risk against our real infrastructure, not just a checklist.
  • Running hands-on audits covering pen testing, vulnerability management, supply-chain security, bringing technical judgement, not just policy references.
  • Owning our governance, risk and compliance frameworks, and keeping them honest, turning policy into controls that actually work at the infrastructure and code level.
  • Automating the parts of GRC that don't need a human (vulnerability tooling, endpoint protection rollout, policy-to-enforcement mapping), so the function scales without the busywork.
  • Building real product and infrastructure knowledge, so you become the person people come to, not the person who has to go find someone else.

What you'll bring

  • A technical background you can back up: Computer Science, Information Security, or similar, plus real experience in cybersecurity or IT security management.
  • CISSP or CISM (or equivalent depth of experience). We care more about the substance than the letters.
  • A track record in incident management and governance, risk and control frameworks, ideally somewhere that also demanded technical credibility, not just process.
  • The confidence to say "that policy doesn't reflect how this actually works", and the technical grounding to be right.
  • A bias toward automating and simplifying, not toward adding another layer of sign-off.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.

Who we are:

Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.

Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.

We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.

This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…

What we can offer you:

No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.

We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.

At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there.

That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are. We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity status.

But we don’t just open the door to diversity – we actively welcome it. Why? Because we believe every unique voice adds something special to our team, leading us to smarter solutions and a better workplace.

So, come as you are and join our Speechling community. We’re building a place where every voice not only gets heard but is also respected and valued.

For more information on us, please visit our website and follow Speechmatics on our social channels via Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

description:

Olemme energiainfran yhdistävä tekijä, joka auttaa hankkeen kaikkia osapuolia saavuttamaan yhteisesti asetetut tavoitteet turvallisesti ja tehokkaasti. Työtämme ohjaavia arvoja ovat vastuullisuus, luotettavuus ja avoimuus. Tutkimme ja kokeilemme jatkuvasti uusia toimintamalleja ja työkaluja, joiden avulla voimme kehittää asiakkaidemme toimintaa ja toimialoja.

Autamme asiakkaitamme hankkeen koosta ja sijainnista riippumatta. Räätälöimme palvelumme aina asiakkaalle sopivaksi kokonaisuudeksi, mutta saat apuamme myös yksittäisiin asiantuntijatehtäviin. sitema.fi

Sitema kasvaa ja etsii nyt SÄHKÖVERKKOJEN SUUNNITTELIJAA/ PÄÄSUUNNITTELIJAA!

Tässä roolissa pääset mukaan rakentamaan kestävämpää ja toimintavarmempaa sähköjärjestelmää osana asiantuntevaa tiimiämme kansainvälistyvässä markkinassa!

Tärkeimmät työtehtäväsi

  • Sähköverkon voimajohtoprojektien teknisten ratkaisujen määritteleminen, projektin suunnittelutiimin töiden tukeminen ja projektien laadukkaasta suunnittelukokonaisuudesta vastaaminen

  • Projektikokonaisuuden teknisestä sisällöstäja suunnitelmien laadusta vastaaminen

  • Osallistuminen tarjouslaskentaan ja projektiaikataulun laadintaan

  • Sovittujen aikataulujen noudattaminen yhteistyössä projektipäälliköiden kanssa

  • Asiakkaalle lähtevän materiaalin laadusta huolehtiminen

  • Toimia projektipäällikkönä tai hänen varahenkilönä sovittaessa

  • Kyky toimia ryhmässä ja ohjata suunnittelutyötä

  • Uusien asiakkuuksien hankinta yhdessä myynnin ja markkinoinnin kanssa

Toivomme sinulta

  • Sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta sähkönsiirron projektien suunnittelu-, luvitus-, ja/tai rakentamistöistä 0,4 - 400 kV jännitealueilla. Painottuen 110-400kV jännitealueelle.

  • Hyviä yhteistyökykytaitoja, toimit sujuvasti asiakasrajapinnassa

  • Hallitset kokonaisuudet ja osaat priorisoida

  • Olet riittävän tarkka ja järjestelmällinen

Tartu tilaisuuteen!

  • Sitemalla yhdistyvät vastuu ja vapaus – luotamme asiantuntijoihimme ja annamme tilaa itsenäiselle tekemiselle. Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen, osaavan työyhteisön tuen sekä mahdollisuuden kasvaa osana suomalaisen energiainfran kehityksen kärkeä.

  • Sitema Oy on saanut Arvostettu työpaikka® sertifikaatin ja meille henkilöstö- ja asiakastyytyväisyys on toiminnan kulmakiviä.

  • Olemme laajasti mukana erilaisissa sähköverkon hankkeissa aina voimajohtojen saneerauksista uusiin datakeskushankkeisiin, joten pääset näkemään ja tekemään laajasti energia-alan aallon harjalla.

  • Käytössämme on etätyömalli ja toimipisteitä ympäri Suomen kuten Espoossa, Tampereella, Seinäjoella, Oulussa, Kuopiossa, Raumalla, Kajaanissa ja Joensuussa.

Paikka täytetään heti, kun sopiva tekijä löytyy! Tiedustelut tehtävään liittyen: milena.rahi@reqruitz.com

title: Erfaren ServiceNow plattforms utvecklare
description:
Är du en erfaren ServiceNow utvecklare som också har erfarenhet av att operativt leda ett team? Då har du hittat rätt.

Kund söker efter en erfaren ServiceNow utvecklare som också har erfarenhet av att operativt leda ett team. Kund arbetar med plattformens genomgripande hälsa, integrationer, CMDB/CSDM, Employee Center, Performance/platform analytics och tillsammans med kollegor agera som stöd till övriga förvaltningar inom ServiceNow området. Plattformen används av över 20.000 medarbetare. Kundens mål är att skapa värdefulla och enkla interaktioner för alla dessa användare. Kundens förvaltning- och utvecklingsteam är geografiskt spridda och baserade på produktareor.

Några av arbetsuppgifterna

• Skapa och förvalta Business rules, Client script, Script includes, ACL, Integrationer mm.

• Analysera krav och omsätta till tekniska specifikationer

• Delta i workshops och dialoger med verksamhet/kund

• Delta i arkitekturdiskussioner i syfte att bygga långsiktiga lösningar

• Planera och analysera operativa och utvecklingsaktiviteter teamet behöver göra.

• Delta i roadmapsarbete

• Förstå verksamheten och kunna omsätta och estimera till lösningar i servicenow

Konsultens profil

Konsulten kommer att utmanas av komplexa frågeställningar, förväntas samarbeta och skapa värdefull utveckling för Kunden.

Då kund arbetar agilt är det viktigt att man trivs med det arbetssättet, tar egna initiativ och är hjälpsam och serviceminded. Att ha ett analytiskt sinne, samt vara naturligt nyfiken på teknik och inneha förmågan att arbeta både med detaljer och ett helhetsperspektiv värdesätts.

Uppdraget är på cirka 6 månader med möjlighet till förlängning. Placering: Solna.

Krav

• Minst 9 års erfarenhet inom aktuellt området på heltid (mycket djup/hög kompetens eller generalist kompetens)

• Gedigen erfarenhet av utveckling i ServiceNow plattformen

• Relevant akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet

• Genomfört uppgradering av ServiceNow

• Implementerat ServiceNow eller någon av dess moduler

• Javascript

• CSDM & CMDB

• Arbetat med förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering

• Bred erfarenhet från integrationer

• Haft workshops och dialog med verksamhet/kund

• Erfarenhet av att leda ett team operativt

• Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift

Meriterande

• Har erfarenhet med arbete av On-prem / Self-hosted

• Certifikat inom ServiceNow (exempelvis: Certified System Administrator (CSA)

• Certified Application Developer (CAD), Certified Implementation Specialist etc)

Kan detta vara ett uppdrag som passar dig?

Sök redan i dag eller kontakta oss så berättar vi gärna mer. Vi behöver en ansökan inkluderat CV och personligt brev på svenska som matchar vår kunds krav. Kunden kan fatta beslut tidigare än sista ansökningsdatum, urval och intervjuer sker löpande. NXT Interim och NXT Rekrytering är ett nischat och innovativt företag som är verksamma inom konsult och rekryteringsbranschen.

Vi är verksamma inom HR, IT, Ekonomi, Sälj och Marknad och har över 20 års erfarenhet i branschen. Vi erbjuder våra konsulter bl.a sjukförsäkring, remote-arbetsplatser och flera andra förmåner som förgyller deras vardag. Vid anställning tillämpar vi kollektivavtal.

title: Wandelvrijwilliger: Samen in beweging
description:
Lekker in de buitenlucht bewegen, échte verbinding maken én de avond gezellig afsluiten met een drankje: dat is onze wandelclub in het kort

Onze bewoners hebben een lichte verstandelijke beperking, zijn redelijk zelfstandig en kijken elke keer weer uit naar dit moment. Het is een warme en enorm hechte club waar iedereen zichzelf mag zijn. We lopen op ons eigen tempo, houden rekening met elkaar en zijn altijd in voor een goed gesprek of een grapje.

  • Samen met de groep loop je een mooie route van ongeveer 3 kilometer (circa 1 uur)

  • Samen met vrijwilligers Jan en Peter bedenk je leuke routes over de Binckhorst of in de buurt.

  • Na afloop drinken jullie samen een drankje bij Café de Boulevard.

Praktisch:

  • Om de week op dinsdagavond.

  • We verzamelen om 18.45 uur en wandelen van 19.00 tot 20.00 uur

  • Om 20.00 sluiten we af met een lekker drankje en kletsen we nog even na

  • Jij wandelt graag

  • Houdt van een praatje en hebt échte aandacht voor onze bewoners.

  • Je bent geduldig en open: iedereen wandelt op zijn eigen tempo en mag zichzelf zijn.

Wat bieden wij:

  • Je maakt deel uit van een hele warme, hechte club!

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,29 per km

  • Mogelijkheden voor deskundigheidsbevordering

  • Ontmoetingen en kleine attenties

  • Verzekeringen: ongevallen, bedrijfsaansprakelijkheid en inzittende

  • Nazorgteam en vertrouwenspersoon aanwezig


Enthousiast over deze vacature of nog vragen? Bel dan 0642461019 of mail naar vrijwilligerswerk@cello-zorg.nl Of je laat je gegevens achter bij solliciteer direct (het uploaden van een cv is niet nodig)

title: Senior Frontend / Full Stack Developer (React & Java)
description:
Salary: 900-1200 PLN/day on B2B

Work model: hybrid from Gdynia / Gdańsk / Warszawa / Łódź (3 days per week from the office)

Why choose this offer?

  • You can expect a flexible work organization

  • The international work environment will give you the opportunity to interact with the English language on a daily basis

  • Scandinavian organizational culture will provide you with work-life balance, you will gain time for additional training (financed by Jit)

  • The Jit community will bring you a nice time during regular integration meetings

Project

You will be involved in a greenfield financial project within the Structured Loan Manager / Covenant area. Working in an Agile setup, you will collaborate closely with a dedicated business team to build and enhance a new application from scratch. We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer, but we are also open to experienced Frontend Developers with expert-level React skills who would like to further develop their backend expertise.

Responsibilities you'll have

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining full-stack solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and React

  • Collaborating closely with business stakeholders to gather, refine, and translate requirements into user stories

  • Creating intuitive and high-quality user interfaces with a strong focus on user experience

  • Participating in Agile ceremonies and actively contributing to team discussions and solution design

  • Developing and executing end-to-end tests to ensure high application quality and reliability

  • Supporting the continuous improvement of development processes, code quality, and team collaboration

Expected competences and knowledge

  • Strong commercial experience in full-stack development using Java 17+, Spring Boot, and React

  • Alternatively, 8+ years of hands-on experience with React and a strong interest in developing backend expertise in Java

  • Experience with JPA and relational databases

  • Experience working in Agile development teams

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders and translate requirements into technical solutions

  • Strong communication skills and fluent English

Technologies you'll work with

  • Java 17+

  • React

  • Spring Boot

  • JPA

  • Selenium

  • Liquibase, Maven, Cucumber

Client – why choose this particular client from the Jit portfolio?

Jit Team has had an over-decade-long relationship with the leading financial group in the Nordic countries, and we are privileged to be our client's premier partner in Poland. At present, over 200 Jit personnel are engaged in the completion of more than 60 projects for this Norwegian major provider of financial services with a global presence and a strong focus on modern technology. Our customer's work atmosphere is epitomized by the Scandinavian culture, which is conducive to people who place emphasis on work-life balance and feedback culture. Furthermore, all projects are executed in international teams, giving constant exposure to the English language.

About Jit Team

The Human Factor of IT - it’s not just a slogan, it’s a philosophy. The foundation of Jit Team is people, which is why we prioritise you. We employ over 770 experienced experts, to whom we offer developmental projects, a wide range of benefits, and a proprietary professional development programme. Together with clients from around the world, we create innovative IT solutions delivered by highly specialised and efficient teams.

Behind our maxim are also charitable and educational activities. We support schools, universities, and educational institutions by conducting workshops, running educational projects, sponsoring events, and donating learning equipment. We offer internships that help launch careers in IT. We support water rescuers and hospitals by providing the necessary equipment. We also support numerous charitable organisations helping people in need, children, and the elderly. We are a Polish company and we share what we have achieved over more than 15 years of activity. By supporting local initiatives, we contribute to the circulation of good energy.

title: Asystent / Asystentka ds. sprzedaży
description:
Nasza sprzedaż pędzi do przodu, dlatego szukamy energii i zaangażowania – ambitnej osoby studiującej, która wejdzie do naszego teamu handlowego, odciąży naszą Team Leaderkę, przejdzie u nas prawdziwą szkołę biznesu i z czasem wyrośnie na samodzielnego asa międzynarodowej sprzedaży.

Dlaczego warto do nas dołączyć właśnie teraz?

  • Rośniemy jak szaleni: Od trzech lat co roku podwajamy nasze obroty (x2 rok do roku!). My nie stoimy w miejscu – my lecimy!
  • Szkoła biznesu w praktyce: Nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę bez koła ratunkowego. Będziesz pracować ramię w ramię z naszą Team Leaderką sprzedaży, ucząc się od podstaw, jak wygląda nowoczesny, międzynarodowy proces B2B.
  • Wychowamy własnego managera: Szukamy kogoś na dłużej. Chcemy Cię wyszkolić i dać Ci narzędzia, byś po studiach (lub w ich trakcie) stał/a się w pełni samodzielnym Account Managerem z własnym portfolio dużych, zagranicznych klientów.
  • Pełna elastyczność: Wiemy, czym są kolokwia i sesja. U nas bez problemu połączysz naukę z pracą – działamy zdalnie i dopasowujemy grafik do Twojego planu zajęć.

🔎 Kogo szukamy?

Szukamy osoby na starcie swojej drogi w biznesie, która ma w sobie naturalną ciekawość, "głód" wiedzy i chce szybko chłonąć praktyczne umiejętności. Nie musisz mieć wieloletniego doświadczenia – najważniejsza jest dla nas Twoja postawa, zaangażowanie i to, czy złapiemy wspólny vibe.


Będzie nam po drodze, jeśli:

  • Posiadasz status studenta i szukasz miejsca, w którym realnie rozwiniesz skrzydła (a nie tylko „odbębnisz” staż).
  • Swobodnie rozmawiasz i piszesz po angielsku oraz polsku (must-have) – działamy międzynarodowo, więc codzienny kontakt z zagranicznymi klientami to u nas standard.
  • Jesteś osobą świetnie zorganizowaną i skrupulatną – potrafisz samodzielnie zarządzać swoim czasem w pracy zdalnej, nie gubisz wątków i dbasz o porządek w dokumentach oraz systemach.
  • Chcesz się uczyć sprzedaży i obsługi klienta B2B – pierwsze doświadczenia w kontakcie z ludźmi (np. obsługa klienta, gastronomia, call center, wolontariaty) będą super atutem, ale najważniejsza jest chęć do nauki.
  • Stawiasz na szczerość i otwartą komunikację – pracujemy zdalnie, więc jasny przepływ informacji to dla nas podstawa. U nas mówi się wprost, co działa, a co nie.

title: Solution Architect
description:
As a recruitment company, DCG understands that every business is powered by experienced professionals. Our management style and partnership approach enable us to meet your needs and provide continuous support. Due to our ongoing growth and the large number of recruitment projects we undertake for our partners, we are currently looking for: Solution Architect

Responsibilities:

  • Defining and maintaining the solution architecture: Designing the overall system architecture, translating business, functional and technical requirements into scalable and secure architectural solutions

  • Designing system interoperability and integration: Defining interfaces between system components and external platforms, ensuring interoperability across distributed systems, selecting appropriate integration patterns and technologies, and maintaining architectural consistency throughout the system lifecycle

  • Leading architectural governance and technology selection: Establishing architecture standards and best practices, evaluating technologies and solution alternatives

  • Supporting system planning and software development: Estimating software development activities, analysing existing systems, contributing to solution design and change management and ensuring the solution remains scalable, maintainable and aligned with business objectives

  • Producing technical documentation and providing technical leadership: Preparing architectural documentation and technical presentations, communicating architectural decisions to stakeholders, mentoring development teams

Requirements:

  • Higher education degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline

  • Minimum 7 years of proven professional experience in software development, including at least 2 years in software architecture for large-scale enterprise systems

  • Strong knowledge of distributed systems, including event-driven architectures, Apache Kafka, GraphQL APIs and Redis, with experience integrating complex software systems

  • Co-financing for the sports card

  • Constant support of dedicated consultant

  • Employee referral program

title: Bilrekonditionerare
company: Toveks Bil i Syd AB, Eftermarknad, Borås
description:
Vi är ett familjeföretag i första generationen med verksamhet inom bilhandel och service. Toveks Bil grundades 1994 av Gregor Tovek, som fortfarande är huvudägare. Vi är totalt ca 850 anställda inom koncernen och omsätter ca 5 MDR. Vi har anläggningar på 18 orter till huvudsak i Västsverige och är återförsäljare för Volkswagen, Audi, SEAT, Skoda, Volkswagen Transportbilar samt Scania.

Vi bedriver verksamhet inom tre olika bolag, men under ett gemensamt varumärke – Toveks Bil.

Som bilrekonditionerare ska du se till att våra kunders bilar lämnar vår tvätthall i bästa, tänkbara skick. Du kommer till exempel att arbeta med lättare tvätt så som dammsugning till större och mer omfattande poleringar och lackförseglingar, samt interiörrengöring på nya och begagnade bilar. Det är meriterande om du har Verkstadsteknisk utbildning eller motsvarande, likaså om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta i däckverksamhet/ däckhotell. Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med verkstads- och rekonditioneringsteamet samt ha en tät dialog med försäljningsavdelningen. Du ansvarar för att arbetet utförs med högsta kvalitet och för att processer och rutiner följs.

För att klara arbetet krävs att du är noggrann och effektiv när du utför dina arbetsuppgifter. Har du tidigare arbetat med rekonditionering så är det meriterande. Du samarbetar bra med dina kollegor och har inga problem med att hjälpa till där det behövs. Som person är du engagerad och har en god känsla för service och kvalitet.

Hos oss får du tryggheten av att vara en del i ett stort företag med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter. Vi erbjuder förmåner, i form av uppskattade personalrabatter och friskvårdsbidrag då vi värnar om våra anställdas hälsa. Tillsammans på Toveks Bil vill vi vara våra kunders naturliga val samtidigt som vi har roligt på jobbet och trivs med det vi gör. Vi tror att du som passar in hos oss är en lagspelare och mån om att både du och dina kollegor gör ett bra jobb tillsammans.

Tillträde: snarast, enligt överenskommelse

Arbetsort: Borås

Omfattning: heltid

Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, så var gärna snabb in med din ansökan.

OM FÖRETAGET

Vi är ett familjeföretag med ett motto – Hela vägen! Vi ser vår personal som vår framgångsfaktor och hos oss ska du utvecklas och utmanas i din yrkesroll. Du har ett välmående företag och starka varumärken i ryggen och kompetenta kollegor att jobba sida vid sida med. Vi är en stor, men samtidigt enkel, okomplicerad och familjär organisation där vi är nära till beslut. Vår verksamhet präglas och styrs mycket av våra oerhört starka varumärken, som alla är marknadsledande inom sina segment. Bra egenskaper för att trivas hos oss är positivitet, initiativtagande, sunt förnuft och vilja att vara en del i det vinnande laget.

title: Ohjaaja, Vallinojan asumisyksikkö
description:
Vammaisten ja vanhusten palvelujen toimiala, Vammaispalvelut
Vallinojan asumisyksikkö
Lehmustontie 61 F , 01450 Vantaa

Me VAKEssa rakennamme yhdessä rohkeasti hyvinvointialuetta, johon asukkaamme voivat luottaa. Haluamme olla vakaa edelläkävijä, joka uudistaa toimintaa avoimesti ja ihmislähtöisesti. Arvomme oikeudenmukaisuus, vastuullisuus ja rohkeus ohjaavat arjen työtämme. Tunnistatko näistä myös omat arvosi?

Tule sinäkin Hyvantekijät-joukkueeseemme!

Haemme sijaisuuteen lähihoitajan koulutuksen omaavaa OHJAAJAA Vallinojalle työskentelemään osana asiakkaiden arkea. Ohjaajana tuet asiakkaiden yksilöllisen elämän toteutumista. Vallinojalla työssä korostuu perushoito, mutta työ on myös vahvasti ohjauksellista. Asiakkaita ohjataan ja avustetaan muun muassa kodinhoitossa, ruokailussa sekä kodin ulkopuolla asioimisessa. Ohjaajan työtä tehdään kolmessa vuorossa.

Odotamme sinulta lähihoitajan koulutusta. Aiempi kokemuksesi työstä kehitysvammaisten kanssa auttaa sinut nopeammin alkuun, mutta kokemus ei ole välttämätöntä. Uudet työntekijät perehdytetään työn alussa. Toivomme sinulta kiinnostusta, reipasta asennetta ja omatoimisuutta. Tarvitset työssäsi sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, jotta kommunikointi sujuu mahdollisimman hyvin kaikkien asukkaidemme kanssa.

Vallinoja on koti kuudelletoista (16) kehitysvammaiselle aikuiselle. Tilat sijaitsevat kahdessa kerroksessa ja muodostuvat kolmesta ryhmäkodista. Työyhteisössä ketään ei jätetä yksin, ja työparityöskentely on osa arkea. Vallinojalle on hyvät kulkuyhteydesä Keravalta ja Korsosta.

Miksi Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue?

Meillä hyvinvointi ja arjen sujuvuus ovat aidosti tärkeitä. Tarjoamme lounasedun sekä 400 euron Epassi-edun liikuntaan, kulttuuriin, hyvinvointiin tai työmatkoihin. Lisäksi hyvinvointiasi tukevat lakisääteiset työterveyspalvelumme.

Olemme ihmisläheinen organisaatio, jossa kehitämme toimintaa rohkeasti ja yhdessä. Meillä johtaminen on lupaus selkeistä tavoitteista, arvostavasta kohtaamisesta ja rohkeasta yhdessä uudistamisesta.

Saat selkeän näkymän omaan työhösi sekä mahdollisuuksia kokeilla ja kehittää uusia tapoja tehdä työtä. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia myös oman osaamisesi vahvistamiseen ja urasi kehittämiseen. Teemme merkityksellistä työtä joka päivä: autamme, hoidamme ja pelastamme.
