title: Senior QA Manager
description:
Job Description

Job Summary/Objective
Quality Assurance Leaders at MRI collaborate closely with Product Management, Product Development, Architecture, and Operations teams to define, execute, and continuously improve the quality strategy for MRI’s software solutions. QA Leaders are responsible for ensuring the delivery of high quality, high performance, secure, and scalable products that meet both customer expectations and business objectives.

In this role, QA Leaders provide direction and oversight for manual, automation, and performance testing strategies across web, mobile, API, and backend systems. They establish quality standards, testing practices, tools, and processes, ensuring consistent and effective execution throughout the software development lifecycle. QA Leaders guide teams in defining test approaches, acceptance criteria, and release readiness while proactively identifying quality risks and driving corrective actions.

QA Leaders are accountable for building, mentoring, and developing high performing QA teams, fostering a culture of quality ownership, continuous improvement, and accountability. They leverage metrics, reporting, and data driven insights to evaluate quality outcomes, improve efficiency, and inform decision making at the product, portfolio, and enterprise levels.

In addition, QA Leaders champion the adoption of AI enabled testing capabilities to optimize test design, execution, defect analysis, and risk prediction. By integrating AI and modern testing practices, QA Leaders enhance testing effectiveness, accelerate delivery, and ensure that quality remains embedded across MRI’s products, teams, and global organization.


Education
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline preferred
• Equivalent experience in Quality Assurance, Software Engineering, or Technical Leadership considered
• Advanced certifications, leadership training, or equivalent experience valued at senior levels


Role – Manager (9+ years)

Role Focus

Owns people management, delivery execution, and process adoption for one or more QA teams.

People & Team Management
• Manage QA Engineers and Team Leads
• Conduct performance reviews, coaching, and career development
• Partner on hiring, onboarding, and skills development
Quality Execution
• Own quality outcomes for assigned products or teams
• Define test plans, regression strategies, and release readiness criteria
• Ensure balanced coverage across manual, automation, and performance testing
Process & Metrics
• Enforce QA standards, best practices, and tooling usage
• Track and report quality KPIs (defects, coverage, stability)
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives
AI Enablement
Promote adoption of AI tools for test creation, prioritization, and analytics


Tools and technology
QA Leaders are expected to have strong working knowledge of QA tooling and technologies used to support manual, automation, performance, and AI enabled testing practices. Leaders are responsible for defining standards, driving adoption, and ensuring consistent, effective use of QA tools across teams and regions to enable high quality, data driven delivery.


Benefits
• Hybrid working arrangements
• Annual performance-related bonus
• Health insurance
• 6x Flexi: knock 2.5 hours off your day on anyday
• Engaging, fun & inclusive culture: check out the MRI Software APAC Insta feed and stories!

About Us

From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you!

Our people-first approach to PropTech is defining a new industry standard for client experiences that, quite frankly, can’t be duplicated. Experiences that deliver real value every day. And we know those experiences begin with our people.

We believe MRI is more than just a workplace; it’s a connected community of people who truly feel they belong. Whether we’re investing in employee resource groups or providing tailored resources for each person to reach their full potential, we’re passionate about creating a work environment that makes you excited to show up every single day.

At MRI, one of our core values is to strive to amaze. From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients.

Amazing growth requires amazing employees. Are you up to the challenge?

We know confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting remarkable candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

MRI is proud to be an inclusive employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity across all backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, military, veteran status and more.

We believe that Belonging is a direct result of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Those values are woven into the fabric of who we are and are foundational to our continued success. Come and see for yourself!

title: Asystent / Asystentka ds. sprzedaży
description:
Nasza sprzedaż pędzi do przodu, dlatego szukamy energii i zaangażowania – ambitnej osoby studiującej, która wejdzie do naszego teamu handlowego, odciąży naszą Team Leaderkę, przejdzie u nas prawdziwą szkołę biznesu i z czasem wyrośnie na samodzielnego asa międzynarodowej sprzedaży.

Dlaczego warto do nas dołączyć właśnie teraz?

  • Rośniemy jak szaleni: Od trzech lat co roku podwajamy nasze obroty (x2 rok do roku!). My nie stoimy w miejscu – my lecimy!
  • Szkoła biznesu w praktyce: Nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę bez koła ratunkowego. Będziesz pracować ramię w ramię z naszą Team Leaderką sprzedaży, ucząc się od podstaw, jak wygląda nowoczesny, międzynarodowy proces B2B.
  • Wychowamy własnego managera: Szukamy kogoś na dłużej. Chcemy Cię wyszkolić i dać Ci narzędzia, byś po studiach (lub w ich trakcie) stał/a się w pełni samodzielnym Account Managerem z własnym portfolio dużych, zagranicznych klientów.
  • Pełna elastyczność: Wiemy, czym są kolokwia i sesja. U nas bez problemu połączysz naukę z pracą – działamy zdalnie i dopasowujemy grafik do Twojego planu zajęć.

🔎 Kogo szukamy?

Szukamy osoby na starcie swojej drogi w biznesie, która ma w sobie naturalną ciekawość, "głód" wiedzy i chce szybko chłonąć praktyczne umiejętności. Nie musisz mieć wieloletniego doświadczenia – najważniejsza jest dla nas Twoja postawa, zaangażowanie i to, czy złapiemy wspólny vibe.


Będzie nam po drodze, jeśli:

  • Posiadasz status studenta i szukasz miejsca, w którym realnie rozwiniesz skrzydła (a nie tylko „odbębnisz” staż).
  • Swobodnie rozmawiasz i piszesz po angielsku oraz polsku (must-have) – działamy międzynarodowo, więc codzienny kontakt z zagranicznymi klientami to u nas standard.
  • Jesteś osobą świetnie zorganizowaną i skrupulatną – potrafisz samodzielnie zarządzać swoim czasem w pracy zdalnej, nie gubisz wątków i dbasz o porządek w dokumentach oraz systemach.
  • Chcesz się uczyć sprzedaży i obsługi klienta B2B – pierwsze doświadczenia w kontakcie z ludźmi (np. obsługa klienta, gastronomia, call center, wolontariaty) będą super atutem, ale najważniejsza jest chęć do nauki.
  • Stawiasz na szczerość i otwartą komunikację – pracujemy zdalnie, więc jasny przepływ informacji to dla nas podstawa. U nas mówi się wprost, co działa, a co nie.

title: Afdelingssecretaresse Kindergeneeskunde
description:
Variatie, hectiek, de spil van een team en bovenal, de allerbeste zorg voor de patiënten! Dat zijn woorden waar jij blij van wordt als daadkrachtige afdelingssecretaresse die het hoofd koel houdt als iedereen tegelijkertijd jou om hulp vraagt.
Als afdelingssecretaresse ben je onmisbaar voor de afdeling. Je zit achter de balie van de verpleegafdeling en bent het centrale aanspreekpunt voor patiënten, ouders, bezoekers, artsen en verpleegkundigen. Continu doen zij een beroep op jou waardoor jij als geen ander weet wat er speelt op de afdeling. Je komt te werken binnen een leuk en enthousiast team. Je werkzaamheden zijn gevarieerd, maar daardoor soms ook onvoorspelbaar en hectisch. Geen dag is bij ons hetzelfde. Je beantwoordt binnenkomend telefoonverkeer, verstrekt informatie of verbindt telefoongesprekken door.Via het systeem vraag je medische onderzoeken aan voor onze patiënten. De turnover op de afdeling is hoog. Voor alle opnames, ontslag en overplaatsing van patiënten zorg jij voor het opvragen en verwerken van alle relevante administratieve gegevens in Chipsoft.

Wij zijn op zoek naar een flexibele en stressbestendige afdelingssecretaresse met goede communicatieve en contactuele vaardigheden. Kinderen zijn onze patiënten doelgroep en daar heb jij affiniteit mee. Echter zal jij als secretaresse nog meer te maken hebben met de ouders en hun emoties. Jij voelt feilloos aan hoe je hiermee omgaat. Je kunt goed prioriteiten stellen: je prioriteert de urgentie van alle verzoeken die je moet behandelen, zowel van de patiënten als van de artsen. Je bent professioneel gastvrij: ook tijdens piekdrukte breng je bijvoorbeeld een bezoeker geduldig naar een patiënt, deze houding is voor jou vanzelfsprekend.

Wij vragen

  • Afgeronde (secretaresse) opleiding op minimaal mbo-niveau
  • Goede kennis van de medische terminologie
  • Ervaring in een frontofficefunctie in een ziekenhuis is een pré
  • Flexibele werkdagen

De procedure

Solliciteren naar de vacature van afdelingssecretaresse kindergeneeskunde? Upload jouw cv en motivatiebrief via de solliciteer button t.a.v. Melissa Moerman, recruiter.

Wil je meer weten over de functie? Bep Wiessenhaan, afdelingsmanager Kinder- en Jeugdafdeling, (015-260 35 61) helpt je graag.

Vragen over de procedure? Bel of stuur een WhatsApp bericht naar Melissa via 06 - 82 313 463.

Solliciteren kan tot en met 12 augustus 2026. Wacht echter niet met solliciteren tot de sluitingsdatum: je sollicitatie wordt direct in behandeling genomen.

title: Senior Program Management Specialist [L5] (Retail PMO)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

Retail Program Management 조직은 Coupang Retail 전 카테고리의 지속적인 사업 성장과 운영 효율성 향상을 지원하기 위해, 개별 카테고리를 넘어 전사적·범조직적 프로그램을 기획, 설계, 운영하는 조직입니다.

주요 역할은 다음과 같습니다.

  • Retail 전반의 핵심 과제를 정의하고 우선순위를 수립하여 전략적 프로그램을 추진
  • 새로운 비즈니스 기회 발굴 및 확장 전략 수립을 통한 성장 동력 확보
  • 카테고리 간 공통 문제를 해결하고 표준 프로세스 및 운영 체계를 구축하여 확장성 확보
  • 데이터 기반 인사이트를 활용한 성과 관리 및 의사결정 체계 고도화
  • 고객 경험 개선과 사업 성과 향상을 동시에 달성할 수 있는 혁신 프로그램 설계 및 운영

이를 통해 Retail Program Management 조직은 단순한 프로젝트 관리 조직을 넘어, Coupang Retail의 성장 전략을 실행 가능한 프로그램으로 전환하고 조직 전반의 실행력을 높이는 핵심 엔진 역할을 담당하고 있습니다.

업무 내용

1. Premium Data & Brand Shop+ Program Operations Management

  • Premium Data 및 Brand Shop+ 프로그램의 End-to-End 운영 체계를 관리하며 안정적인 서비스 운영 지원
  • 구독(Subscription) 관리, KPI 모니터링 및 성과 리포팅을 통해 프로그램 운영 현황을 체계적으로 관리
  • 브랜드 및 내부 이해관계자의 문의, 이슈 및 고객 응대를 총괄하며 운영 품질 유지
  • 정책, 프로세스 및 시스템 변경사항에 대한 커뮤니케이션과 Change Management를 주도하여 원활한 운영 전환 지원
  • 운영 프로세스 표준화 및 지속적인 개선을 통해 운영 효율성과 확장성 확보

2. Brand Shop+ 운영 고도화 및 전략 프로젝트 리드

  • 브랜드 경험 향상 및 운영 효율화를 위한 신규 기능 및 프로세스 개선 프로젝트 추진
  • Product 및 Engineering 조직과 협업하여 기능 개발, 정책 개선 및 시스템 고도화 과제 리드
  • 운영 자동화 및 확장 가능한 운영 모델 구축을 통해 프로그램 경쟁력 강화

3. Retail Growth 지원을 위한 신규 비즈니스 및 혁신 프로그램 개발

  • Retail 사업 성장을 지원할 수 있는 신규 비즈니스 기회 및 전략적 프로그램 발굴
  • 고객 경험 개선과 운영 혁신을 동시에 달성할 수 있는 성장 이니셔티브 개발
  • 데이터 및 시장 인사이트를 기반으로 혁신 과제를 정의하고 실행 계획 수립
  • Cross-functional 조직과 협업하여 신규 프로그램을 기획·실행하고 조직 내 확산 주도

자격 요건

  • 이커머스, 유통 또는 관련 산업군에서 Program Management, Business Operations, Project Management 경력이 5년 이상이신 분
  • 정량적 데이터 분석을 통해 비즈니스 문제를 정의하고 개선안을 도출해 본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 표준 운영 절차(SOP) 수립 및 프로세스 개선 프로젝트를 주도하여 인력/비용/시간 효율화를 이끌어내신 분
  • 다양한 이해관계자(Product, Engineering, Business, Operations 등)와의 협업을 통해 프로젝트를 성공적으로 추진한 경험이 있으신 분
  • KPI 관리, 운영 성과 모니터링 및 리포팅 경험이 있으신 분

우대 사항

  • 신규 서비스, 기능 또는 비즈니스 프로그램을 기획하고 Launch한 경험이 있으신 분
  • Subscription, Membership, B2B Program 운영 경험을 보유하신 분
  • E-commerce, Marketplace, Digital Platform 산업 경험을 보유하신 분
  • SQL, Tableau, Power BI 등 데이터 분석 및 시각화 도구 활용 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit.

title: (338P) Media Planning Supervisor
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About Wavemaker: A Leading WPP Media Brand

Wavemaker, part of WPP, positively provokes growth for clients by reshaping consumer decision-making and experiences through media, content, and technology. Our name is both our mission and our method. We do our best work for brave brands and people who relish being challenged to go further and faster, together.

Role Summary and Impact

  • Provide high-quality strategy and tactics in client proposal and reporting.
  • Ensure client projects are kept on track while adhering to campaign objectives.
  • Manage day to day operational work on the given client(s) with the team.
  • Manage the daily communication with multiple parties; able to tackle sudden requests/issues with proper attitude and professional skills.
  • Understand and keep updated with the latest media, esp. digital trends.

Skills and Experience

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.
  • At least 2-4 years’ experience in digital media, advertising, marketing
  • Working knowledge across search (SEM), social (FB/Line), video (OTV), display (GDN etc), ad serving (DCM) and ideally also programmatic media buying (DV360)
  • Experience with Media Research Tools (Comscore, GWI, TGI, YouGov, SimilarWeb)
  • Ability to provide and plan media across channels and estimate return of media investment.
  • Strong organizational skills with a keen ability to prioritize and multitask.
  • Proven problem-solving skills and ability to think outside of the box.
  • Ability to manage client expectations, work independently, and also collaborate in a team environment.
  • Detail-oriented and responsive, deadline-driven with strong reasoning skills.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: System Analyst
description:
As a recruitment company, DCG understands that every business is powered by experienced professionals. Our management style and partnership approach enable us to meet your needs and provide continuous support. Due to our ongoing growth and the large number of recruitment projects we undertake for our partners, we are currently looking for:

System Analyst

Responsibilities:

  • Analysing business processes and requirements

  • Eliciting, analysing and documenting business processes, capabilities, functional and non-functional requirements, and user stories, ensuring alignment with business objectives and identifying potential solution options

  • Designing system and data architectures: Translating business requirements into system specifications and modelling application and data architectures using UML and enterprise modelling tools, including logical data models, use cases, system behaviour, acceptance criteria and UI prototypes in collaboration with UX specialists

  • Supporting solution design and system lifecycle: Collaborating with architects, developers, testers and product owners to ensure consistent, scalable and secure solutions

  • Preparing documentation and communicating solutions

Requirements:

  • A university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline

  • Minimum 4 years of proven professional experience in systems analysis, requirements engineering and software design for complex information systems

  • Expert knowledge of UML and proven experience in modelling Application and Data Architectures, including logical data models, use cases and system specifications

  • Practical experience with enterprise modelling tools such as Sparx Enterprise Architect, ARIS Architect or equivalent, and strong understanding of software architecture and system integration principles

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills, experience working in Agile (Scrum) environments, ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams

  • Excellent command of English (minimum C1 level)

Offer:

  • Co-financing for the sports card

  • Constant support of dedicated consultant

  • Employee referral program

title: Project Delivery Manager
description:
At the Guinness Partnership, our Planned Investment Delivery teams deliver a cyclical programme of improvements that enhance the quality and safety of our residents’ homes.

We have a new opportunity for an experienced Project Delivery Manager to join the Guinness team. This is a full-time, permanent role based at our office in Havant. Your time will be split between on‑site visits across Hampshire and West Sussex, office-based work, and some home working.

As a Project Delivery Manager, your primary purpose will be to lead the successful delivery of planned works, which includes work to windows, roofs, doors and other parts of the building fabric. You will work closely with, and manage external consultants and contractors under a long-term, Target Cost Model and Open Book Planned Partnering Contract (PPC) to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard.

What we are looking for

We know that how we do things is just as important as what we do. That is why we are seeking someone with firsthand experience of delivering planned works within a housing or public sector environment. You will also be a confident collaborator with the ability to develop positive working relationships with colleagues, contractors and residents. We are looking for someone who can positively represent Guinness when engaging with our external contractors.

Essential skills & experience:

  • Proven experience of working within teams successfully delivering large-scale planned investment projects.
  • Commercial acumen and experience in managing all commercial aspects of multiple projects.
  • Experience in contract management with external and internal contractor organisations delivering multi-disciplinary projects to achieve value for money and quality.
  • Proven experience in providing excellent customer service, including consulting with residents as part of planned works.
  • Excellent project management skills.
  • Good knowledge of building construction and repair techniques, building safety and retrofit to current legislation and regulations.
  • Experience in effective budget management.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Extensive project management experience working in the built environment, including component replacement, fire safety and retrofit projects.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the activities of a social landlord.

Essential qualifications:

  • Educated to Level 5 (HND) or higher in Building, Construction, surveying, or equivalent.

To find out more about the key responsibilities and to view the essential and desirable criteria, please review the role profile.

Please apply with a CV and covering letter, detailing how you meet the essential criteria.

title: AES - Hardware Engineer
description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.

  • Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience

  • Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence

  • Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

About the Role

As a Hardware engineer you will focus on Hardware development and software testing of automotive infotainment computer systems, automotive platforms, functional block design.

What You Will Do

  • Development, test and verification of analog and digital functional blocks (e.g. power supplies, Audio blocks, MCU/SoC units) within complex hardware architectures under considering of quality, cost and suitability for series.
  • Test and analysis of application and driver software in infotainment computer systems with the aim to ensure correct functionality of software with dedicated hardware.
  • Support in design, creation and implementation of software and hardware for infotainment computer systems.
  • Creation of measurement reports and technical documentation.
  • Schematic entry and variant management.
  • Evaluation of requirements and feasibility as well as the assistance in System Design / HW realization.
  • Assisting in the technical requirements specification of purchased parts of telematics & connectivity functional blocks and in the evaluation and selection of suitable supplier.
  • Assisting in the judgment of software feature fulfillment in dedicated hardware blocks.
  • Basic knowledge in command shell programming and shell debugging (e.g. routines to control hardware units under Harman operating system).
  • Familiar with revision control systems (eg perforce for check-in/check-out).
  • Knowledge of commonly used interfaces in infotainment systems (PCIe, UART, TDM, Video-, I2C, I2S, USB) appreciated.
  • Realization of system designs, schematics and/or schematics integration of hardware applications in the range of medium to high complexity under consideration of Harman guidelines.
  • Global cooperation with other departments as Construction, Quality, Manufacturing and Software during the development process.
  • Maintenance support.
  • Technical support for internal and/or external staff in the industrialization of function items in an international environment.
  • Perform technical measurements on customer site ( EMC, Thermal, functional).
  • Schematic integration for low to medium complexity projects
  • Design verification and Bring-up activities
  • Create project documentation for projects involved in
  • Redesign of existing analog/digital functional blocks according to change requests (customer change requests, PCN, PTN …)
  • Support RFI/RFQ phase for new projects
  • Support BIOS activities (timings, power up and power down sequences, etc)
  • Support for Schematic and Layout reviews

What You Need to Be Successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical engineering, Information Technology or appropriate graduation or technician).
  • 1 up to 3 years professional experience in the HW development and verification of analog/digital applications and standalone functional units.
  • Knowledge of Hardware and Software Technology, ideally in embedded area.
  • Basic knowledge of programming software (i.e. C#, C++, LabView, VB…).
  • Knowledge of tools for schematic/layout realization and simulation (e.g. Mentor Graphics, SPICE, Ansys) as well as Microsoft applications.
  • Basic knowledge of operating systems (i.e. Linux, Android).
  • Knowledge of the requirements inside the automotive area, especially for EMC.
  • Good knowledge in spoken and written English.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Experience with infotainment/ entertainment systems (it would be a big plus).
  • Basic Linux knowledge.
  • Knowledge of commonly used interfaces in infotainment systems (PCIe, UART, TDM, Video, I2C, I2S, USB, MOST, SDIO …) appreciated.
  • Experience with hardware debugging and using lab tools.
  • Strong communications skills, both written and oral.
  • Very good English knowledge, both written and verbal.
  • Proactivity and good communication skills.
  • Excellent task and time management.
  • Attention to detail and “can do” attitude.
  • Flexibility
  • Highly organized and multitasking.
  • Analytical & critical thinking.
  • Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines

What Makes You Eligible

  • Willingness travel (0- 20% of time) depending on the project necessities.
  • Willingness to work in from our office.
  • [Indicate any scheduling requirements - e.g., Due to the nature of global infrastructure, you understand that flexibility in working hours is required.]

What We Offer

  • Flexible work environment
  • Access to employee discounts on world-class Harman and Samsung products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, etc.)
  • Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University
  • Competitive wellness benefits
  • “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology

Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.

If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or Protected Veterans status. title: Director of Estates
description:
• Sapientia Education Trust

  • Address: Wymondham, Norfolk NR18 9SZ

  • Salary: Competitive

  • Hours: Full time

  • Contract: Permanent

  • Reference: 0848

Sapientia Education Trust is a successful and ambitious Multi-Academy Trust serving schools across Norfolk and Suffolk. Established in 2016, the trust has grown to 22 schools, educating almost 9,000 pupils across primary, secondary and sixth form provision. With further schools expected to join the trust in the coming years, we are entering an exciting new phase of growth, development and opportunity.

Our central teams provide expert support across education, finance, HR, ICT, health and safety, governance and estates. Together, we work in partnership with school leaders to remove barriers, drive improvement and ensure our schools have the resources they need to succeed.

The role

To lead the strategic development of a multi-site education estate and help shape the future of one of East Anglia's most successful Multi-Academy Trusts.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an ambitious and forward-thinking estates leader to help shape the future of a highly respected and expanding organisation.

As Director of Estates, you will join the Executive Team at a pivotal point in the trust's development. With a growing family of schools and significant investment planned across our estate, you will provide the strategic vision, leadership and expertise required to ensure our buildings and facilities continue to support the highest standards of education for years to come.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead all aspects of estate management across the trust's diverse portfolio, from strategic asset planning and major capital projects to compliance, sustainability, health and safety, maintenance and estate development.

This role offers an outstanding platform for an experienced estates professional who is passionate about delivering meaningful impact. Whether through developing innovative estate strategies, securing investment, improving sustainability or delivering transformational capital projects, your work will directly support the education and wellbeing of thousands of children and young people across Norfolk and Suffolk.

To find out more

If you would like to visit the trust or would like an informal discussion, please contact Briony Rigwell, Executive Assistant to the CEO by calling 01953609012 or emailing: ea@setrust.co.uk

How to apply

Complete an online application form via our website along with a supporting letter of no more than 800 words, detailing how your experience equips you for the post and what you would bring to us.

Closing date: 12pm, 17 August 2026

Interview date: week commencing 24 August 2026

Promoted as FJ (Featured Job) on Suffolk Jobs Direct.

Applications are considered on receipt; therefore, early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to interview before the application closing date, should we receive a sufficient number of applications.

The trust is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. All applicants will be required to undergo appropriate safeguarding and pre-employment checks. In accordance with Keeping Children Safe in Education, references will be sought for shortlisted candidates prior to interview.

title: Senior Instrumentation Engineer
description:
What we do at Blykalla

Blykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company at the forefront of the nuclear industry, pioneering the development of small modular reactors that provide clean, safe, and reliable energy. Thanks to lead-cooling, we achieve high safety in a very compact format, allowing for a simple and cost-effective design that can be mass-produced. Our unique reactor design will provide safe and green baseload energy that perfectly complements solar and wind power.


What you’ll get to do

Blykalla is developing and commercializing lead-cooled Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) to provide safe, reliable, and fossil-free energy. Our mission is to deploy advanced nuclear technology that enables the decarbonization of industry and supports long-term energy security.

Reliable and accurate instrumentation is fundamental to the safe operation of any nuclear power plant. As Blykalla develops its lead-cooled SMR technology, we are building an in-house instrumentation capability to define, specify, and integrate the measurement systems that provide the data required for plant control, protection, monitoring, diagnostics, and regulatory compliance.


We are seeking a Senior Instrumentation Engineer to lead the specification, integration, and lifecycle management of instrumentation systems for Blykalla's lead-cooled SMR.

This role will be responsible for defining instrumentation requirements, ensuring that measurement systems meet the demanding requirements of reactor operation while working closely with automation, control systems, electrical, mechanical, process, and safety engineers.

Who you’ll get to work with

The Senior Instrumentation Engineer sits in the Plant Engineering Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Plant engineering manager. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla.

Key Responsibilities

Instrumentation System Design

  • Develop the instrumentation philosophy for Blykalla's reactor and plant systems.

  • Specify instrumentation for Nuclear Island and supporting plant systems.

  • Select and specify sensors, transmitters, analyzers, and field devices suitable for nuclear applications.

  • Develop standard instrumentation specifications and engineering guidelines.

  • Ensure instrumentation designs are maintainable, reliable, and support plant availability objectives.

Measurement System Engineering

Develop instrumentation solutions for measurement of temperature, pressure, differential pressure, flow, level, density, vibration, position, speed, radiation (where applicable) and chemistry and process analyzers.

Support instrumentation for reactor systems, primary coolant systems, heat transport systems, steam and energy conversion systems, auxiliary systems, HVAC systems, water treatment systems and fuel handling systems.

Instrumentation Documentation

Develop and maintain instrument data sheets, instrument index, I/O lists, hook-up drawings, instrument location plans, installation specifications, instrument specifications, calibration requirements and inspection and test plans.

Support development of P&IDs, functional descriptions, cause-and-effect matrices, instrument loop diagrams and control philosophies.

System Integration

Work closely with automation, control systems, electrical, mechanical, process, reactor and safety engineers to ensure instrumentation supports plant operation, protection, diagnostics, and maintenance.

Define interfaces between field instrumentation and plant DCS, PLC, and protection systems.

Vendor & Engineering Partner Management

  • Develop technical specifications for instrumentation packages.

  • Evaluate vendor proposals.

  • Review engineering partner deliverables.

  • Support procurement activities.

  • Participate in supplier technical meetings.

  • Ensure compliance with Blykalla requirements and applicable codes and standards.

Testing & Commissioning

  • Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT)

  • Site Acceptance Tests (SAT)

  • Instrument calibration

  • Loop checks

  • Commissioning activities

  • Functional testing

  • Performance verification

  • Assist in developing maintenance and calibration strategies for operational plants.


Who you are

You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are:

  • BSc or MSc in Instrumentation, Electrical, Automation, Control or Nuclear Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Fluent in English, spoken and written

  • Fluency in Swedish is a plus

  • 8-10 years of experience in instrumentation engineering within power generation, process industries, or other highly regulated industrial environments.

  • Experience specifying and selecting industrial instrumentation.

  • Experience producing instrumentation engineering documentation.

  • Experience supporting multidisciplinary engineering projects.

  • Experience reviewing supplier and contractor engineering deliverables.

Technical Skills

Strong understanding of:

  • Industrial instrumentation technologies

  • Measurement principles

  • Process instrumentation

  • Instrument selection and specification

  • Calibration methods

  • Instrument installation practices

  • Signal transmission (4–20 mA, HART, Foundation Fieldbus, Profibus PA, Ethernet-based protocols)

  • SIL concepts and instrument reliability

  • Functional safety fundamentals

Location

This position is for our office in Stockholm.

So, what do you think?

Don't miss the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team as Senior Instrumentation Engineer and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. Apply today with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements.

We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply!



Reference & Background Checks

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.


We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.

We do not accept applications via email.

We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies.

Note on AI Use: Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

title: Senior Designer
description:
We invite you to come grow with us.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignite's global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation & Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production & QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Role: Senior Designer - India Design Studio

Location: Gurugram, India

Team: India Design Studio

The Senior Designer is the Design Studio's senior craft and quality lead. You will remain hands-on in high-value work while setting creative standards, coaching designers and ensuring that Ignite's connected expertise is expressed through clear, persuasive and distinctive client stories.

What you will do

  • Lead complex proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials and other high-value client-facing design work.
  • Translate strategic, scientific and commercial content into persuasive visual narratives, storylines, information structures and data stories.
  • Provide creative direction and final design sign-off for priority, complex or high-risk work, while reinforcing that designers and business stakeholders retain accountability for their contributions and factual content.
  • Review team outputs and provide clear, constructive feedback against brand, accessibility, storytelling and quality standards.
  • Coach designers in presentation craft, information design, data visualisation, brand application, stakeholder engagement and responsible AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Partner with business-unit spokes and workflow leads to clarify briefs, shape scope, estimate effort and agree realistic quality and delivery expectations.
  • Protect and evolve Inizio Ignite templates, visual systems, reusable components, iconography, data-visualisation patterns and asset libraries.
  • Identify recurring quality issues and opportunities to improve briefs, workflows, QA checks, onboarding and knowledge sharing.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly for understanding, restructuring, exploration, asset discovery and QA, and help the team apply them without compromising craft, confidentiality or accountability.
  • Contribute to the growth of the Design Studio by demonstrating its value, strengthening global relationships and helping the team scale effective practices.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • At least 6 years of experience in presentation design, visual design, graphic design or a similar creative role, ideally in healthcare, life sciences, consulting, professional services or an agency environment.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating complex pitches, proposals, RFPs, credentials, information design, data visualisation and client-facing storytelling.
  • Advanced PowerPoint and presentation-design capability, with strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or similar tools; Think-cell or other charting tools would be advantageous.
  • Excellent visual storytelling, layout, typography, information design, data visualisation and design-system skills.
  • Experience coaching designers, reviewing work and raising quality without creating unnecessary delay or dependency.
  • Strong stakeholder management, scoping, prioritisation and problem-solving skills in an international environment.
  • Strong understanding of brand governance, accessibility, reusable asset systems, document QA and final-delivery standards.
  • Confident and responsible AI literacy, with the judgement to decide when AI adds value and when human-led craft is required.
  • The confidence to challenge unclear content, unrealistic expectations or work that does not meet client-facing standards.

Ideal profile

  • You are a confident design leader who combines strategic storytelling with strong execution.
  • You can raise quality, make pragmatic decisions and keep priority work moving.
  • You enjoy developing people, building standards and creating a culture of shared accountability.
  • You are motivated to shape a new global Design Studio and strengthen how Ignite brings its connected advisory proposition to market.

Life at Inizio Ignite

You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.

In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.

We provide

  • A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
  • International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
  • A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
  • A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

title: Liikunnan ja terveystiedon lehtori, Ylästön koulu
description:
Vantaan kaupunki, Kasvatus ja oppiminen, Perusopetus
Ylästön koulu

Ollaksentie 29, 01690 Vantaa

Työsuhteen kesto: Määräaikainen 11.08.2026 - 31.07.2027

Hei sinä liikunnan ja terveystiedon opettaja, tule mukavaan työyhteisöömme Ylästön kouluun!

Etsimme oppilaslähtöisesti ajattelevaa, innostavaa ja yhteistyökykyistä opettajaa työyhteisöömme yläkoulun liikunnan ja terveystiedon opettajaksi ajalle 11.8.2026-31.7.2027. Opetettavanasi on 7.-9. luokkien perus- ja valinnaisliikuntaa sekä muutamia tunteja terveystietoa. Aineryhmässä tehdään tiivistä yhteistyötä ja luvassa onkin huippukollegat.

Ylästön koulussa työskentelee 85 koulun kehittämiseen sitoutunutta opettajaa ja ohjaajaa. Olemme rakentaneet uudehkon yhtenäiskoulumme yhteistyöllä ja hyvällä keskinäisellä vuorovaikutuksella. Oletamme, että olet samanhenkinen.

Ylästön koulu on noin 850 oppilaan yhtenäiskoulu, jossa alueen oppilaat opiskelevat ensimmäisestä yhdeksänteen luokkaan, joten kutsumme itseämme kyläkouluksi. Tavallisen yhtenäiskoulutoiminnan lisäksi Ylästössä on musiikkiluokkatoimintaa kolmannesta yhdeksänteen vuosiluokkaan ja yläasteikäisten oppilaiden vammaisopetusta. Koulun slogan "Yhdessä Ylästön koulussa" kannattaa tulla kokemaan paikan päälle. Meillä et jää yksin!

Miksi valita Vantaa?

Vantaa on maamme neljänneksi suurin kaupunki, jossa on rohkeutta tehdä asioita uudella tavalla ja taitoa toimia yhteistyössä erilaisissa verkostoissa. Kaupunki on turvallinen työnantaja, joka tarjoaa henkilöstölle laajat mahdollisuudet osaamisen kehittämiseen. Nykyaikaisissa oppilaitoksissamme arvostetaan laadukkaan kasvatuksen ja opetuksen lisäksi kansainvälisyyttä, monikulttuurisuutta ja yhteisöllisyyttä.

Tule opettajaksi Vantaalle! [Tutustu opettajan työhön Vantaa.fi:ssä.](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/tyo-perusopetuksessa-ja-toisella-asteella)

Vantaan kaupunki tarjoaa työntekijöilleen monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, kuten liikunta-, hyvinvointi- ja kulttuuriedun, lounasedun ja työmatkaedun julkisen liikenteen käyttöön. Tuemme henkilöstön hyvinvointia mahdollistamalla ja tukemalla liikunnallista elämäntapaa. Kaupungin työntekijät voivat hyödyntää mm. uimahallien, kuntosalien ja ryhmäliikunnan sekä hierontayritysten etuhintaisia palveluja. Lisäksi työntekijöille on usein tarjolla alennushintaisia lippuja kaupungin kulttuuritapahtumiin.

title: Vice President, Training
description:
Venture Global LNG (“Venture Global”) is a long-term, low-cost provider of American-produced liquefied natural gas. The company’s Louisiana-based export projects service the global demand for North American natural gas and support the long-term development of clean and reliable North American energy supplies. Using reliable, proven technology in an innovative plant design configuration, Venture Global’s modular, mid-scale plant design will replace traditional designs as it allows for the same efficiency and operational reliability at significantly lower capital cost.

We are seeking qualified applicants for the position:

Vice President, Training

Located:

Houston

Summary

We are seeking qualified applicants for the position of Vice President, Training located in Houston, TX or our Louisiana sites.

Venture Global is embarking on a transformational journey to elevate how we train, develop, and empower our people. As we continue to expand our footprint and operational excellence, the Vice President of Training will play a critical leadership role in shaping the company’s future workforce capability.

This executive will design and lead a multi-year roadmap to build a world-class training organization — integrating onboarding, compliance, technical skills, and immersive learning technologies to ensure Venture Global’s teams are equipped to operate safely, efficiently, and innovatively across the value chain.

General Description Duties & Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a 3-year enterprise training strategy focused on onboarding, regulatory compliance, technical skill development, and leadership readiness.
  • Partner with Operations, HSSE, Engineering, and HR leaders to align training with business priorities, regulatory standards, and operational
  • Define and implement a Learning Framework that integrates digital learning, simulators, and real-world field experience.

Training Infrastructure & Technology

  • Support the roll-out of the centralized Learning Management System (LMS) for competency tracking, certification management, and Competency Assurance Management System
  • Create, Implement and Administer a fit for purpose CAMS process
  • Support leadership training programs
  • Lead the build-out of training facilities across LNG sites, including field training simulators, labs, and digital learning environments.
  • Introduce immersive training technologies (VR/AR, digital twins, simulation platforms) to accelerate operator and technician readiness.
  • Establish a centralized Learning Management System (LMS) for competency tracking, certification management, and analytics.
  • Oversee design and deployment of technical, compliance, and leadership training programs in partnership with human resource
  • Champion a culture of continuous learning and improvement across all sites.
  • Embed training metrics and feedback loops into RCA/CAPA, lessons learned, and performance reviews.
  • Partner with external institutions and LNG leaders to benchmark and integrate best practices.

Metrics & Governance

  • Establish KPIs to measure training impact — time-to-competence, certification rates, compliance completion, and skill progression.
  • Report progress and ROI of training investments to the executive leadership team.

Qualifications

Required experience

  • Fifteen or more years of experience in learning, development, or operational training leadership within the LNG sector.
  • Experience and knowledge in Industrial training and operations.
  • Extensive experience in technical training and competency strategies.
  • Proven success in building training organizations or academies at scale, ideally involving immersive or simulation-based learning.
  • Deep understanding of LNG operations, safety, and compliance frameworks
  • Executive presence with strong influencing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Track record of leading cross-functional transformations and delivering measurable capability uplift.

Success Profile

  • Visionary – Can translate VG’s growth strategy into a sustainable learning architecture.
  • Operationally Grounded – Understands field realities and operational urgency in LNG operations.
  • Innovative – Brings technology adoption to transform the learning experience
  • Collaborative – Builds bridges across functions for unified outcomes
  • Metrics-Driven – Focused on measurable results and ROI

Mission

  • Baseline training landscape, modernize onboarding/compliance, implement LMS.
  • Deploy field simulators, immersive learning pilots, and standardized certifications.
  • Establish Training Center of Excellence - global benchmark for LNG training, safety, and leadership

title: Avarn söker utbildade ordningsvakter till Örebro
description:
En ordningsvakt arbetar på offentliga platser där många människor är i rörelse. Därför är det viktigt att vara stresstålig och ha hög social kompetens. Ordningsvaktens arbete skiljer sig från väktarens eftersom ordningsvakten har större rätt att ingripa vid ordningsstörande. Han/hon har rätt att avlägsna, omhändertaga och gripa. För att få arbeta som ordningsvakt krävs en speciell ordningsvaktsutbildning och ett ordningsvaktsförordnande.

Tjänsteställe: Örebro

Arbetstider: Varierande arbetstider, både vardagar och helger.

Varaktighet: Behovsanställning (6 månaders provanställning tillämpas)

Tillträde: Omgående/enligt överenskommelse

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker utbildade ordningsvakter som är säkerhetsmedvetna, serviceinriktade, empatiska och har en inre trygghet och en naturlig drivkraft att vilja hjälpa till. Du ska vara utbildad ordningsvakt med ett giltigt ordningsvaktsförordnande.

Utöver de personliga egenskaper som vi eftersöker och beskriver i de olika uppdragen, behöver du uppfylla grundläggande krav för att bli kvalificerad för tjänsten:

  • gymnasiekompetens
  • god svenska i tal och skrift
  • körkort B
  • genomfört ordningsvaktsutbildning inom de tre senaste åren med godkänt resultat

Du behöver även vara ostraffad*, drogfri, ha en ordnad ekonomi samt en god hälsa och fysik för att kunna bli anställd på Avarn Security.

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan! Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan snarast möjligt - dock senast 2026-08-30 - sök tjänsten via vår https://www.avarnsecurity.se/karriar/lediga-tjanster/?rmpage=job&rmjob=p5812ej via mejl. Tester kommer att tillämpas i rekryteringsprocessen. Ha koll på din inkorg då testerna skickas dit.

Vårt erbjudande

Vi är den kompletta säkerhetsaktören på marknaden vilket möjliggör att vi är ledande i branschen för våra kunder samt att det finns goda utvecklingsmöjligheter för dig som medarbetare.

Du kommer att vara en viktig representant för allmänheten och våra kunder. Därför är det A och O för oss att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där alla våra 9000 medarbetare ska känna att ansvar, omtanke och samarbete främjas. Vi tar arbetsmiljöarbete på allvar och arbetar med ständiga förbättringar. Vi tillämpar lönesättning enligt kollektivavtal.

Avarn Security värnar om att du som medarbetare ska ha en trygg livssituation och hållbarhet i arbetslivet. Därför erbjuds alla nyanställda kostnadsfritt ett års försäkringslösning innehållande bland annat sjuk- och olycksfallsförsäkring, livförsäkring och barn- och ungdomsförsäkring.

* För att kunna anställas inom Avarn Security AB krävs att du blir godkänd av Länsstyrelsen för anställning i ett auktoriserat bevakningsföretag, i enlighet med Lag (1974:191) om bevakningsföretag. Ansökan till Länsstyrelsen hanteras av Avarn Security. Beroende på vilken befattning det gäller kan även en säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) bli aktuell. För att kunna utreda och bedöma om du uppfyller kraven enligt respektive lagstiftning genomförs en bakgrundskontroll. Denna bedömning omfattar laglydnad, lämplighet, pålitlighet, lojalitet samt eventuella sårbarheter. Uppgifter som inhämtas kan komma från dig själv, från öppna källor eller från myndigheter. Vid prövning av lämplighet för en tjänst tillämpar vi alltid en helhetsbedömning.

title: Sous Chef

Accountable for overall success of the daily restaurant kitchen operations. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. • Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

• Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

• Maintains the productivity level of employees.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.

• Handles guest problems and complaints.

• Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.

• Schedules employees to meet business demands and tracks employee time and attendance.

• Trains employees in safety procedures.

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.

Additional Responsibilities

title: 글로벌 MD Lead
description:
About

[BRAND]

퓨어웰니스는 누구나 건강을 위한 소비를 똑똑하고 쉽게 하는 세상을 만들고 있는 약국 MSO 스타트업입니다.
쏟아지는 건강 정보와 수많은 제품 중에서 꼭 필요한 것만 정제하고 큐레이션하여 전달합니다.

[WHY PVREWELLNESS]

현재 외부 투자 없이 사업을 시작해 3개월 만에 월 매출 12억 원을 달성했고, 올해 10개 이상의 K-뷰티 약국 오픈을 목표로 빠르게 성장하고 있습니다.

우리의 가장 큰 차별점은 약사의 눈으로 제품과 고객을 바라본다는 것입니다.
성분을 근거로 제품을 평가하고, 고객의 피부 고민에 맞는 큐레이션을 직접 설계합니다.
단순히 잘 팔리는 제품을 진열하는 것이 아니라, 왜 이 제품이어야 하는지를 설명할 수 있는 매대를 만듭니다.

[OUR ROADMAP]

대한민국에서 제일 가고 싶은 약국의 대명사가 됩니다.

• 차별화된 압도적 고객 경험을 통해 앞서갑니다.
• 내수 시장을 대상으로 창고형 약국 카테고리를 확장합니다.
• 똑똑하고 쉬운 건강 소비를 위해 PB 상품을 개발합니다.

이 여정에서 상품을 넘어 브랜드를 만들고, 선택을 넘어 기준을 만드는 진짜 브랜드 큐레이터를 찾습니다

Responsibilities

[퓨어웰니스의 글로벌 MD Lead는 이런 일을 해요]
• 고객 중심의 상품 전략을 통해 퓨어웰니스만의 경쟁력을 만들어요.
- 퓨어웰니스만의 상품 철학과 고객 인사이트를 바탕으로 상품 전략과 카테고리 방향성을 리드해요.
- 고객의 건강한 소비를 위한 차별화된 상품 라인업을 기획하고 운영해요.
- 고객과 시장의 변화를 반영하여 상품 포트폴리오를 지속적으로 고도화하고 새로운 상품 기회를 발굴해요.
- 상품이 퓨어웰니스를 찾는 가장 강력한 이유가 될 수 있도록 상품 경쟁력을 만들어가요.

• 데이터를 기반으로 상품 성장을 리드해요.
- 고객, 시장, 판매 데이터를 기반으로 카테고리별 성장 정략을 수립해요.
- 조직 내 핵심 지표를 분석하고 더 큰 성장을 위한 실행 전략을 도출해요.
- 상품 도입, 확대, 축소에 대한 의사결정을 리드하며 상품 운영 효율을 지속적으로 개선해요.
- 데이터와 현장의 인사이트를 연결하여 퓨어웰니스만의 MD 운영 기준을 만들어가요.

•확장 가능한 상품 운영 체계를 만들어요.
- 브랜드/벤더사와의 전략적 파트너십을 구축하고 협업을 리드해요.
- SKU 운영, 발주, 재고, 프로모션 등 상품 운영 프로세스를 지속적으로 고도화해요.
- 조직이 확장되어도 일관된 상품 경쟁력을 유지할 수 있는 운영 체계를 설계해요.
- MD의 성장을 돕고, 팀이 더 좋은 의사결정을 할 수 있는 기준과 일하는 방식을 함께 만들어가요.

Requirements

[이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요]
• 뷰티/헬스케어/리테일 카테고리 MD 경력 5년 이상 혹은 이에 준하는 역량을 갖추신 분
• 스킨케어/뷰티 카테고리에 대한 깊은 관심과 이해도가 있는 분
• 카테고리 전략부터 상품 운영까지 MD 전 과정을 리드해보신 분
• 고객과 데이터를 기반으로 전략을 수립하고 실행하여 결과를 만드신 분
• 브랜드/벤더사와 전략적인 파트너십을 구축하고 협업을 이끄신 분

Preferred

[이런 분이시라면 더 좋아요]
• 카테고리를 운영하는 것을 넘어, 하나의 브랜드를 함께 성장시키고 싶으신 분
• 정답이 없는 시장에서 새로운 리테일의 기준을 만들어보고 싶으신 분
• MD팀만의 일하는 기준과 문화를 함께 만들어가고 싶으신 분
• 국내를 넘어 글로벌 상품 전략을 리드하는 커리어를 만들어가고 싶으신 분
• H&B, 드럭스토어, 뷰티 리테일에서 카테고리 성장을 리드해보신 분
• AI툴을 적극 활용하여 업무의 생산성을 극대화한 경험이 있으신 분

Benefits

[업무 몰입과 성장을 위해 아낌없이 지원합니다]
• 인센티브 제도
• 임직원 추천 보상금 200만원
• 교육비 인당 연 180만원
• 도서비 월 1권 지원
• AI 구독·토큰 적극 지원

[건강하게 휴식하고 일하실 수 있도록 지원합니다]
• 점심 식대 1일 12,000원
• 야근 시 저녁 식대, 택시비 지원
• 일에만 몰입이 가능한 당충전 간식 지원
• 종합검진 인당 연 30만원
• 약국 전제품 직원가 구매

title: Divisional Finance Officer Continental Europe
description:
Divisional Finance Officer – Continental Europe

Shape the future of Finance across Continental Europe

We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded Divisional Finance Officer (DFO) to partner with the Continental Europe leadership team and play a pivotal role in driving financial performance, business insight, and transformation across the region.

Reporting to the Europe CFO, this role sits at the heart of the CE business, working closely with the CE President, Business Heads, Country Leaders, and key Finance stakeholders to provide high-impact financial leadership, actionable insight, and decision support. This is a unique opportunity for a finance leader who combines strong technical expertise with commercial acumen, influencing skills, and a passion for finance data transformation.

The successful candidate will not only oversee the financial performance of the region, but also help modernise reporting, improve data quality, enhance analytics, and support the evolution of Finance operating models and management information.

What you will do

As CE Divisional Finance Officer, you will:

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the CE Regional President, Business Heads, and Country Leaders, providing tactical and strategic financial guidance to support business growth and performance.
  • Lead financial planning, forecasting, actuals, and performance analysis across the region, ensuring robust insight and clear commentary for senior leadership.
  • Own and oversee the CE P&L, helping the business understand performance versus plan, prior year, and forecast.
  • Partner closely with Underwriting, Pricing, Actuarial, Operations, Claims, Credit Control, and other Finance teams to drive informed decision-making.
  • Manage and control regional expenses, including direct costs, accruals, prepayments, allocated costs, and headcount.
  • Deliver high-quality management information, broker analysis, production reporting, and other key performance metrics.
  • Support executive and board-level reporting with accurate, timely, and insightful financial presentations.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting policies and controls, including Sarbanes requirements and other governance processes.
  • Act as local Finance lead on ad hoc projects, including finance systems change and transformation initiatives.
  • Lead and develop the CE DFO team and Finance Managers, fostering strong collaboration, accountability, and performance.

Why this role is exciting

This is more than a traditional finance leadership role. It is an opportunity to:

  • Influence strategic decisions at regional and European level
  • Drive better business performance through sharper insight and stronger financial partnering
  • Improve finance processes, reporting, and operational efficiency
  • Contribute to the transformation of Finance data, analytics, and management reporting
  • Help shape a more modern, data-led finance function across Continental Europe

What we are looking for

We are seeking an experienced finance leader who brings:

  • Strong senior finance experience in a complex, international, matrixed environment
  • Proven ability to partner with senior business leaders and influence decisions
  • Deep understanding of P&L management, forecasting, planning, and performance analysis
  • Strong commercial mindset and the ability to translate data into actionable insight
  • Experience in management reporting, financial controls, and executive-level communication
  • A track record of improving finance processes, reporting, and business performance
  • Exposure to data transformation environments, with experience working in or alongside teams driving finance data, reporting, systems, or analytics transformation
  • Ideally, experience within the insurance sector, or a strong understanding of insurance business dynamics, financial drivers, and operating models
  • Confidence working with large and complex data sets, and an interest in improving data quality, automation, and reporting efficiency
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage, develop, and inspire teams

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate will be:

  • A credible and influential finance business partner
  • Comfortable operating at both strategic and hands-on levels
  • Analytical, curious, and solutions-oriented
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Motivated by transformation, continuous improvement, and delivering measurable impact

title: Bidding Strategies Algo Team Leader
description:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!

As a Team Leader on the Bidding Strategies Algo team in our TLV Office, you'll play a vital role in shaping how Advertisers bid in real-time auctions at massive scale. You will lead the optimization of our existing bidding strategies and the design of new ones, formulating bidding problems mathematically, applying control-theoretic methods, and analyzing the complex dynamics of a closed-loop. By guiding team members and partnering closely with engineering, you'll turn theoretical insights into robust production solutions. Your work will directly influence advertiser ROI efficiency across thousands of advertisers.

To thrive in this role, you'll need:

  • Advanced academic training (MSc/PhD) with strong grounding in applied mathematics, optimization, control theory, or a related quantitative field
  • Strong Algorithmic Problem-Solving Experience (6+ years), and 2+ years of Managerial or Technical Leadership Experience
  • Production-Grade Algorithm Engineering Experience
  • Experience Driving Measurable Business Impact Through Algorithmic Improvements
  • Experience interfacing effectively with engineering teams to deliver complex algorithms into production
  • Experience leveraging agent-based coding tools to accelerate development, experimentation, and code quality

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Real-Time Bidding, Auction Theory

How you'll make an impact:

  • Lead the optimization of Taboola's existing bidding strategies
  • Design and deliver new bidding strategies end-to-end into production
  • Drive deep analysis of complex dynamics and closed-loop feedback effects
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to deliver robust, scalable systems
  • Lead and develop algorithm engineers
  • Play a part of Taboola's tech organization's growth in the agentic development era

Why Taboola?

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:

Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says:
"You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture."

Well-being: Enjoy comprehensive benefits and well-being programs tailored to the region, a fully stocked kitchen, and location-specific perks.

Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office, with an option to come in more often if desired.

Work with some of the biggest names: Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Condé Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, and Expedia.

Ready to realize your potential?

Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, & the Taboola Life Blog.

About Taboola

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.

Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.
