title: Snowflake Engineer
description:
About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with strong expertise in Python, Matillion, and Snowflake to design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data warehouse solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in ETL/ELT development, data modeling, and cloud data engineering while working in an agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Matillion.
  • Build and optimize data warehouse solutions on Snowflake.
  • Develop robust data processing frameworks and automation scripts using Python.
  • Create and maintain data models, transformations, and workflows to support business analytics.
  • Optimize Snowflake performance, including query tuning, clustering, and warehouse management.
  • Integrate data from multiple structured and unstructured sources.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver high-quality data solutions.
  • Implement data quality, validation, monitoring, and error-handling mechanisms.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and production support activities.
  • Follow best practices for security, governance, and documentation.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python, Matillion, and Snowflake.
  • Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills with experience in query optimization.
  • Good understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional data modeling.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving
  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.
  • Exposure to DBT is an added advantage.
  • Knowledge of REST APIs and data integration techniques.
  • Familiarity with data governance and security best practices.

title: Asbestipurkaja
description:
Etsimme ASBESTIPURKAJIA asiakasyrityksillemme.

Etsimällämme asbestisaneeraajalla on aiempaa kokemusta asbestipurkutöistä sekä voimassa olevat pätevyydet. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu asbestimateriaalien turvallinen poisto ja käsittely. Omalla ammattitaidollasi vastaat siitä, että asbestipurkutyöt suoritetaan asianmukaisesti säädösten mukaisesti.

TYÖSSÄ VAADITAAN:

* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia sekä voimassa olevat asbestipurkutöihin vaadittavat pätevyydet
* Omatoimista otetta tarttua työtehtäviin itsenäisesti
* Aikaisempaa kokemusta vastaavista työtehtävistä

TARJOAMME SINULLE:

* TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan, jossa palkka tulisi olemaan 14,00-19,50€/h
* Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.

* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian!

Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä arkisin klo 9-15 Hennalta p. 050 449 9284 / henna.kalaoja@worker.fi

title: System Architect, Automotive - Gothenburg
description:
About SEGULA Technologies

SEGULA Technologies is part of the SEGULA Technologies Group, a global engineering company with more than 15,000 employees across 30 countries. Together, they are involved in a wide range of important projects, leveraging extensive expertise and experience to develop the technologies of tomorrow.

As a consultant at SEGULA Technologies, you will have the opportunity to gain experience across a variety of industries and technical fields. They offer the chance to build valuable professional experience, expand your network, and work in exciting environments with well-known brands.

SEGULA Technologies is always looking for new, brilliant, and bold talent. What are you passionate about? Take on your next challenge with SEGULA!

For more information, visit them at: https://www.segulatechnologies.com/en/

About the role

SEGULA Technologies is looking for an experienced System Architect to join its engineering team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will play a key part in defining end-to-end software deployment solutions for connected vehicle platforms, with a particular focus on remote software download, connectivity, and uptime services.

Working closely with fellow system architects and stakeholders across production, aftermarket, and product development, you will analyze requirements, define technical concepts, and contribute to the architecture of future software deployment solutions. You will also ensure that proposed concepts are documented, anchored within governance forums, and aligned across the organization.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly experienced architect who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while collaborating across multiple engineering disciplines.

Key Responsibilities

• Collaborate with other system architects to define end-to-end software deployment solutions.

• Analyze business and technical requirements together with stakeholders across production, aftermarket, and development.

• Break down requirements into scalable technical concepts and architectural solutions.

• Lead concept development and support technical decision-making within assigned areas.

• Present and anchor proposed concepts in governance forums for review and approval.

• Document architectural concepts, technical decisions, and decision logs for future reference.

• Apply technical expertise to analyze complex challenges and areas of uncertainty.

• Execute architectural activities according to established plans, priorities, and technical directives.

• Contribute to a collaborative engineering environment by supporting colleagues and sharing technical knowledge.

Location: Gothenburg

Employment type: Full-time, Permanent

Employment start date: As agreed with Segula

Profile - who are we looking for?

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related field.

• 12+ years of relevant professional experience.

• Recognized expert within your technical discipline.

• Strong knowledge of remote software download (Over-the-Air / OTA) solutions.

• Strong knowledge of connectivity services and functions.

• Experience working with both onboard and offboard systems related to software deployment.

• Experience collaborating with stakeholders across production, aftermarket, and product development.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within an architectural team.

• Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Desirable:

• Experience defining end-to-end software deployment architectures.

• Experience performing technical requirement analysis and concept development.

• Experience documenting architectural concepts and technical decision logs.

• Experience presenting and anchoring technical concepts in governance forums.

SEGULA Technologies offers

  • Exciting assignments with Sweden’s leading industrial companies

  • Collective agreement

  • Health insurance

  • Childcare benefit (parental benefit)

  • Pension benefits, including flexible pension options

  • Discounts through our benefits platform on gym memberships, fitness equipment, massage, insurance (supplementary insurance or health protection), pension and savings plans (additional contributions or savings products), transportation and travel, as well as lifestyle benefits (discounts on culture, entertainment, and shopping)

  • Training and professional development opportunities through e-learning

  • Computer glasses

Application & Contact

Please note that applications and interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Therefore, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

We are committed to a recruitment process free from discrimination and bias. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, gender identity or expression, age, ethnicity, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual orientation, or background.

To apply, click on “Submit application” and complete our AI-powered interview. It is a quick and easy way for us to get to know you and your experience, while giving you the opportunity to show us who you are.

The recruitment process

When you apply, you will be invited to complete an AI-powered interview with Hubert related to the position. The next step is a digital legal background check conducted through Fortcheck. After this, reference checks will be carried out digitally using Refensa. Following these steps, SEGULA Technologies will take over the recruitment process. Please note that the role may be filled before the application deadline.

title: Senior Analyst Engineer - Intelligence Management
description:
At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year.

Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year.

The Product Operations team exists to make Product demand absorbable at scale — predictable, sustainable, and governed by a clear operating system, so the business can expand without growing chaos. We run on three principles: intelligence over reporting, flow over heroics, and governance over guesswork.

Intelligence Management is the layer that turns signals into decisions. We instrument the operating system with data, automation, and AI — surfacing risks, opportunities, and pace deviations, and delivering insight that leaders consume directly, without routing a request through an analyst. We move value down the decision lifecycle — Data → Dashboard → Insights → Intelligence → Action — and remove manual toil from the loop, concentrating human judgement where it matters the most.

You:

  • You are a highly autonomous, technically credible professional who turns messy operational reality into trustworthy intelligence that leaders and teams act on.
  • You own and define the approach for ambiguous, high-impact problems — from "what is actually happening across the roadmap?" to automate this loop end-to-end.
  • You build the signals, systems, and automated insight that strengthen decision quality and speed, partnering, influencing, and challenging senior leaders with evidence so the department meets its yearly goals with margin instead of heroics.
  • You have a good financial acumen and are familiar with ROI metrics.

Your Day to Day:

In this role, you will autonomously partner with and challenge Product leaders (Directors and above), using data and automation to accelerate decisions and reduce the manual overhead of running the department and create intelligence. You will lead end-to-end or advise according to context, from initial problem framing through to sustained adoption. Your work centers on three pillars:

Intelligence Builder — turning signals into decisions

  • Design, build, and operate the signals, dashboards, and automated insights that leaders consume directly — without routing a request through an analyst or ops person.
  • Own data quality and trust: every number is accurate and traceable, with documented calculation logic. The intelligence layer is only as credible as the data beneath it.
  • Make monitoring self-serviceable — roadmap progress, goal execution, and risk emergence surfaced by default, with human oversight reserved for genuinely complex cases.
  • Pair closely with Engineering on upstream instrumentation, defining what data matters and what problems it must solve.

Decision Partner — challenging and enabling leaders

  • Translate operational data into decision-ready narratives for senior leadership forums: what is happening, what it means, and what decision it calls for.
  • Challenge PMs, EMs, and PLT with evidence when the data contradicts intuition, acting as a neutral third party in the debate.
  • Map and provide the insights that support investment and capacity trade-offs, using historical productivity and capacity data as reference.
  • Partner with Delivery Operations and Organizational Effectiveness so intelligence flows into the operating rhythm and the leadership narrative, rather than sitting in a dashboard.

Automation Force Multiplier — removing toil, reclaiming judgment

  • Roll out AI and agentic workflows that trigger alerts and action requests to the right individuals, plus push/pull context systems filtered by audience (PLT, ELT, management, all).
  • Automate governance and reporting workflows with measurable ROI in hours reclaimed.
  • Set standards and best practices for AI-assisted analytical work, modelling AI-first ways of working for the wider team to follow.

You Have & You Know-how:

  • 5–7 years in data/analytics, decision intelligence, analytics engineering, or a similar role with direct engagement with senior stakeholders, ideally in fast-paced B2B Engineering/Product environments.
  • Strong hands-on data skills: performant SQL and Python (Pandas), data modelling, pipelines/ETL, and building self-service data products — comfort turning messy inputs into trustworthy signals.
  • Demonstrated ability to design automated insight and monitoring systems people actually consume, with data-quality and governance rigour (documented metric logic, no "magic numbers").
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence without authority, simplify complexity, and translate split information into clear narratives for different audiences (from junior ICs to senior leadership); confident challenging senior stakeholders with evidence.
  • Solid knowledge of business financials (general concepts — ROI, cost, margin) and the judgment to distinguish a genuine risk signal from noise.
  • Ability to operate with autonomy and judgment on ambiguous mandates, owning problems end-to-end from framing through to sustained adoption — a can-do bias that treats ambiguity as an invitation, not a blocker.
  • Proficiency in collaborative and BI tooling (e.g., Google Suite, Confluence/Jira, Looker), with AI as your default way of working — you use GenAI and agentic workflows as a force multiplier, not an occasional assistant.
  • Learner by nature: high learning agility and a growth mindset — you actively seek what you don't know, especially in emerging AI and automation, and turn it into capability for the team.
  • Prior experience in pricing and monetization projects (Plus)

The Product department builds our product to disrupt the financial crime industry from a data-led approach. We partner with our clients using a holistic lens and have result-driven solutions to manage financial risk with a cloud-first platform and a world-class UX interface. Being part of this team, you have a voice in planning, strategizing, and challenging the status quo. Your thoughts and ideas are valued. Our fast-paced and open environment encourages us to lean in, try new things, and discover our potential. We define and act on what could be in tomorrow's world, not on what is today. Join Us!

#LI-Remote #LI-MG3

Your First 30-Days at Feedzai:

You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one-on-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. In addition, you will have access to a ton of information to give you history, context, and all the knowledge you can handle about Feedzai and the team. Finally, you will start working on projects and collaborating on work currently being done. We can't wait to have you join the team!

Life at Feedzai Instagram

Feedzai Culture

Feedzai is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Feedzai does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.

title: Erityisluokanopettaja 1.-2.lk, Simonkallion koulu
description:
Vantaan kaupunki, Kasvatus ja oppiminen, Perusopetus
Simonkallion koulu

Simonkalliontie 1, 01350 Vantaa

Työsuhteen kesto: Määräaikainen 13.08.2026 - 31.07.2027

Hei sinä työstäsi innostunut ammattitaitoinen opettaja!

Haemme erityisluokanopettajaa iloiseen joukkoomme ja osaksi erityisopetuksen tiimiä. Avoinna oleva määräaikainen tehtävä sijoittuu 1.-2.luokan oppilaiden erityisluokkaan (yhdysluokka). Luokassa työskentelee työparinasi koulunkäynninohjaaja. Olet osa ammattitaitoista erityisopetuksen tiimiä, jossa pääset tekemään yhteistyötä ja kehittämään omaa osaamistasi johdon vahvalla tuella. Haluamme auttaa sinua onnistumaan.

Erityisluokanopettajana ylläpidät hyvää luokkahenkeä ja näet oppilaat yksilöinä. Vaativassa arjessa toimintapoihisi kuuluvat positiivinen vahvistaminen, oppilaskohtaisten tukitoimien suunnittelu ja toteutus sekä muuttuvien tilanteiden rauhallinen hallinta. Työkalupakistasi löytyy monipuolisia pedagogisia toimintatapoja vaativissa työtehtävissä, toimit tilanteissa ratkaisukeskeisellä työotteella ja olet oma-aloitteinen työyhteisön jäsen. Osaat tehdä yhteistyötä joustavasti ja lapsen etua ajatellen.

Vastineeksi tarjoamme työyhteisön, jossa on lämmin ja arvostava työskentelyilmapiiri. Simonkallion koulu on noin 550 oppilaan alakoulu, joka on juuri kokenut perusteellisen peruskorjauksen ja voit toteuttaa opetusta täysin uusituissa ja nykyaikaisissa työtiloissa.

Oppilaitamme luotsaa koulupolulla tällä hetkellä 36 ammattitaitoista opettajaa, 8 koulunkäynninohjaajaa, kuraattori, terveydenhoitaja, koulupsykologi ja koulun muu henkilökunta. Toimimme arjessa luokka-aste-tiimeinä ja tiimityöskentelylle on varattu viikoittain aikaa. Koulussamme toimivat alueelliset musiikkiluokat 3.-6. ja kaksi valmistavan opetuksen alueellista ryhmää.

Olemme Prokoulu ja ohjaamme käyttäytymistä ratkaisukeskeisellä työotteella. Koko kouluyhteisön hyvinvointi on toimintamme kulmakivi ja meillä on aktiivista toimintaa koulu- ja työhyvinvoinnin ylläpitämiseksi lukuvuoden ympäri. Luokissa harjoitellaan tunne-ja vuorovaikutustaitoja viikoittaisilla hyvinvointitunneilla. Koulussamme toimii aktiivinen Kivatiimi sekä kiusaamistapausten ennaltaehkäisyssä että tilanteiden selvittelyssä.

Erityisluokanopettajilla kelpoisuus virkaan huomioidaan lisänä kokonaispalkkauksessa. Viran hoitamisen edellytykset täyttäville erityisluokanopettajille voidaan maksaa palkanlisää.

[Tutustu Simonkallion koulun toimintaan](https://sivistysvantaa.fi/simonkallionkoulu/index.html) ja tule osaksi meidän Simpparin porukkaa!

Miksi valita Vantaa?

Vantaa on maamme neljänneksi suurin kaupunki, jossa on rohkeutta tehdä asioita uudella tavalla ja taitoa toimia yhteistyössä erilaisissa verkostoissa. Kaupunki on turvallinen työnantaja, joka tarjoaa henkilöstölle laajat mahdollisuudet osaamisen kehittämiseen. Nykyaikaisissa oppilaitoksissamme arvostetaan laadukkaan kasvatuksen ja opetuksen lisäksi kansainvälisyyttä, monikulttuurisuutta ja yhteisöllisyyttä.

Tule opettajaksi Vantaalle! [Tutustu opettajan työhön Vantaa.fi:ssä.](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/tyo-perusopetuksessa-ja-toisella-asteella)

Vantaan kaupunki tarjoaa työntekijöilleen monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, kuten liikunta-, hyvinvointi- ja kulttuuriedun, lounasedun ja työmatkaedun julkisen liikenteen käyttöön. Tuemme henkilöstön hyvinvointia mahdollistamalla ja tukemalla liikunnallista elämäntapaa. Kaupungin työntekijät voivat hyödyntää mm. uimahallien, kuntosalien ja ryhmäliikunnan sekä hierontayritysten etuhintaisia palveluja. Lisäksi työntekijöille on usein tarjolla alennushintaisia lippuja kaupungin kulttuuritapahtumiin.

Jos jäit vielä pohtimaan, mitä Vantaalla on sinulle tarjottavaa, [käy verkkosivuillamme lukemassa lisää syitä valita Vantaa.](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/kaupunki-ja-paatoksenteko/avoimet-tyopaikat-vantaan-kaupungilla/johtaminen-tyohyvinvointi-ja-henkilostoedut)

Yhteystiedot:

Rehtori

Jokila Minna

040 5889020

minna.jokila@vantaa.fi

title: QA Engineer
description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer who is passionate about delivering reliable, high-quality digital experiences to millions of FT readers worldwide. You’ll play a key role across two of our customer facing teams, ensuring our products are robust, performant. Helping us maintain the premium experience expected across our web, mobile, and backend platforms.

Working across web, mobile, APIs, and backend services, this role is initially centred around hands-on manual and exploratory testing, while also offering the opportunity to help shape and grow our automation capabilities over time. We’re looking for someone who enjoys understanding how products work end-to-end, is proactive in identifying risks and edge cases, and is excited by the opportunity to evolve testing practices through tooling, automation, and continuous improvement. Improving collaboration between product, engineering, and design, and supporting a culture of shared ownership for quality across the teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Own quality for features from refinement through to release, helping define testable acceptance criteria and appropriate test coverage
  • Perform manual, exploratory, smoke, and regression testing across web, mobile, API, and backend systems
  • Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases and defect reports
  • Use tools such as Postman, browser developer tools to investigate issues and support release decisions
  • Support production issues and customer-reported bugs by working closely with your scrum teams
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, high-value, or regression-heavy scenarios
  • Help evolve QA practices, tooling, and automation capabilities across the team
  • Identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency and release confidence through automation and smarter testing approaches
  • Contribute to automated test coverage using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or similar frameworks
  • Communicate quality risks, test coverage, and release readiness clearly to stakeholders across engineering and product

Contribute to Team Delivery

  • Participate actively in agile ceremonies including refinement, planning, retrospectives, Scrum, and Kanban processes
  • Advocate for quality throughout the development lifecycle by helping shape clear acceptance criteria and testable user stories
  • Contribute to release readiness discussions by communicating risks, trade-offs, and test coverage clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Work collaboratively across engineering, product, and support teams to foster a strong culture of quality ownership

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong experience in manual, exploratory, smoke, regression, and functional testing within agile teams
  • A good understanding of QA methodologies, risk-based testing, and shift-left quality practices
  • Experience testing web, iOS, Android, APIs, and integrated systems
  • Hands-on experience with API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent
  • Ability to design pragmatic test strategies and comprehensive test cases across different scenarios
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to spot risks, gaps, and edge cases early
  • An interest in automation and a desire to grow skills in tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or similar
  • Good communication skills and confidence working across engineering, product, and support teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience contributing to test automation frameworks
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern delivery practices
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Testmo, BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or AWS Device Farm
  • Ability to influence QA practices and promote a strong culture of quality ownership across team

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. title: AI Product Engineer
description:
We've been building digital products for over 10 years, with a strong focus on Blockchain-based applications. At 4soft, people come first - it's our team of passionate technologists that enables us to work with international clients and deliver innovative solutions. We believe in transparency, effective teamwork, and achieving real business outcomes for those we serve.

Want to work on AI-powered tools that help compliance teams investigate crypto transactions faster and with greater confidence? Growth and a great team culture matter to you? 4soft is the perfect place to find both.

Tech environment: TypeScript, Node.js, LangChain, LangGraph, AWS, PostgreSQL, LLM frameworks

As an AI Product Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Building and maintaining AI-powered features and agentic workflows using LLM frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph, enabling compliance teams to make faster, more confident decisions

  • Designing prompts, tool integrations, and retrieval pipelines that turn complex blockchain data into useful answers for investigators

  • Ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of AI systems - developing and running evaluations, and weighing trade-offs across cost, latency, and quality

  • Strengthening pipeline reliability, observability, and automation through continuous improvements to code and tooling

  • Designing and building the backend services, APIs, and event-driven systems that support these features, using TypeScript and Node.js

  • Collaborating closely with product managers, domain experts, web engineers, and your engineering lead to take features from prototype through to production

  • Keeping up with the fast-moving AI landscape: new frameworks, agentic patterns, and automation techniques - bringing relevant insights to the team

What we expect from you:

  • +6 years of software engineering experience, with at least 1-2 years of meaningful production work building LLM-powered features

  • Practical knowledge of LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar

  • Practical understanding of prompt engineering, tool/function calling, subagents, structured outputs, and managing context windows

  • Strong backend skills in TypeScript / Node.js, with solid API design.

  • Experience evaluating LLM outputs and iterating on prompts/pipelines, including using observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or similar)

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure - AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, or similar)

  • Understanding of architectural trade-offs specific to LLM systems: cost vs latency vs quality, deterministic vs probabilistic behaviour

  • English proficiency at C1 level or above (for international client collaboration)

  • Polish language skills at B2 level or above (for smooth communication with the team)

Great if you also bring:

  • Experience with agentic patterns: planning, multi-step reasoning, tool use loops

  • Hands-on work with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation)

  • Knowledge of container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm)

  • Experience working with multiple model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, open-weight models)

  • Experience with observability platforms like Datadog (metrics, tracing, alerting)

  • Distributed or event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS, etc.)

  • An interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain, or compliance, or a desire to learn

What helps us stay balanced:

  • Grow your skills and hobbies with us - make use of a dedicated training and wellbeing budget

  • Work from home or the office - your choice, up to 100% remote

  • Access to specialists whenever you need them via our LuxMed healthcare package

  • If the gym is your second home, activate a Multisport card with us

  • Looking for a long-term home? You're in the right place - stable collaboration, no dress code, no heavy atmosphere

  • Our team knows how to have fun: board games, city outings, go-kart races, laser tag, great food on team retreats - we take integration seriously (in the best way :)

title: Teollisuuseristäjä
description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme TEOLLISUUSERISTÄJIÄ 11 viikon kestoiseen projektiin Oulussa!

Olet etsimämme henkilö, jos sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta eristystöistä ja/tai sinulla on kokemusta peltisepäntöistä.

Työhön kuuluu eristyksien tekeminen teollisuuskohteessa. Työ edellyttää kykyä tehdä fyysistä työtä, voimassa olevaa työturvakorttia, sekä aiempaa kokemusta teollisuuseristyksistä ja valmiutta työskennellä korkealla.

Töitä on tarjolla ainakin 11 viikoksi, myös jatko on mahdollinen. Projektin aloitus sijoittuu elokuun puoliväliin.

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana, ja täytämme paikat heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä, joten jätä hakemuksesi pian!


Odotamme sinulta:

* Ahkeraa asennetta ja kykyä fyysiseen työhön
* Voimassaolevaa työturvakorttia
* Aiempaa kokemusta vastaavasta työstä
* Valmiutta tehdä pitkiäkin työpäiviä ja sekä aamu- että iltavuoroja projektin ajan

Eduksi katsotaan myös muu osaaminen rakennusalalta, rakennusalan koulutus sekä muut mahdolliset lupakortit.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle:

* TES:n mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan
* Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka tukee kaikissa työsuhteeseen liittyvissä asioissa


Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.

* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian!

Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä arkisin klo 9-15 Niinalta p. 050 466 3948 / niina.takalahti@worker.fi

Huomioithan, että otamme vastaan ainoastaan hakupainikkeen kautta lähetetyt hakemukset. Emme käsittele esimerkiksi sähköpostilla, WhatsAppilla tai tekstiviestillä lähetettyjä työhakemuksia.

title: KOKKI
description:
PALKATAAN KOKKI MONIPUOLISIIN TEHTÄVIIN, VAKITUISEEN, KOKOAIKAISEEN TYÖSUHTEESEEN

Haemme ammattitaidostaan ylpeää kokkia yksityiseen perheyritykseen hotelli Gustavelundiin. Hotellimme sijaitsee Tuusulanjärven rannalla kauniissa puistomaisemissa, noin 15 min Helsinki-Vantaan lentokentältä ja puolen tunnin ajomatkan päässä Helsingin keskustasta.

Asiakaskuntamme koostuu kokouksissa, koulutuksissa ja erilaisissa yritystapahtumissa kokoontuvista ryhmistä, joille valmistamme kokoustarjoiluja, ryhmäillallisia sekä buffetruokailuja. Toteutamme laadukkaasti ja korkeatasoisesti monipuolisia ja vaihtuvia tuotteita: päivittäin tarjolla on hotelliaamiainen sekä lounas, iltaisin tarjoillaan bankettien lisäksi A la Cartea. Viikonloppuisin tarjoilemme brunsseja, olemme myös suosittu perhejuhlien pitopaikka. Terassillamme kesäkeittiössä valmistetaan grilliruokia ryhmille sekä salaatteja, pizzoja ja hampurilaisia walk-in asiakkaille. Hotellissamme järjestetään festivaalityyppisiä tapahtumia, kuten urheiluautotapaamisia, juhannusjuhla, bändi-iltoja ja varttuneemman väen disco-iltoja. Haluamme tarjota vieraillemme mahdollisimman paljon itse tehtyä ruokaa, leivomme ja valmistamme annoksia tuoreista raaka-aineista.

Työkielenämme on suomi. Toivomme sinulta kausivaihteluiden vuoksi joustavuutta: käytössämme on MaRaTes tasausjärjestelmä. Työskentelemme pääsääntöisesti kahdessa vuorossa, arkisin kello 6.00 - 20.30, viikonloppuisin alkaen kello 7.00 ja päättyen aina kulloisenkin tilaisuuden mukaan. Työ sisältää ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Palkkauksen pohjana on MaRaTes sekä normaalit ilta-, sunnuntai- yms. lisät, Kokemuksen määrän ja laadun mukaan palkka on myös neuvoteltavissa.

Arvostamme asiakaspalvelutaitoja, vastuullisuutta ja vieraanvaraisuutta sekä innostunutta ja innostavaa asennetta. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä ammattikoulutus ovat työssä onnistumisen edellytyksiä. Hakijoilta edellytämme aiempaa kokemusta ravintolan keittiössä työskentelystä sekä hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työpaikan, jatkuvan kehityksen ja uudistuksen alla olevat upeat puitteet, mukavat asiakkaat ja huippuluokan työkaverit. Kanssamme olet mukana kehittämässä toimintaa perheyrityksessä, jossa on helppo tuoda esiin omia näkemyksiä ja ideoita ja osallistua toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Työ alkaa heti.

title: HR-asiantuntija
description:
Haemme HR-asiantuntijaa määräaikaiseen tehtävään Kasvatuksen ja koulutuksen toimialan henkilöstöresurssipalveluihin ajalle 1.9.2026-31.8.2027.

HR-asiantuntijana työskentelet perusopetuksen kumppaniasiantuntijana sekä vastaat tietyistä osaamisen kehittämisen teemoista toimialatasoisesti. Työssäsi tarjoat esihenkilörekrytointeihin ja palvelussuhteen alkuun liittyvää asiantuntijatukea esihenkilöille ja johdolle. Tuet perusopetuksen esihenkilöitä muutostilanteissa sekä henkilöstön rekrytoinnissa ja tehtäviisi kuuluu myös henkilöstöraportointia ja henkilöstösuunnittelua.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset myös rakentamaan ja kehittämään toimialan HRD-kokonaisuutta. Osallistut organisaation HRD-kokonaisuuden määrittelyyn ja kehittämiseen. Varmistat, että osaamisen kehittäminen tukee strategisten tavoitteiden toteutumista. Kehität organisaation käytäntöjä osallistumalla oppivan organisaation mallien ja toimintatapojen kartoittamiseen ja käyttöönottoon sekä kehität ratkaisuja, jotka tukevat jatkuvaa oppimista arjessa.

Tehtävässä osallistut toimialatason HRD-verkoston toimintaan ja tuot siihen asiantuntijuuttasi. Tehtäväkokonaisuus on uusi ja tehtävien painotukset voivat muuttua.

Kasvatuksen ja koulutuksen toimialan henkilöstöresurssipalveluissa tarjoamme sinulle työyhteisön, jossa työskentelet osana motivoitunutta, osaavaa ja suurta asiantuntijaporukkaamme ja tiimiä jossa jokainen saa olla oma itsensä. Vahvuuksiamme ovat hyvä työilmapiiri sekä merkityksellinen ja vaikuttava työ. Kasvatuksen ja koulutuksen toimialan HR:ssä autamme toisiamme, onnistumme yhdessä ja haluamme kehittää toimintakulttuuriamme kohti yhteisöohjautuvuutta. Työskentelemme Kalasatamassa moderneissa ja yhteisöllisyyttä tukevissa työtiloissa.

Meille on tärkeää, että voit tehdä vaikuttavaa työtä hyvän helsinkiläisen elämän eteen. Haluamme, että onnistut ja innostut työssäsi. Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia kasvaa ja kehittyä ammattilaisena. Tuoreimman henkilöstökyselyn mukaan meillä viihdytään ja työ koetaan mielekkääksi!

Sinulta puolestaan toivomme kokemusta osaamisen kehittämisestä ja monipuolisista HR-tehtävistä. Ymmärrät oppivan organisaation periaatteet sekä kykenet edistämään niitä käytännönratkaisuiksi organisaatiossa. Lisäksi arvostamme kokemusta HRD-toimintojen uudistamisesta ja kehittämisestä. Hyvät yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot ovat edellytys verkostomaisessa työskentelytavassamme. Työyhteisön jäsenenä haluat osaltasi edistää yhteisöohjautuvaa työskentelykulttuuria.

Saat käyttöösi Suomen suurimman työnantajan henkilöstöedut, kuten jopa 550 euron Epassi Flex -edun käytettäväksi työmatkoihin sekä kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja hyvinvointipalveluihin. Lue lisää henkilöstöeduistamme ja tutustu Helsingin kaupunkiin työnantajana osoitteessa: https://www.hel.fi/fi/avoimet-tyopaikat/miksi-toihin-kaupungille

Tehtävän tasopalkka on 4270,79 €/kk. Sen lisäksi maksetaan myös mahdollinen työkokemuslisä max. 8 %. Noudatettava sopimusala on KVTES.

Jätäthän hakemuksesi 10.8. klo 16 mennessä. Haastattelut pidetään 12.8. ja 17.8.


Kelpoisuusehto:

Edellytämme soveltuvaa ylempää korkeakoulututkintoa sekä hyvää suomen kielen taitoa ja tyydyttävää ruotsin kielen taitoa.


Tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi Helsingin kaupunki kannustaa anonyymiin rekrytointiin, ja tämä rekrytointi toteutetaan anonyymisti. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin tavoitteena on kohdentaa huomio hakijan ammatilliseen osaamiseen sekä työkokemukseen. Täytä työnhakulomake normaalisti. Huomioi hakemusta kirjoittaessasi, että se noudattaa anonymiteetin periaatteita. Esihenkilö valitsee haastateltavat henkilöt anonyymin yhteenvedon perusteella eikä siinä ole nähtävissä hakijan nimeä, ikää, sukupuolta tai äidinkieltä.

title: Asystent / Asystentka ds. sprzedaży
description:
Nasza sprzedaż pędzi do przodu, dlatego szukamy energii i zaangażowania – ambitnej osoby studiującej, która wejdzie do naszego teamu handlowego, odciąży naszą Team Leaderkę, przejdzie u nas prawdziwą szkołę biznesu i z czasem wyrośnie na samodzielnego asa międzynarodowej sprzedaży.

Dlaczego warto do nas dołączyć właśnie teraz?

  • Rośniemy jak szaleni: Od trzech lat co roku podwajamy nasze obroty (x2 rok do roku!). My nie stoimy w miejscu – my lecimy!
  • Szkoła biznesu w praktyce: Nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę bez koła ratunkowego. Będziesz pracować ramię w ramię z naszą Team Leaderką sprzedaży, ucząc się od podstaw, jak wygląda nowoczesny, międzynarodowy proces B2B.
  • Wychowamy własnego managera: Szukamy kogoś na dłużej. Chcemy Cię wyszkolić i dać Ci narzędzia, byś po studiach (lub w ich trakcie) stał/a się w pełni samodzielnym Account Managerem z własnym portfolio dużych, zagranicznych klientów.
  • Pełna elastyczność: Wiemy, czym są kolokwia i sesja. U nas bez problemu połączysz naukę z pracą – działamy zdalnie i dopasowujemy grafik do Twojego planu zajęć.

🔎 Kogo szukamy?

Szukamy osoby na starcie swojej drogi w biznesie, która ma w sobie naturalną ciekawość, "głód" wiedzy i chce szybko chłonąć praktyczne umiejętności. Nie musisz mieć wieloletniego doświadczenia – najważniejsza jest dla nas Twoja postawa, zaangażowanie i to, czy złapiemy wspólny vibe.


Będzie nam po drodze, jeśli:

  • Posiadasz status studenta i szukasz miejsca, w którym realnie rozwiniesz skrzydła (a nie tylko „odbębnisz” staż).
  • Swobodnie rozmawiasz i piszesz po angielsku oraz polsku (must-have) – działamy międzynarodowo, więc codzienny kontakt z zagranicznymi klientami to u nas standard.
  • Jesteś osobą świetnie zorganizowaną i skrupulatną – potrafisz samodzielnie zarządzać swoim czasem w pracy zdalnej, nie gubisz wątków i dbasz o porządek w dokumentach oraz systemach.
  • Chcesz się uczyć sprzedaży i obsługi klienta B2B – pierwsze doświadczenia w kontakcie z ludźmi (np. obsługa klienta, gastronomia, call center, wolontariaty) będą super atutem, ale najważniejsza jest chęć do nauki.
  • Stawiasz na szczerość i otwartą komunikację – pracujemy zdalnie, więc jasny przepływ informacji to dla nas podstawa. U nas mówi się wprost, co działa, a co nie.

title: SO_IT Operation Engineer
description:
Roles & Responsibilities:

The objective of this role is to manage the onboarding of Windows on-premises infrastructure into enterprise operations by ensuring accurate configuration, CMDB compliance, automation of onboarding activities, documentation and seamless integration with ITSM and monitoring platforms. The role requires strong technical expertise in Windows Server administration, scripting, database management and IT service management processes to deliver standardized, efficient and compliant onboarding services.

Windows Server Onboarding

Perform onboarding of Windows servers into enterprise infrastructure management platforms. Ensure servers comply with organizational standards, security baselines, monitoring, backup, patching and operational requirements. Validate server configurations before production onboarding.

Automation & Scripting

Develop and maintain automation scripts using PowerShell, Batch scripting, and other scripting technologies to streamline onboarding activities. Automate repetitive operational tasks to improve efficiency, consistency and reduce manual effort.

Configuration & CMDB Management

Maintain accurate Configuration Management Database (CMDB) records. Ensure configuration items (CIs) are created, updated and maintained in accordance with ITIL standards. Perform periodic audits to ensure CMDB data accuracy and compliance.

Database Support

Work with MS-SQL Server and Oracle databases to validate application dependencies, execute basic queries, generate reports, and support onboarding activities requiring database integration.

ITSM & Ticket Management

Manage onboarding requests through ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow and T&R. Coordinate with multiple support team for Technical and process related topics.

Documentation & Process Governance

Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), onboarding documentation, knowledge articles and technical runbooks. Identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to operational excellence initiatives.

Stakeholder & Project Coordination

Collaborate with infrastructure, application, database, security, and network teams to ensure successful onboarding of Windows environments. Participate in Onboard planning, status reporting, risk identification and escalation management.

Educational qualification:

· Bachelor’s degree. Preferred computer science/IT graduates

Experience:

2 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Windows Server Administration or Infrastructure Operations. Strong knowledge of Windows Server (2016/2019/2022/2025) administration.

  • Experience in Windows Server onboarding, infrastructure provisioning or platform support. Knowledge of scheduled tasks, remote execution and scripting best practices.

  • Understanding of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Windows Services, and server hardening.

  • Experience working with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow and T&R.

  • Experience in enterprise infrastructure environments supporting large-scale Windows server deployments.

  • Exposure to automation and scripting for infrastructure operations.

Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft Windows Server Experience.

  • Knowledge in

    • ITIL Foundation.

    • Oracle and MS-SQL Database

    • Networking fundamentals

  • Scripting – PowerShell, VBScript, .NET

title: Reception Coordinator
description:
Are you a natural host — someone who lights up when meeting new people, remembers names, and genuinely wants to understand who our clients are? Can you stay warm and composed even when reception gets busy and a queue starts to form? Do you take pride in keeping a space looking and feeling welcoming? If yes, read on!

ABOUT CIC

CIC builds and connects thriving innovation communities around the world. Founded in 1999 in Cambridge, MA, we were one of the first companies to offer flexible office space and coworking. We manage a global network of innovation-focused workspace, laboratories, and event space across North America, Europe, and Asia, and continue to expand globally.

ABOUT CIC ROTTERDAM

Opened in 2016, CIC Rotterdam sits inside the landmark Groot Handelsgebouw, just steps from Rotterdam Central Station. The campus is an active part of the city’s innovation landscape and one of the Leading Start-up hub in Europe — home to entrepreneurs, researchers, and organizations building the future of industry, sustainability, and urban life.

It’s a place where work happens across borders, disciplines, and generations.

Learn more about us here.

ABOUT YOU

CIC is looking for a true host — ideally, someone with experience as a receptionist, concierge, or front desk associate who thrives on connecting with people in a fast-paced environment. Be that great first impression for our many guests and clients. Comfortable flying solo as working as part of a team.

More specifically, you will possess the following characteristics:

  • A natural connector — personable, curious about people, and quick to build rapport with guests and clients.

  • Calm and composed under pressure, especially when reception gets busy or a queue builds up.

  • Detail oriented and organized, with a genuine eye for keeping the reception area tidy, presentable, and welcoming.

  • Self-motivated and proactive in taking ownership and responsibility for tasks and leading them to completion.

  • A team player with the capacity to foster and maintain positive working relationships with clients, colleagues, building management and vendors — equally comfortable working solo at the desk.

  • Comfortable working with everyone, treating everyone equally.

  • Ideas driven, with an interest in taking on administrative projects beyond reception, such as booking meeting rooms for Events or scheduling meetings for Sales.

  • A professional communicator, both verbally and in writing.

  • Able to reliably and conveniently commute to our Rotterdam office to ensure smooth collaboration.

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK

This position will be the welcoming first face and first impression for CIC’s many members, guests, and vendors. You will join our Rotterdam campus, reporting to the Manager Operations, as part of an 11-person Community Team — building real connections with the people who walk through our doors. Some work will be independent, including holding down reception solo at times, while other work will require collaboration with other members of the CIC staff.

Potential responsibilities will include:

  • Overseeing the quality of the front desk experience while demonstrating a proactive desire to assist others and provide excellent, hospitality-driven service.

  • Welcoming guests and providing them with a relaxed and efficient transition to their host.

  • Building genuine connections with guests and clients — in person, on the phone, and via email — taking the time to understand who they are and what they need.

  • Staying calm, gracious, and in control when reception gets busy or a queue forms, keeping the CIC experience smooth for everyone waiting.

  • Being a face of CIC and providing an exceptional first experience for new clients (assist with key distribution, take a photo of new employees, answer questions, etc.)

  • Taking ownership of the reception area’s look and feel — keeping it tidy and presentable, and always looking for ways to make it more welcoming.

  • Comfortable holding the reception desk solo at times, while also working closely with the rest of the team on day-to-day operations, including cross-training other staff.

  • Responding to near constant client requests and questions of every variety. For example, a client may ask “Can I get some extra furniture and have some help rearranging my office?” or “How do I send a package to Japan?”

  • Assisting in processing mail & packages for clients, and helping oversee the condition and organization of the CIC mailroom.

  • Supporting the Events and Sales teams with administrative projects, such as booking meeting rooms or scheduling meetings — a natural way to grow beyond the front desk.

  • Covering operational tasks in the Community Team and beyond as required, identifying operational issues, resolving those within your scope, and escalating when appropriate.

YOU HAVE

  • A MBO or bachelor’s degree or equivalent front desk experience and at least 1 year of professional experience.

  • Flexibility to work between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM when needed, while maintaining a standard full-time schedule.

  • Occasional flexibility to provide reception support during evening events, when needed.

  • Fluency in English and Dutch.

  • The ability to legally work in the Netherlands. CIC is unable to sponsor visas for this role at this time.

  • Nice to have: experience in the hospitality industry.

If you don’t meet all the requirements or qualifications but bring some other unique skills and experience that would be valuable in this role, please apply and highlight those attributes for us in your cover letter.

OUR OFFER

  • Employment contract, full-time, on-site at CIC Rotterdam (Groot Handelsgebouw).

  • Starting salary: €2,750 gross / month, excl. Holiday Allowance.

  • Commuting / Transportation allowance (if living beyond 5 km from the office).

  • Private pension plan.

  • Wellness benefit.

  • Allocated budget for training (customized to specific requirements of the role and organization's objectives).

WHO WE ARE

At CIC, our values aren't a poster on the wall - they shape how we work, how we hire, and how we show up for each other every day. You'll hear about them throughout our recruitment process:

• We are good humans — respect, kindness, and accountability in every interaction

• We are happy to help — we step forward with care, energy, and pride in our work

• We are problem solvers — curious, growth-minded, and always looking for a better way

• We are resilient — steady under pressure and adaptable in the face of change

• We deliver — dependable and results-driven, balancing speed with quality.

Please submit your application in English. Thank you!

CIC welcomes all candidates regardless of race, color, ancestry, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status or disability. If you require an accommodation please let us know. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: Manufacturing Operations Intern
description:
The selected candidate will join the Machining Department within the Manufacturing organization and will support the team in the planning and management of consumable cutting tools used in machining processes.

The main objective of the internship project is to develop a structured forecasting and procurement process for cutting tools, based on sales forecasts and production requirements, with the aim of optimizing inventory levels, ensuring material availability, and reducing the risk of shortages or overstocking.

Main Responsibilities

  • Analyze historical consumption data of cutting tools used in machining operations.
  • Collect and interpret sales forecasts and production plans.
  • Map the relationship between finished products, manufacturing processes, and tool consumption.
  • Develop forecasting models to estimate cutting tool requirements.
  • Support the definition of replenishment policies and inventory management strategies.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Industrial Engineering teams.
  • Monitor key performance indicators related to tool consumption, inventory levels, and material availability.
  • Identify and propose improvement actions to enhance the efficiency of the procurement and planning process.

Internship Project Objectives

At the end of the internship, the candidate will have contributed to the development of a planning system for consumable cutting tools capable of:

  • Forecasting tool demand based on sales projections.
  • Optimizing inventory levels.
  • Improving production continuity and material availability.
  • Supporting purchasing decisions through structured data analysis and forecasting methodologies.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • Strong interest in manufacturing processes and production planning.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems and data analysis tools is considered a plus.

The role connects business users, data owners, technology platforms, and governance standards to enable effective data adoption and regulatory grade data quality. title: Global Mobility & Compliance Specialist
description:

Global Mobility & Compliance Specialist

We are looking for a highly motivated and proactive individual with a strong work ethic, who has experience and is passionate in assisting prospective employees to relocate to Malta, and engage in screening and compliance related activities.

What you will be expected to do:

As a Global Mobility & Compliance Screening Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting the onboarding of international talent from pre-employment screening through to relocation and work authorization in Malta. You will ensure candidates meet the Firm's compliance requirements while also facilitating a smooth immigration and relocation process, acting as a point of contact throughout their onboarding journey.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for, but not limited to:

Immigration & Mobility Management

  • Managing the complete work permit application process for third country nationals, EU citizens, and Maltese citizens;
  • Assisting with relocation and onboarding of international employees, serving as a key point of contact throughout their mobility journey;
  • Ensuring full compliance with Identita’s work permit and visa requirements and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of regulatory changes;
  • Coordinating with Line Management, Legal professionals, and external authorities to facilitate seamless international assignments.

Candidate Screening & Risk Assessment

  • Conduct pre-employment screening and due diligence checks on prospective employees and vendors.
  • Review screening results through relevant compliance platforms and assess potential sanctions, PEP, adverse media, criminal, or regulatory risks.
  • Verify candidate identifiers and investigate possible matches to eliminate false positives.
  • Escalate high-risk findings and maintain audit-ready documentation.

Candidate Experience & Onboarding Support

  • Act as the primary point of contact for international hires throughout screening, immigration and relocation processes.
  • Guide candidates through relocation requirements, housing considerations, tax registration, social security and local administrative requirements.
  • Collaborate with HR, hiring managers and government authorities to ensure a seamless onboarding experience.

Let's talk about you

  • You have 2-3+ years' experience in immigration, compliance screening, employee onboarding, or related operational functions.
  • You possess a strong understanding of Maltese and/or Schengen immigration regulations and work authorization requirements.
  • You have the ability to analyze information critically, validate personal identifiers, and assess potential compliance risks.
  • You are highly organised, capable of managing multiple case files and strict regulatory deadlines simultaneously.
  • You communicate effectively with candidates, government authorities, HR teams and external stakeholders.
  • Experience with compliance screening tools, sanctions screening, due diligence platforms, or background verification processes will be considered an asset.

Our Story

What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for maximum impact. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.

Make the kind of impact that we make for clients only for Deloitte itself. Working alongside the IT, QRM, Finance, Marketing & Growth teams, the HR function is a multidisciplinary team which supports the rest of the firm. We are problem solvers, talent seekers and researchers.

Why Deloitte?

As a Purpose-led organization, at the heart of everything we do is a set of timeless principles that distinguish the Deloitte culture. We foster diversity and inclusion and encourage you to bring your authentic self to work. Explore, question and collaborate while building a career that inspires and energies you. description:

At Blacklane, we're redefining what premium mobility looks like and making it sustainable in the process. As we scale globally, the systems that power our chauffeur network are becoming as important as the experience we deliver to guests. That's where you come in.

We are looking for a Group Product Manager to lead our Chauffeur Domain: the engine behind how chauffeurs join our platform, how supply is managed, how rides are priced and dispatched, and how our marketplace operates at scale. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role at the intersection of operations, data, and product and it's one of the most complex and consequential domains in the company.

What you will own

You will lead a domain of five teams and five Product Managers, each with their own roadmap and KPIs. Your job is to set the direction, sharpen the strategy, and focus on improving the business.

  • Define and drive the product vision and priorities for the Chauffeur Domain, ensuring every team is working on the highest-impact problems
  • Manage, mentor, and grow five Product Managers across different seniority levels
  • Partner closely with engineering, data science, and operations to solve genuinely hard technical problems
  • Balance chauffeur and partner needs against guest experience requirements, making smart trade-offs at pace
  • Stay close to market dynamics and partner behaviour to keep the strategy sharp and the roadmap grounded
  • Serve as the domain's senior voice across the business with leadership, with partners, and with the teams building alongside you

ABOUT YOU

  • 5+ years in product management, with at least 4 years managing Product Managers
  • A track record of owning complex product domains end-to-end and shipping data-driven improvements that moved the needle
  • Strong analytical instincts, you're comfortable in the data and know how to use it to make decisions and influence others
  • Excellent communication skills, whether you are aligning a cross-functional team or presenting strategy to the executive team
  • Experience working in fast-paced, technically complex environments where the problems don't come with obvious answers

Why this role

The Chauffeur Domain is where supply meets demand, where technology meets operations, and where getting it right has a direct impact on Blacklane's ability to grow. About Blacklane

Our mission is simple but powerful: to become the world’s leading premium, global chauffeur service. Operating in 50+ countries, we reimagine chauffeur-driven rides by prioritizing reliability, innovation, and first-class service at every step. Blacklane is also at the forefront of sustainable mobility efforts, continuously working to reduce our operational impact on the planet.

We support our people through initiatives like Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), mentorship programs that bring our values to life.

We welcome—and actively support—employees to create or join the communities that are important to them.

description:
Vill du vara med och bygga framtidens privata moln – och utvecklas som tekniker? Skatteverket befinner sig i en unik expansionsfas där vi inte bara utvecklar vår egen IT – vi bygger och levererar infrastrukturtjänster till flera myndigheter i Sverige. Just nu utvecklar vi nästa generations privata molnplattform, samtidigt som vi etablerar en AI‑verkstad för både intern och extern användning. Det här är en miljö där du får möjlighet att både lära dig snabbt och jobba med modern teknik i stor skala. Upptäck ett mångsidigt uppdrag!

Om jobbet

Du blir en del av avdelningen Skatteverkets tekniska tjänster(STT) med cirka 500 medarbetare. Du ingår i ett team inom server, virtualisering och lagring som ansvarar för vår IaaS‑plattform.

Som tekniker får du arbeta nära erfarna kollegor och successivt bygga upp din kompetens inom virtualisering. Du arbetar med drift, förvaltning och vidareutveckling av vår virtualiseringsplattform i en komplex It-miljö. Du samarbetar med andra teknikområden som nätverk, lagring och plattform och tillsammans bidrar ni till förbättringar och automatisering av arbetssätt. Dessutom är du med och utvecklar vår privata molnplattform.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att lära dig av erfarna specialister inom virtualisering och cloud och möjlighet att arbeta med teknik som ligger nära private cloud, automation och containerplattformar. Utöver spännande tekniska möjligheter erbjuder vi en god balans mellan arbete.

Skatteverkets it-avdelning arbetar aktivt för att främja en inkluderande arbetsplats som präglas av jämställdhet och mångfald där alla medarbetare får lika möjligheter att bidra och utvecklas. Läs mer på Jobba med it hos oss

Du kommer att ha placeringsort Malmö eller Sundbyberg.

Om dig

För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss på Skatteverket behöver du vara lyhörd, tänka nytt och ta ansvar. I arbetet är gott omdöme och förståelse för rättssäkerhet och säkerhet viktigt. Du ska också leva upp till vår medarbetarpolicy.

I det här jobbet ska du:

  • ha god samarbetsförmåga, vara hjälpsam och ha ett gott bemötande
  • ha förmågan och viljan att lära dig nya saker, vara flexibel och öppen för förändringar
  • ta initiativ, tänka nytt och ta ställning i frågor
  • självständigt planera och driva ditt arbete framåt för att nå resultat
  • uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska

Du ska även ha:

  • något års aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet virtualisering
  • arbetslivserfarenhet inom nätverk (routing och switching)
  • relevant erfarenhet av containerteknik

Det är önskvärt om du har erfarenhet VCF och Infrastructure as Code. Automation är även önskvärt.

Bra att veta

Anställningen är tillsvidare och kan inledas med provanställning i sex månader.

En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.

På skatteverket.se/jobb kan du exempelvis läsa om vår samhällsbärande roll, fördelarna med att jobba hos oss och hur det går till när du söker våra jobb.

När du ansöker bifogar du ditt cv. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar och du ska därför inte bifoga det i din ansökan.

Ansvariga kontaktpersoner har begränsad tillgänglighet under semesterperioden. Om du önskar komma i kontakt med någon av oss, maila oss gärna så hjälper vi dig vidare. Intervjuer planeras att genomföras under vecka 36 och 37.

För att söka tjänsten vänligen klicka på, eller kopiera, länken nedan för att komma vidare till ansökningsformuläret. Referensnummer 2026/569

You are applying for: Virtualiseringstekniker – Private Cloud & VMware

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Skatteverket har en samhällsbärande roll. Vårt arbete berör alla privatpersoner och företag och genom vårt uppdrag bidrar vi till ett väl fungerande samhälle. Vår utveckling är kunddriven och vi samverkar med andra för att skapa effektiva lösningar. Tillsammans gör vi samhället möjligt.

title: Produktägare av ITSM-verktyg
description:
Är du en erfaren Produktägare av ITSM-vertyg som har stor vana att följa ITIL-processer? Då har du har du hittat rätt.

Vår kund söker nu en erfaren Produktägare som vill leda införandet, utvecklingen och den långsiktiga förvaltningen av ett nytt ITSM-verktyg. Rollen innebär att agera bryggan mellan verksamhet, IT, leverantörer och utvecklingsteam, med ansvar för produktvision, roadmap, backloggprioritering och kravhantering. Du säkerställer att lösningen stödjer verksamhetens behov, följer ITIL-processer och uppfyller krav på säkerhet, kvalitet och regelverk. Uppdraget omfattar även att etablera ett nytt produktområde och skapa förutsättningar för en framtida överlämning till intern förvaltning.

I rollen som Produktägare kommer du att ha nära samarbete med initiativledare, förändringsledare, kravanalytiker, testledare, processledare, tekniska specialister, leverantörer, användare och intressenter av ITSM-verktyget. Du förväntas ha god förståelse för både ITIL-processer och digital produktutveckling samt kunna omsätta strategiska och operativa behov till tydliga krav, prioriterade backloggar och genomförbara leveranser. Rollen kräver stark kommunikativ förmåga, god helhetssyn och erfarenhet av att fatta välgrundade prioriteringsbeslut i miljöer med många intressenter.

Uppdraget är ett konsultuppdrag på 12 månader. Placering: Stockholm, uppdraget möjliggör för närvarande arbete på både distans och på plats på kontoret.

Arbetsuppgifter

· Ansvara för produktvision, målbild och roadmap för ITSM-verktyget

· Prioritera och förvalta backlogg utifrån verksamhetsnytta, tekniska beroenden, risker och regelkrav

· Samla in, analysera och tydliggöra behov från verksamhet, IT och förvaltningsorganisation

· Formulera epics, features, user stories, acceptanskriterier och prioriterade krav

· Säkerställa att utveckling och konfiguration stödjer etablerade ITIL-processer

· Samarbeta nära med Tech Lead, utvecklare, processägare, arkitekter, säkerhetsfunktioner och leverantörer

· Följa upp leveranser, nyttorealisering, användarupplevelse och kvalitet

· Bidra till styrning, beslutsunderlag, förvaltningsplanering och releaseplanering

· Säkerställa att lösningen följer krav på informationssäkerhet, dataskydd, tillgänglighet, spårbarhet och offentlig förvaltningsbarhet.

Krav

Minst åtta (8) års erfarenhet inom IT, verksamhetsutveckling, produktägarskap, systemförvaltning eller ITSM som inkluderat backlogghantering och prioritering.

Minst tre (3) års erfarenhet som produktägare, objektspecialist, förvaltningsledare eller projektledare.

Minst tre (3) års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete med ITIL-processer, minimum Incident, Problem, Change, Release och Configuration management samt ha förståelse för Asset och Request Management.

Minst tre (3) års erfarenhet av arbete med hantering av krav, behovsanalys och strategisk planering.

Minst tre (3) års erfarenhet av minst två (2) av följande områden: CMDB, Asset Management, självbetjäningsportaler, automatisering eller ärendeflöden.

Minst tre (3) års erfarenhet av koordinering mellan flera parallella initiativ, tekniska beroenden eller programarbete.

Dokumenterad arbetslivserfarenhet med minst två (2) års erfarenhet inom offentlig verksamhet i större organisationer (minst 500 anställda), med både upphandlade och interna leveranser.

Meriterande

Konsulten är ITIL-certifierad. Kommentera gärna vilken certifiering, t ex ITIL 4.

Konsulten är certifierad eller utbildad inom Scrum eller agila arbetssätt.

Kan detta vara ett uppdrag som passar dig?

Sök redan i dag eller kontakta oss så berättar vi gärna mer. Vi behöver en ansökan inkluderat CV och personligt brev på svenska som matchar vår kunds krav. Kunden kan fatta beslut tidigare än sista ansökningsdatum, urval och intervjuer sker löpande. NXT Interim och NXT Rekrytering är ett nischat och innovativt företag som är verksamma inom konsult och rekryteringsbranschen.

Vi är verksamma inom HR, IT, Ekonomi, Sälj och Marknad och har över 20 års erfarenhet i branschen. Vi erbjuder våra konsulter bl.a sjukförsäkring, remote-arbetsplatser och flera andra förmåner som förgyller deras vardag. Vid anställning tillämpar vi kollektivavtal.

title: Production & QA Assistant
description:
We invite you to come grow with us.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignite's global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation & Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production & QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Role: Production & QA Assistant - India Design Studio

Team: India Design Studio

The Production & QA Assistant is a foundational role in the Design Studio, combining junior production support, independent checklist-based QA and workflow administration. You will help protect design time, strengthen delivery discipline and ensure that files are accurate, organised and ready for client or business use.

What you will do

  • Apply approved templates and complete basic formatting or production updates to slides, documents and supporting materials.
  • Perform independent QA after the designer has completed their self-check, reviewing formatting, alignment, pagination, footnotes, spelling, grammar, consistency, brand application, accessibility and template compliance.
  • Record QA findings clearly and return issues to the designer or Senior Designer for correction; the role supports quality control but does not replace designer or business-owner accountability.
  • Check briefs and source files for completeness and flag gaps before work begins.
  • Log requests, update workflow trackers and maintain an accurate record of status, turnaround, rework, feedback and common quality issues.
  • Manage file naming, folder structure, version control, handover notes and final delivery packages.
  • Prepare editable source files, PDFs, linked assets and usage notes for final delivery where required.
  • Tag reusable assets and maintain library metadata so approved content can be found, adapted and reused.
  • Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support grammar, consistency, brief summarisation, tagging or QA, with careful human review before findings are acted on.
  • Escalate missing information, conflicting versions, confidentiality concerns, delivery blockers or high-risk quality issues to the Senior Designer or relevant workflow lead.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • At least 1 year of experience in production support, presentation support, document QA, creative operations, project administration or another detail-focused role; strong entry-level candidates with relevant internships or portfolios may also be considered.
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word, Excel, PDF workflows and Microsoft Teams/SharePoint or similar collaboration environments.
  • Excellent attention to detail and confidence checking layout, formatting, spelling, grammar, page flow, naming conventions and version control.
  • Basic understanding of brand guidelines, templates, accessibility and what makes a file ready for client-facing use.
  • Experience using trackers, logs, checklists, file structures or workflow documentation accurately and consistently.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to flag gaps, errors or risks without taking ownership away from the person responsible for correcting them.
  • Practical AI literacy and a responsible approach to confidential information and human review.
  • Interest in presentation production, design craft, workflow improvement and healthcare or life-sciences client work.

Ideal profile

  • You are highly accurate, organised and calm under time pressure.
  • You enjoy making files cleaner, clearer and easier for others to use.
  • You take pride in catching issues and communicating them constructively before materials are delivered.
  • You are motivated to develop your production, quality or design skills as the studio grows.

Career progression

This role is the foundation of the Design Studio career framework. With demonstrated design craft and a suitable portfolio, progression may lead to Designer and Senior Designer. Colleagues who build deeper expertise in workflow, quality, asset management and reporting may also develop toward a Studio Operations or QA specialist pathway. Progression is based on capability, impact and available business opportunities.

Life at Inizio Ignite

You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.

In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.

We provide

  • A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
  • International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
  • A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
  • A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.
