title: Associate Editor, Coal
description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

09

S&P Global Platts

The Role: Associate Editor

The Team: The team is responsible for contributing to the daily publication of Platts Coal Trader, an industry leading publication covering the US thermal coal market. The team writes daily news and analysis as well as conducts daily benchmark price assessments.

The Impact: The role is critical to defending our brand, increasing our relevance in the market, showcasing Platts’ subject matter expertise regarding coal and related commodities such as power, natural gas and renewable energy, while also ensuring our daily benchmark price assessments are accurate. Your job is to make sense of supply and demand and how it impacts pricing, while also considering the role coal plays in ever-changing domestic and international markets.

What’s in it for you:

  • Gain subject matter expertise in domestic and international coal markets, as well as North American power markets.

  • Travel for conferences, market engagement

  • Chance to grow within S&P Global, a global Fortune 500 company

Responsibilities:

  • Research and write daily market relevant news and analysis; also work on longer enterprise pieces.

  • Conduct daily and weekly price assessments

  • Adhere to rigorous compliance standards

  • Develop new sources and broaden existing relationships

What We’re Looking For: We are looking for someone who is curious about energy markets. If you're right for this role, you'll be inquisitive, conscientious, and an effective communicator. You'll love this job because you'll be in a dynamic environment where market-moving changes occur every day, surrounded by high-energy individuals who are enthusiastic about covering markets and regulation, spotting key trends and reporting about those trends to our customers. You will be able to tackle problems and take independent action. You will seek out new assignments and act on opportunities.

Basic Qualifications:

  • An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in journalism.

  • Strong background in journalism, communications, or a related field.

  • Ability to travel.

  • Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in commodities journalism or direct experience in commodities.

  • Proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese.

  • Advanced Excel and SQL skills.

About S&P Global Energy
At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive economically in a rapidly changing global landscape. Learn more at www.spglobal.com/energy.

What’s In It For You?

Our Mission:

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People:

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values:

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership


Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

Benefits:

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

Our benefits include:

  • Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.

  • Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.

  • Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.

  • Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.

  • Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.

  • Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries

Vi söker nu dig som vill jobba som butikssäljare hos oss på Circle K Gammelstad. Tjänsten motsvarar 25% och är en tillsvidaretjänst med provanställning. Vi söker även dig som vill arbeta flexibla arbetstider. Arbetspassen för denna tjänst är förlagda dagtid, kvällar och helger. Utöver ditt schema finns det även möjligheter att ta extrapass för att komma upp i sysselsättningsgrad. Ensamarbete förekommer. B-körkort och tillgång till egen bil krävs om du inte är bosatt i närområdet, då kollektivtrafiken till arbetsplatsen är begränsad.

Som butikssäljare hos oss har du en månadslön som baseras på din tidigare erfarenhet inom service. Månadslönen vid heltidsarbete varierar mellan 27400-33065 kr/månad. Utöver din månadslön får du extra OB-ersättning för arbete under kvällar, nätter, helger och röda dagar. Eftersom vi har en CV-lös och fördomsfri rekrytering behöver du styrka din tidigare erfarenhet genom att uppvisa arbetsgivarintyg under rekryteringsprocessen. För att söka tjänsten fyller du enkelt i dina uppgifter, anger vilka tider du kan arbeta och genomför därefter ett kort servicetest som tar cirka 10 minuter. Är du vår nya butikssäljare som gillar varierande arbetsuppgifter och att ge service utöver det vanliga? Vi jobbar med löpande urval i rekryteringen så sök tjänsten omgående för att inte missa chansen!

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan senast 10.08.2026

Om dig:

  • Du är en teamplayer – du sätter laget före jaget.
  • Du är en fixare – du hittar lösningar på allt.
  • Du älskar människor.
  • Du är en allkonstnär: Du gillar att ha koll på allt, och tycker om att göra många saker samtidigt.
  • Du vill lära dig nya saker och utvecklas.
  • Du pratar och förstår svenska.
  • Du är över 18 år.

Om oss:

  • Vi är en plantskola för social skills – vi lägger en bra grund för alla framtida yrken. Och du får ett snyggt CV!
  • För dig som redan kommit en bit i yrkeslivet kan vi erbjuda ett utvecklande och mångsidigt jobb.
  • Du får kunskap om hur det är att driva butik.
  • Du lär dig att bli en ledare med förståelse för service.
  • Du får specialistkunskap – vi kan allt från att driva butik och sälja drivmedel, till marknadsföring och ledarskap.
  • Du får en möjlighet till att göra karriär inom företaget – kanske vill du driva din egen butik, eller sikta mot ett jobb på vårt huvudkontor.
  • Du får ett roligt jobb med härliga kollegor.
  • Vi är ett internationellt företag med kollegor runt omkring i hela världen.
  • Våra stationer kan ha biluthyrning, då är körkort B-manuell ett krav.
  • Vi erbjuder dig ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag och personalrabatt på alla våra stationer.

Circle K är ett framgångsrikt globalt företag med mer än 17 300 butiker i 27 länder. Totalt har vi cirka 150 000 anställda som arbetar i våra butiker och på kontoren. Vårt nätverk består av butiker som drivs både i bolags- och franchisedrift. Vår kultur och våra värderingar: One Team, Take Ownership, Play to Win och Do the Right Thing är grunden i allt vi gör. Vi vill göra det enkelt för våra kunder längs vägen genom att erbjuda bra produkter och snabb service i världsklass.

För den här tjänsten krävs att du antingen är medborgare i Sverige, ett annat nordiskt land eller ett EU/EES-land, har permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige, eller är asylsökande med giltig rätt att arbeta. Under rekryteringsprocessen behöver du kunna visa upp handlingar som styrker ditt medborgarskap eller din arbetsrätt i Sverige.

Vi förbehåller oss rätten att göra bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidater i rekryteringsprocessen.

title: Lead Full Stack Developer (10+ Years in DotNet+C#+React+Typescript+Azure+SQL server)
description:
Lead Software Engineer – Assurant, GCC India


We are seeking a Full Stack Tech Lead who will provide technical and delivery leadership for enterprise-grade applications across frontend, backend, and cloud platforms. This role involves owning architecture and design decisions, guiding implementation standards, mentoring engineers, and ensuring scalable, secure, and high-quality software delivery. The Tech Lead will work closely with product owners, architects, and DevOps teams within Agile or SAFe environments, while actively leveraging AI-assisted engineering practices to improve productivity, quality, and consistency.

This position will be in Bengaluru & Hyderabad at our India location.

Work Time: 3:30 PM IST -12:30 AM IST

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Lead end-to-end technical design and architecture for complex full-stack systems, collaborating with product, architecture, and cross-functional teams to define scalable and resilient solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership to a team of engineers by setting development standards, reviewing critical code paths, and guiding implementation approaches aligned with architectural runway and organizational standards.
  • Break down complex features into well-defined technical tasks, estimates, and sprint deliverables, supporting predictable execution and release planning.
  • Architect and develop secure, versioned, and well-documented APIs and backend services using modern .NET or equivalent platforms, applying microservices, event-driven, and domain-driven design patterns where appropriate.
  • Drive frontend architecture using modern SPA frameworks, ensuring modular design, effective state management, performance optimization, accessibility, and consistent user experience.
  • Establish and enforce built-in quality practices including automated testing strategies, code quality gates, CI/CD standards, and Definition of Done across teams.
  • Lead cloud architecture and deployment strategies utilizing Azure or AWS services, including serverless components, container orchestration, monitoring, telemetry, and cost-aware design.
  • Champion application security by driving secure SDLC practices, threat modeling, authentication and authorization patterns, secrets management, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Mentor and coach engineers through code reviews, design discussions, pairing, and knowledge-sharing forums, fostering continuous improvement and engineering excellence. Leverage AI-enabled software engineering tools responsibly for architecture exploration, code generation, refactoring, documentation, and test creation, validating outputs for correctness, security, and maintainability.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

  • Typically, 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with progressive responsibility, including technical leadership of full-stack or .NET-based enterprise solutions within Agile or SAFe delivery models.

Technology Requirements

  • Expert-level full-stack development experience using React with TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and moder UI architecture patterns including performance optimization and accessibility.
  • Deep expertise in C# and .NET 6/7/8, ASP.NET Core, NodeJS background services, and distributed system design including microservices, messaging, resiliency patterns, and API governance.
  • Strong data architecture and integration skills with SQL Server and other relational databases, Entity Framework Core, performance tuning, and experience with NoSQL platforms.
  • Advanced experience designing and governing APIs including REST standards, versioning strategies, documentation, backward compatibility, and API security.
  • Proven leadership in CI/CD pipeline design and governance, source control strategies, automated testing, containerization using Docker, and deployment patterns such as blue/green and canary releases.
  • Extensive cloud architecture experience using Azure or AWS services including App Services, Functions, Service Bus or event platforms, Key Vault, identity, monitoring, and operational readiness.
  • Strong security leadership with hands-on experience in OWASP practices, OAuth2/OIDC, threat modeling, secure coding standards, and regulated environment considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement AI-assisted engineering workflows using tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude, including prompt engineering, AI output validation, and responsible AI usage.
  • Excellent problem-solving, performance engineering, debugging, and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to balance delivery speed and risk management.

title: Servicemonteur
description:
Als service- en onderhoudsmonteur in Broek op Langedijk zorg jij ervoor dat cv-ketels, warmtepompen en hybride installaties optimaal blijven presteren. Je verhelpt storingen snel en vakkundig en voert preventief onderhoud uit, zodat klanten altijd kunnen rekenen op warmte en comfort.

Storingen opsporen, oplossen én voorkomen: daar krijg jij als servicemonteur energie van! Bij Feenstra waarderen we jouw vakmanschap met een aantrekkelijk salaris vanaf € 3.467,31, volop opleidingsmogelijkheden en een eigen werkbus met professioneel en gekeurd gereedschap. En dat is nog maar het begin. Klinkt goed? Lees snel verder!

Zó maak jij het verschil!

Als servicemonteur ben jij het vertrouwde gezicht van Feenstra bij onze klanten. Dankzij jouw technische kennis en klantgerichte aanpak blijven installaties veilig, betrouwbaar en energiezuinig functioneren.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het uitvoeren van onderhoud aan cv-ketels, hybride systemen en warmtepompen;

  • Het snel en vakkundig oplossen van storingen;

  • Het voorkomen van problemen door tijdig en zorgvuldig onderhoud uit te voeren.

Dankzij jouw inzet genieten klanten van een comfortabele en veilige installatie. Of het nu gaat om een warm huis of een warme douche: jij zorgt ervoor dat alles blijft werken zoals het hoort.

Dit past bij jou

  • Je bent technisch sterk en klantgericht;

  • Je blijft rustig en denkt in oplossingen, ook bij drukte of storingen;

  • In de winter ligt je focus op storingen, in de zomer op onderhoud;

  • Je draait mee in de storingsdienst (ongeveer 1x per 4 weken een weekenddienst en één vaste avond per week).

Jij bent het visitekaartje van Feenstra. Storingen oplossen, onderhoud uitvoeren en klanten adviseren? Jij doet het met gemak en een glimlach.

  • Je hebt al de nodige ervaring en weet precies wat je doet, geen service- of onderhoudsbeurt is voor jou onbekend!

  • Een mbo-diploma onderhoudsmonteur niveau 2 of Eerste monteur Service & onderhoud niveau 3;

  • VCA, CO-certificering en F-gassen diploma? Mooi! zo niet, dan zorgen wij dat je ze haalt;

  • In het bezit van een geldig rijbewijs B;

  • Storingsdiensten? Jij draait jouw hand er niet voor om;

  • Een VOG aanvragen? Voor jou geen probleem!

Een aanbod waar je het warm van krijgt!

Wij zijn trots: onze collega’s waarderen ons met een prachtige 8,5 en onze klanten kozen ons tot Installatiebedrijf van het Jaar 2025. Dat zegt iets over hoe fijn het is om hier te werken.

  • Een goed salaris tussen € 3.467,31 en € 3.939,71 bruto per maand, afgestemd op jouw ervaring;

  • Contract van één jaar met uitzicht op vast dienstverband;

  • Betaalde reisuren: je krijgt betaald vanaf het moment dat je instapt;

  • Vrije dagen 25 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen per jaar o.b.v. 40 uur per week;

  • Dit zit wel goed: 8% vakantiegeld, jaarlijkse winstdeling én een fijne pensioenregeling;

  • Blijven leren? Altijd! Toegang tot trainingen en cursussen om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen;

  • Jouw voordeel: korting op sportabonnementen, een weekend weg via FiscFree, korting op Feenstra producten én jouw energierekening bij Vattenfall.

Wij zijn enthousiast, jij ook? Solliciteer!

Solliciteren is best een stap, dat snappen we. Daarom sta ik voor je klaar als je ergens over wilt praten, iets wilt navragen of gewoon even wilt checken of dit écht bij je past.

📧 smadari@feenstra.com
📞 06-14181001

title: Reconciliation Specialist
description:
As a Reconciliation Specialist, you'll play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of investment portfolio records by reconciling cash, transactions, and securities holdings across global investment portfolios. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with portfolio managers, custodians, and operations teams while gaining exposure to investment operations, process improvement initiatives, and industry-leading technologies. You'll develop deep expertise in investment management, contribute to operational excellence, and help drive outcomes that support our commitment to securing better financial futures for our customers.

Position Responsibilities

• Perform daily reconciliations of securities holdings, cash balances, and cash transactions across investment portfolios to ensure accuracy and completeness.

• Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies by partnering with internal stakeholders, custodians, and external service providers.

• Monitor and review reconciliation exceptions, ensuring timely resolution and adherence to service level agreements (SLAs).

• Support business governance activities through reporting, analysis, and participation in team and stakeholder meetings.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency through automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Participate in projects, system enhancements, user acceptance testing (UAT), and other transformation initiatives impacting investment operations.

• Maintain accurate documentation and support audit, compliance, SOX, and regulatory requirements.

• Provide guidance, knowledge sharing, and support to junior team members and new hires when needed.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Investments, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in reconciliation, investment operations, securities administration, banking, or a related financial services environment.

• Strong understanding of investment products, securities instruments, cash management, and financial transactions.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in investment accounting or investment operations.

• Knowledge of reconciliation and investment platforms such as SimCorp Dimension, Bloomberg, DUCO, or custodian reporting systems.

• Experience with Power BI, Power Apps, VBA, robotics, automation tools, or data analytics solutions.

• Professional certifications such as CISI or equivalent investment-related credentials.

• Experience supporting process improvement, transformation, or automation initiatives.

• Exposure to audit, regulatory, compliance, or SOX-controlled environments.

title: Master Thesis in Data-Driven Force Prediction for Rotary Grinding in the Semiconductor Industry
description:
You will be part of an innovative research project where data-driven methods meet cutting-edge technology. Ready to turn your ideas into impact? Apply now and help to shape future solutions.

  • You will conduct a comprehensive review of existing force modeling methods for rotational grinding and explore state-of-the-art machine learning approaches for sequence-to-sequence regression on time-series data, such as Symbolic Regression, Convolutional Neural Networks, and Mamba.
  • As part of the data analysis process, you will analyze and prepare the provided time-series data, including feature engineering to extract relevant physical parameters.
  • Based on your research, you will implement and train various machine learning frameworks for force prediction.
  • To assess the developed approaches, you will create and apply a robust comparison matrix using key performance indicators such as prediction accuracy (RMSE, MAE), computational cost, and interpretability.
  • Throughout the project, you will regularly document, present, and discuss your findings and progress with the project team.
  • Education: master studies in the field of Mechanical Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Physics, or comparable
  • Experience and Knowledge: strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with common data science libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch, and Pandas
  • Personality and Working Practice: you are highly self-motivated and enjoy tackling challenging research topics independently
  • Work Routine: your on-site presence is required
  • Languages: fluent in English and very good in German

Start: according to prior agreement
Duration: 6 months

Requirement for this thesis is the enrollment at university. Please attach your CV, transcript of records, examination regulations and if indicated a valid work and residence permit.

title: Production & QA Assistant
description:
We invite you to come grow with us.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignite's global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation & Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production & QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Role: Production & QA Assistant - India Design Studio

Team: India Design Studio

The Production & QA Assistant is a foundational role in the Design Studio, combining junior production support, independent checklist-based QA and workflow administration. You will help protect design time, strengthen delivery discipline and ensure that files are accurate, organised and ready for client or business use.

What you will do

  • Apply approved templates and complete basic formatting or production updates to slides, documents and supporting materials.
  • Perform independent QA after the designer has completed their self-check, reviewing formatting, alignment, pagination, footnotes, spelling, grammar, consistency, brand application, accessibility and template compliance.
  • Record QA findings clearly and return issues to the designer or Senior Designer for correction; the role supports quality control but does not replace designer or business-owner accountability.
  • Check briefs and source files for completeness and flag gaps before work begins.
  • Log requests, update workflow trackers and maintain an accurate record of status, turnaround, rework, feedback and common quality issues.
  • Manage file naming, folder structure, version control, handover notes and final delivery packages.
  • Prepare editable source files, PDFs, linked assets and usage notes for final delivery where required.
  • Tag reusable assets and maintain library metadata so approved content can be found, adapted and reused.
  • Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support grammar, consistency, brief summarisation, tagging or QA, with careful human review before findings are acted on.
  • Escalate missing information, conflicting versions, confidentiality concerns, delivery blockers or high-risk quality issues to the Senior Designer or relevant workflow lead.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • At least 1 year of experience in production support, presentation support, document QA, creative operations, project administration or another detail-focused role; strong entry-level candidates with relevant internships or portfolios may also be considered.
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word, Excel, PDF workflows and Microsoft Teams/SharePoint or similar collaboration environments.
  • Excellent attention to detail and confidence checking layout, formatting, spelling, grammar, page flow, naming conventions and version control.
  • Basic understanding of brand guidelines, templates, accessibility and what makes a file ready for client-facing use.
  • Experience using trackers, logs, checklists, file structures or workflow documentation accurately and consistently.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to flag gaps, errors or risks without taking ownership away from the person responsible for correcting them.
  • Practical AI literacy and a responsible approach to confidential information and human review.
  • Interest in presentation production, design craft, workflow improvement and healthcare or life-sciences client work.

Ideal profile

  • You are highly accurate, organised and calm under time pressure.
  • You enjoy making files cleaner, clearer and easier for others to use.
  • You take pride in catching issues and communicating them constructively before materials are delivered.
  • You are motivated to develop your production, quality or design skills as the studio grows.

Career progression

This role is the foundation of the Design Studio career framework. With demonstrated design craft and a suitable portfolio, progression may lead to Designer and Senior Designer. Colleagues who build deeper expertise in workflow, quality, asset management and reporting may also develop toward a Studio Operations or QA specialist pathway. Progression is based on capability, impact and available business opportunities.

Life at Inizio Ignite

You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.

In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.

We provide

  • A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
  • International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
  • A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
  • A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

title: Postdoctoral position in Plant Evolutionary Genomics and Pangenomics
description:
Postdoctoral position in Plant Evolutionary Genomics and Pangenomics

Department of Plant Biology

About the position

A postdoctoral position in plant evolutionary genomics is available in the Yant Lab at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Uppsala, Sweden. The Yant Lab develops computational and genomic approaches to understand evolution, adaptation, genome dynamics, and whole-genome duplication across diverse plant systems (see https://www.yantlab.net/).

The project is funded through a Formas grant aimed at restoring European ash (Fraxinus excelsior) populations threatened by ash dieback. The successful candidate will contribute to developing the first Swedish-focused European ash pangenome, integrating long-read genome assemblies with population-scale sequencing to understand disease resistance and local adaptation across Europe.

The project combines large-scale population genomics, graph-based pangenomics, structural variant discovery, genome-wide association studies, and evolutionary genomics using state-of-the-art long-read sequencing and computational genomic approaches. The successful candidate will work closely with collaborators at other SLU campuses, the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, and other European partners, contributing to both methodological developments and biological discovery.

The project offers an opportunity to work at the forefront of plant evolutionary genomics while contributing directly to forest restoration and conservation.

Your profile

We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a PhD in botany, evolutionary biology, genetics, genomics, bioinformatics, plant biology, or a related subject deemed equivalent by the employer. The applicant should have a strong publication record relative to career stage and demonstrated ability to conduct independent research. The ideal candidate will have experience in all of the following areas:

-large scale population genomics, demographic inference, and evolutionary genomics

-graph-based pangenomics and structural variant analysis, ideally in plants

-genotype-environment association (GEA/EAA) or GWAS

-programming in Python, with extensive experience working in Linux and multiple HPC environments.

-population genomics across environmental gradients, including demographic inference and genotype–environment association analyses

Experience with long-read sequencing, structural variant analysis, graph-based genome analysis, and plant genomics is considered an advantage but is not required.

The successful candidate is expected to be a collaborative team member who will drive the project with creativity, independence, and scientific curiosity. Excellent written and spoken English is required.

Since postdoctoral appointments are career-development positions, priority will be given to candidates who received their doctoral degree within the past three years.

About us

The Department of Plant Biology (www.slu.se/en/vbsg) offers a creative and stimulating international environment and is one of several departments that make up the ‘Uppsala BioCenter’. The department undertakes fundamental research on model organisms, agricultural crops, forest trees and bioenergy crops. Our main areas of research comprise the interaction of plants with microorganisms and other environmental stresses, plant growth and development, biotechnology and metabolic engineering, regulation of gene expression, population genetics, genome analysis, and the development of breeding systems. Species in use are model organisms such as the entire Arabidopsis genus, Physcomitrella, Cochlearia, crops such as rapeseed, basket willow (Salix), potato, and cereals, and pathogens such as viruses, bacteria, and fungi/oomycetes. The department is responsible for basic and advanced courses in general and molecular genetics, cell biology, gene technology, plant physiology, plant breeding, plant biochemistry and biotechnology, and molecular interactions between plants and pathogens. In addition, the department contributes to various courses together with other departments. Uppsala, Sweden ́s fourth-biggest city, has two universities and with more than 50 000 students a vibrant student atmosphere. It is located in the Greater Stockholm area and has an excellent connection to the Stockholm-Arlanda international airport.

For more information about the department visit: https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-biology-forest-genetics/

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location: Uppsala.

Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. Downer is seeking an experienced Superintendent to join our Utilities Water team, supporting the delivery of critical water infrastructure works. This role will be responsible for driving optimal project outcomes across time, cost, quality and safety, while overseeing construction activities, site teams, subcontractors, resources, plant, equipment, materials and day-to-day project coordination.

Reporting to the Construction Manager, you will provide strong frontline leadership across allocated projects, ensuring works are delivered safely, efficiently and in line with project, client, environmental and legislative requirements. You will also play a key role in developing site team capability, building strong stakeholder relationships, and supporting a collaborative, high-performing project environment.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Overseeing project coordination, scheduling and allocation of resources, subcontractors, plant, equipment, travel, accommodation and materials.
  • Managing week-to-week site activities, work crews and subcontractors, while maintaining compliance with statutory requirements, policies and procedures.
  • Driving a strong Zero Harm culture and taking responsibility for the safety of work crews, the public, facilities and site activities.
  • Supporting constructability and methodology input through design development, procurement strategies, cost development and project scheduling.
  • Recruiting, managing, coaching and developing supervisory staff to create a high-performing team.
  • Building trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support successful project delivery.

What we are looking for

You will bring significant project delivery experience within the water and/or wastewater industry, along with demonstrated experience managing subcontractors, schedules and quality outcomes in a project delivery environment.

  • Minimum 10 years’ project delivery experience within the Water and/or Wastewater industry in SEQ.
  • Experience working with large water boards or utility providers.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and manage schedules.
  • Strong subcontractor management experience.
  • Experience driving quality outcomes in project delivery.
  • Ability to work well under pressure and in changing environments.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder relationship, organisational and time management skills.
  • Thoroughness, attention to detail and a strong commitment to Zero Harm.

What we offer

title: File Handler Litigated Tactical
description:
As a Litigated Credit Hire Specialist here at Keoghs you'll be at the heart of a team dedicated to championing clients interests in high-stakes credit hire cases.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to investigate Litigated Complex Credit Hire claims from a tactical and strategic point. The role of the File Handler is to carry out complex & technical investigations on claims submitted from specific opponents. These claims will be up to £25,000 in value.

This is a fantastic opportunity to become part of an incredible team and gain more experience in investigating credit hire claims with a view to successfully repudiating the claims.

The role will also involve an understanding of the court process, to include:

35 hours per week worked 9am and 5pm Mondays to Fridays inclusive with 1 hour for lunch
Essential:

•Good telephone negotiation skills

•Ability to make decisions
•Ability to remain calm under pressure
•Good IT skills including Word, Outlook, and experience of a Case Management System preferred
•Adhere to the Keoghs Values

Desirable:
•Experience of handling PI claims

Values
Our culture is focussed on making Keoghs sustainable and successful for our people and clients, with this our five values are at the heart of everything we do;

Keoghs values

We succeed together

title: DevOps Engineering Manager
description:
Great to Meet You! We are Ascenda


Ascenda powers the growth of leading financial services brands worldwide with premium rewards programs that differentiate their products, drive profitable customer behaviors, and create sustained engagement.

We are behind the world-class rewards propositions of major banks and fintechs around the globe, including brands like American Express, Capital One, Brex, Revolut, Ramp, HSBC, Bank of New Zealand, Virgin Money (Australia), Bradesco (Brazil), ANZ (Australia), HDFC (India) and many others.

We are a thriving global Loyalty-as-a-Service company and are experiencing rapid expansion. Join our dynamic team contributing to the execution of our business strategies as we strive for hypergrowth. Our team spans 20 cities worldwide, with dual headquarters in Singapore and New York, totalling 270 team members.


Join us as a DevOps Engineering Manager in Singapore/Vietnam!


What we do

We're a small team of nice, experienced and (we think) fun folks. We treat our infrastructure as a product built for the developers who use it every day. Our job is to make it easy for them to ship, run and observe their services: good paved roads, sensible defaults, and self-service tooling so teams can move without waiting on us. It's all managed as code with Terraform, running on Kubernetes across multiple AWS accounts and regions, built and deployed through automated CI/CD pipelines and Helm charts. Grafana watches most of it. We're currently moving our CI/CD off Jenkins onto GitHub Actions.

We work closely with our developers and security teams, and we believe in "you build it, you own it." The platform is there to make that ownership manageable, not scary, by giving teams the guardrails and visibility to run what they ship. We care about automation and quality, and we've hit the tougher security standards (PCI-DSS, SOC2, ISO27001). Our clients are financial institutions and airlines, so they expect high availability, reliability and security.

On a typical day we reach for Terraform, Istio, ArgoCD, Kubectl, Helm, GitHub Actions, Grafana, Cloudflare… to name a few.

The Role

We want someone to lead our growing DevOps team (6+ engineers today) who genuinely cares about cloud, systems, automation, reliability and security, with several years of hands-on experience in a similar stack. It's a player-coach role: you'll lead and grow the team, and while the role has a managerial aspect to it, we also expect you to acquire deep knowledge of our stack and contribute to it in a hands-on manner.

Your Impact

  • Set and adjust the platform roadmap and priorities based on stakeholders input, but more importantly, working towards the company's infra/devops vision.
  • Lead, mentor and grow the team, drawing on your own hands-on skills and experience.
  • Help design and evolve the cloud platform powering our current and future services, with a strong bias toward self-service and paved roads.
  • Champion the "you build it, you own it" culture, giving teams the tooling, observability and guardrails to own their services with confidence.
  • Ensure our platforms run smoothly, reliably and securely to serve our customers, and that quality standards for infrastructure, code and documentation are met and delivered on reasonable timelines.
  • Propose and drive improvements in scalability, automation, performance, CI/CD and self-service. We're absolutely looking forward to your suggestions!

Who You Are

  • Several years of hands-on experience and battle-scars with AWS, Linux, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD and observability, plus experience managing complex architectures at scale.
  • Experience managing a team of engineers and fostering cross-team collaboration.
  • Solid systems and cloud fundamentals, with strong troubleshooting, problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • A developer-experience mindset - you think about internal tooling and infrastructure as products with real users, not just systems to keep running.
  • Networking, databases (we use Postgres and Redshift) and scripting/development background.
  • A pragmatic view on cost and FinOps. You are comfortable driving efficiency gains while balancing them against reliability, velocity and delivery.
  • A security-and-compliance-first mindset. You've worked in regulated or audited environments (e.g. PCI-DSS, SOC2, ISO27001) and treat security and compliance as built into the platform, not bolted on.

Why Join Ascenda?

Ascenda offers the unique opportunity to lead in LaaS, shaping the future of rewards programs. You'll be part of an environment that prizes groundbreaking ideas and their execution. We provide unparalleled career growth opportunities in a supportive and dynamic environment, complemented by a competitive compensation package that recognizes your impact.

Ascenda is dedicated to diversity and inclusion, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds. Join us on our mission to power the growth of the financial services industry by making loyalty simple and rewarding for everyone, everywhere.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen kehittäjäopettaja, Jönsaksen päiväkoti
description:
Vantaan kaupunki, Kasvatus ja oppiminen, Varhaiskasvatus
Jönsaksen päiväkoti

Löydöspolku 4, 01600 Vantaa

Työsuhteen kesto: Määräaikainen 17.08.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan - 31.12.2026

Haluatko olla mukana luomassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta? Tule meille Vantaalle varhaiskasvatuksen kehittäjäopettajaksi!

Etsimme joukkoomme kehittämismyönteistä varhaiskasvatuksen kehittäjäopettajaa Opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriön rahoittamalla koulutuksellisen tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden avustuksella vuoden 2026 loppuun saakka.

Etsimme Jönsaksen päiväkotiin innostunutta ja rohkeaa varhaiskasvatuksen kehittäjäopettajaa, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä. Tässä tehtävässä pääset suunnittelemaan, kehittämään ja arvioimaan varhaiskasvatussuunnitelman mukaista pedagogista toimintaa yhteistyössä päiväkodin johtajan ja kasvattajatiimien kanssa. Roolisi on tärkeässä osassa yksikön pedagogiikan ja toimintakulttuurin laadun kehittämistä ja varmistamista lapsiryhmissä.

Toimintakulttuuriamme kehitetään vaikuttavaan tutkimusnäyttöön perustuen. Yksikössämme on käytössä ProVaka -toimintamalli lasten sosiaalisten taitojen tukemiseen. Työntekijänä sitoudut toimimaan toimintamallin periaatteiden mukaisesti - yhdessä yksikön muun henkilöstön kanssa.#_msocom_1

Jönsaksen päiväkoti on 5-ryhmäinen talo, joista 2 ryhmää toimii painottuen 1-3-vuotiaisiin ja 3 ryhmää, joissa lasten ikäjakauma on pääsääntöisesti 3-5-vuotiaita. Koko päiväkodissa on noin 90 lasta ja 15 kasvattajaa. Yksikössämme toimii laaja-alainen erityisopettaja sekä lasten tarpeiden mukaisesti meillä on lisäksi avustavaa henkilökuntaa.

Kulkuyhteydet meille ovat erittäin hyvät, sillä sijaitsemme keskellä Myyrmäkeä, aivan juna-aseman vieressä. Retkeilemme paljon ja päiväkotimme pihalla on myös kota, jota hyödynnämme toiminnassamme. Jönsaksen päiväkodissa on kehittämismyönteinen ja henkilöstön kesken hyvä ja raikas ilmapiiri. Henkilöstön vaihtuvuus on vähäistä. Päiväkodistamme voit lukea lisää täältä: [Jönsaksen päiväkoti | Vantaa](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/palveluhakemisto/toimipiste/jonsaksen-paivakoti)

Mikä tekee tästä tehtävästä erityisen?

Tehtävässäsi yhteiskehität oppimisympäristöjä, tuet kasvattajatiimejä ja osallistut yksikön johtoryhmätyöskentelyyn. Toimit inklusiivisen toimintakulttuurin edistäjänä, ja vahvistat työyhteisön osaamista hyödyntämällä monipuolisia pedagogisia menetelmiä tiimien henkilöstön kanssa yhdessä työskennellen. Lapsiryhmissä kehitätte käytäntöjä, joilla varmistatte lasten hyvinvoinnin, tasa-arvoisen oppimisen ja osallistumisen.

Millaista osaamista tarvitset menestyäksesi tehtävässä:

- Hallitset varhaiskasvatuksen pedagogiset menetelmät ja osaat soveltaa niitä luovasti ja joustavasti.
- Olet taitava ohjaamaan työyhteisöä ja kehittämään varhaiskasvatussuunnitelman mukaista pedagogiikkaa lapsia ja henkilöstöä kuunnellen.
- Sinulla on erinomaiset yhteistyö- ja viestintätaidot ja nautit moniammatillisesta työskentelystä.
- Vahvuuspedagogiikan kehittäminen, osallistaminen ja lapsen itsetunnon vahvistaminen on sinulle tärkeää.

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa lasten tulevaisuuteen ja luoda heidän oppimisestaan innostavaa ja laadukasta.
- Työssäsi pääset tekemään moniammatillista yhteistyötä varhaiskasvatuksen muiden ammattilaisten, esimerkiksi laaja-alaisen varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettajan sekä kieli- ja kulttuurikoordinaattorin kanssa.
- Hyvät koulutusmahdollisuudet itsesi ja ammatillisuutesi kehittämiseen.
- Kaupunkitasoiset vertaistapaamiset toisten kehittäjäopettajien ja kehittäjäsosionomien verkostossa.
- Työhyvinvointia tukevat edut, kuten työmatkaedun.

Liity osaksi Vantaan tarinaa!

Vantaan varhaiskasvatuksen visiona on iloiset, oppivat ja osallistuvat lapset kasvavat kestävään tulevaisuuteen. Jos koet olevasi valmis ottamaan seuraavan askeleen varhaiskasvatuksen kehittämisessä, tartu tilaisuuteen ja jätä hakemuksesi jo tänään!

Lähetä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta ja olemme sinuun yhteydessä. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pian, sillä haastatteluita voidaan pitää jo hakuaikana ja valinta tehdä heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Työsuhteen tietoja

Kelpoisuusvaatimus: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja (Varhaiskasvatuslain mukainen varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuus)

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksen lisäksi edellytämme:

- hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa
- hyvää työmoraalia ja aitoa kiinnostusta varhaiskasvatukseen
- kykyä toimia saumattomasti työyhteisön jäsenenä ja yleisesti ottaen hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
- joustavuutta

Luemme eduksi: Positiivisen elämänasenteen ja hyvän huumorintajun.

Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Kunnallisen opetushenkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen (OVTES) mukaisesti.

Palkkaus: 3129,71-3234 eur/kk. Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuusvaatimukset täyttävästä tutkinnosta maksetaan lisäksi 15 eur/kk, ja kasvatustieteiden maisterin tutkinnosta 37,88 eur/kk.
Aiempaan työkokemukseen perustuva työkokemuslisä on 3-8 %.

Edellytettävät luvat: Valitun henkilön tulee esittää voimassa oleva rikostaustaote. Alle kouluikäisten lasten kanssa työskentelevien valittujen henkilöiden hengityselinten tuberkuloosia koskeva selvitys tarkastetaan (tartuntatautilaki § 55).

Työpaikkojen lukumäärä: 1

Koeaika: Tehtävässä noudatetaan 2 kuukauden koeaikaa

Kokoaika-/osa-aikatyö: Kokoaikainen

Palvelusuhteen muoto: Työsuhde

Työaika: 38 h 15 min/viikko

Yhteystiedot:

Päiväkodin johtaja

Ahtola, Auli

040 5346366

auli.ahtola@vantaa.fi

Tavoitettavissa 9-15

Vantaa on vastuullinen työnantaja. Tuemme työntekijöidemme hyvinvointia ja osaamista sekä työyhteisöjen hyvää ilmapiiriä. Kehitämme jatkuvasti esihenkilötyötämme. Meille Vantaan kaupungilla on tärkeää työyhteisön tasa-arvoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus. Toivomme saavamme hakemuksia erilaisilta taustoilta olevilta henkilöiltä, kuten eri-ikäisiltä, eri sukupuolta olevilta ja erilaisista kieli-, kulttuuri- ja vähemmistöryhmiin kuuluvilta.

Lähetä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta. Vantaan hakujen hakuaika päättyy klo 16:00.

Rekrytointiprosessissa saatetaan käyttää videohaastattelua.

title: Asystent / Asystentka ds. sprzedaży
description:
Nasza sprzedaż pędzi do przodu, dlatego szukamy energii i zaangażowania – ambitnej osoby studiującej, która wejdzie do naszego teamu handlowego, odciąży naszą Team Leaderkę, przejdzie u nas prawdziwą szkołę biznesu i z czasem wyrośnie na samodzielnego asa międzynarodowej sprzedaży.

Dlaczego warto do nas dołączyć właśnie teraz?

  • Rośniemy jak szaleni: Od trzech lat co roku podwajamy nasze obroty (x2 rok do roku!). My nie stoimy w miejscu – my lecimy!
  • Szkoła biznesu w praktyce: Nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę bez koła ratunkowego. Będziesz pracować ramię w ramię z naszą Team Leaderką sprzedaży, ucząc się od podstaw, jak wygląda nowoczesny, międzynarodowy proces B2B.
  • Wychowamy własnego managera: Szukamy kogoś na dłużej. Chcemy Cię wyszkolić i dać Ci narzędzia, byś po studiach (lub w ich trakcie) stał/a się w pełni samodzielnym Account Managerem z własnym portfolio dużych, zagranicznych klientów.
  • Pełna elastyczność: Wiemy, czym są kolokwia i sesja. U nas bez problemu połączysz naukę z pracą – działamy zdalnie i dopasowujemy grafik do Twojego planu zajęć.

🔎 Kogo szukamy?

Szukamy osoby na starcie swojej drogi w biznesie, która ma w sobie naturalną ciekawość, "głód" wiedzy i chce szybko chłonąć praktyczne umiejętności. Nie musisz mieć wieloletniego doświadczenia – najważniejsza jest dla nas Twoja postawa, zaangażowanie i to, czy złapiemy wspólny vibe.


Będzie nam po drodze, jeśli:

  • Posiadasz status studenta i szukasz miejsca, w którym realnie rozwiniesz skrzydła (a nie tylko „odbębnisz” staż).
  • Swobodnie rozmawiasz i piszesz po angielsku oraz polsku (must-have) – działamy międzynarodowo, więc codzienny kontakt z zagranicznymi klientami to u nas standard.
  • Jesteś osobą świetnie zorganizowaną i skrupulatną – potrafisz samodzielnie zarządzać swoim czasem w pracy zdalnej, nie gubisz wątków i dbasz o porządek w dokumentach oraz systemach.
  • Chcesz się uczyć sprzedaży i obsługi klienta B2B – pierwsze doświadczenia w kontakcie z ludźmi (np. obsługa klienta, gastronomia, call center, wolontariaty) będą super atutem, ale najważniejsza jest chęć do nauki.
  • Stawiasz na szczerość i otwartą komunikację – pracujemy zdalnie, więc jasny przepływ informacji to dla nas podstawa. U nas mówi się wprost, co działa, a co nie.

title: Research Engineer – Neuro-Symbolic AI (Knowledge Graphs) & Multimodal Assistant Systems
description:
Roles & Responsibilities :
Conduct cutting-edge research in Neuro-Symbolic AI, focusing on the integration of formal knowledge representations such as knowledge graphs with modern machine learning and deep learning techniques.

  • Design multimodal data pipelines integrating text, structured data, and, where relevant, visual or sensor information.

  • Design and develop knowledge-driven AI systems with natural language interaction capabilities, enabling explainable, trustworthy, and human-centered AI assistants.

  • Integrate Neuro-Symbolic reasoning with large language models (LLMs) and multimodal foundation models using knowledge grounding, structured retrieval and reasoning-aware workflows to improve robustness, interpretability, and domain adaptability.

  • Design, build, and evolve semantic assets — such as ontologies, knowledge graphs, semantic data models, and symbolic rules / constraints — that ground, validate, and explain neuro-symbolic AI systems in production-oriented research settings.

  • Prototype, evaluate, and validate research concepts through experiments, benchmarks, and real-world use cases, translating research outcomes into scalable solutions.

  • Collaborate closely with international, cross-disciplinary teams of researchers, engineers, and product stakeholders to apply research innovations to business-relevant scenarios such as product engineering, diagnostics, maintenance, and repair.

  • Contribute to technology transfer, supporting the transition from research prototypes to production-ready systems in collaboration with software and product teams.

  • Publish research findings in top-tier conferences and journals, file patents, and contribute to Bosch’s intellectual property portfolio.

  • Stay up to date with the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, knowledge representation, and multimodal systems, ensuring Bosch remains at the forefront of innovation.

  • Actively participate in internal and external research communities, workshops, and collaborations to foster knowledge exchange and thought leadership.

Educational qualification:

Ph.D. or M.S. or M. Tech from top Indian or foreign institutes (IITs, IIITs, IISc etc.) in Computer Science or a related field (e.g., NLP, linguistics, artificial intelligence, cognitive science)

Experience :

  • At least 3 years of relevant professional or applied research experience.

Mandatory/requires Skills :
• Expertise in Neuro-Symbolic AI Architectures and Frameworks: Proven ability to design, implement, and integrate hybrid AI systems that combine machine learning with symbolic reasoning (preferably knowledge graphs) to address complex requirements.

• Advanced Data Engineering for Multi-Modal Integration: Demonstrated proficiency in building robust data pipelines capable of integrating, cleaning, and preprocessing heterogeneous data sources

• Understanding of core NLP concepts and practical experience using state-of-the-art NLP frameworks, libraries (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers, spaCy, NLTK, Gensim etc.) for text processing, tokenization, semantic parsing, and language modeling.

• Proven experience in extracting structured knowledge from unstructured text using NLP techniques like Named Entity Recognition (NER) and Relation Extraction. to understand user queries, extract insights from text, and contribute to the automatic construction and expansion of dynamic knowledge bases.

• Experience utilizing popular graph libraries (e.g., RDFlib, KGLab, and PyTorch Geometric) to develop and deploy graph-based ML algorithms, including link prediction, node classification, relation extraction and graph embeddings like Node2Vec.

• Use visualization tools like Gephi, D3.js for Graph analytics and visualization.

• Proven ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional and international teams.

Preferred Skills - Any of the following will be an added advantage:
• Strong understanding of knowledge representation and reasoning techniques, including ontology design, schema alignment, rule authoring, explainable inference workflows, and hybrid symbolic-neural evaluation methodologies.

• Neuro-Symbolic AI & Hybrid Reasoning: Experience architecting or implementing hybrid reasoning and analytical engines capable of complex problem-solving, including causal reasoning, planning, explainable decision-making, and symbolic-neural inference. Architect and implement hybrid reasoning and analytical engines capable of complex problem-solving, including causal reasoning, planning, explainable decision-making, and symbolic–neural inference.

• Hands-on experience with enterprise knowledge graph and semantic web technologies, especially Neo4J, Stardog, STEADY including ontology modelling using OWL/RDFS, RDF data modelling, SPARQL query development, SHACL-based validation, reasoning/inference, and graph-based data integration.

• Working knowledge of symbolic query and reasoning approaches such as SPARQL, SHACL, description logics, logic programming, rule-based inference, or constraint-based reasoning.

• Ability to formulate research questions, design experiments, define evaluation criteria, run ablations, and interpret results with scientific rigor and strong reproducibility practices.

• Hands-on experience working with, prompting, fine-tuning, and evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language models. Strong understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) paradigms.

• Skills in graph embeddings, graph neural networks, Answer Set Programming/Prolog, SWRL or Drools, causal reasoning, agentic AI workflows, MLOps/cloud deployment, research publications, and patent drafting will be an added advantage.

title: Purkutyöntekijä
description:
Etsimme asiakasyritykselle PURKUTYÖNTEKIJÖITÄ vaihteleviin kohteisiin!

Etsimme reippaita ja motivoituneita purkutyöntekijöitä vaihteleviin kohteisiin Ouluun. Työtehtäviin kuuluu käsipurkutöitä sekä hiomista ja suojausten tekoa. Työ tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja työskennellä monipuolisessa ja kiinnostavassa projektissa. Jos sinulla on asbestipurkuluvat, katsotaan se suureksi eduksi, muttei ole välttämättömyys.

Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:
* Aiempaa työkokemusta purkutöistä
* Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja reipasta asennetta
* Itsenäistä ja oma-aloitteista työskentelyotetta
* Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti ja sujuva suomen kielen taito
Hienoa (muttei välttämätöntä) on, jos sinulla on lisäksi:
* Voimassa olevat asbestipurkuluvat ja kokemusta myös asbestipurusta
Me tarjoamme sinulle:
* Rakennusalan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 13-17,50 euron välille, ja se määritelläänosaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan
* Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet
* Mukavan ja rennon työporukan
* Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa
Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:
Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.
Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:
* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.
* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.
* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.
* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.
Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!
Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian!

Huomioithan, että otamme vastaan ainoastaan hakupainikkeen kautta lähetetyt hakemukset. Emme käsittele esimerkiksi sähköpostilla, WhatsAppilla tai tekstiviestillä lähetettyjä työhakemuksia.

Please note that we only accept applications submitted via the application button. We do not process job applications sent, for example, by email, WhatsApp, or text message.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
About NCR Atleos

NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

Title: Junior Software Engineer

Location: Dundee

Grade: 9

Job Description

An opportunity has arisen in the Engineering organisation for a Software/Firmware Engineer within the Secure Devices team, developing security products for Automated Teller Machines (ATMs).

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, learning new technologies, and working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary engineering team based at the NCR Atleos Discovery Centre R&D site in Dundee.

You will be part of a team responsible for delivering high quality software for ATM security related modules, including Encrypting Pin Pads, Card Readers, and Anti-Fraud devices.

The successful candidate will be part of an engineering group with development teams in global locations. As a software engineer in the team you will be responsible for working alongside fellow Engineers on development projects, investigating and resolving technical issues with the support of experienced engineers, and supporting the team to ensure customer commitments and goals are met. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate flexibility in response to changing priorities and requirements.

The role involves both firmware and software development, with opportunities to gain experience across a range of technologies and platforms. Experience with one or more of C, C++, or C# is required. Exposure to embedded systems, Python, Rust, USB, I2C, RTOS, cryptography, CI/CD tools, or source control systems would be beneficial but is not essential.

This role provides an opportunity to develop expertise in the design and development of security devices, firmware development, and software development, while working alongside experienced engineers in a collaborative environment. The successful candidate will receive guidance and support from experienced software and firmware engineers, with opportunities to develop technical skills and take on increasing responsibility as their experience grows.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, develop and document Software/Firmware with the support of senior developer/technical leads to meet customer requirements within agreed timescales.
  • Analyse and process data to then identify and develop solutions to customer requirements, with the assistance of senior developers.
  • Design, develop and document test procedures and software to validate functionality
  • Software/firmware unit test, and supporting integration and systems testing, including Continuous Integration builds and testing.
  • Regular progress reporting on schedule, quality & scope
  • Effective communication with fellow developers, technical team leads, and QA.
  • Support existing security devices through problem investigation, identification, and resolution

Essential Qualifications

  • Minimum Bachelor's Level Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Experience developing Software in C or C++ or C#
  • Good methodical problem-solving skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment composed of peers while also taking responsibility for individual tasks.
  • Knowledge of Software configuration management

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++
  • Knowledge of Symmetric and Asymmetric cryptographic frameworks
  • Knowledge of Microchip or NXP processor technologies (or equivalent)
  • Knowledge of development environments, including RTOS and embedded systems
  • Knowledge of Linux operating system
  • Knowledge of electronic designs

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

title: Senior virtualiseringsexpert – VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF)
description:
Vill du vara med och bygga Sveriges mest samhällskritiska privata moln? Skatteverket befinner sig i en unik expansionsfas där vi inte bara utvecklar vår egen IT – vi bygger och levererar infrastrukturtjänster till flera myndigheter i Sverige. Just nu utvecklar vi nästa generations privata molnplattform baserat på VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), samtidigt som vi etablerar en AI‑verkstad för både intern och extern användning.

Var med och gör samhället möjligt!

Om jobbet

Vi söker nu en senior virtualiseringsexpert som vill vara med och designa, bygga och vidareutveckla en plattform som gör verklig skillnad för offentlig sektor. Du blir en del av avdelningen Skatteverkets tekniska tjänster (STT) med cirka 500 medarbetare. Du ingår i ett specialistteam inom server, virtualisering och lagring som ansvarar för våra plattformar.

I rollen arbetar du nära plattformens kärna och får en viktig position i att driva den tekniska utvecklingen framåt.

  • Design, implementation och vidareutveckling av VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF)
  • Bygga och vidareutveckla vår privata molnplattform för multi‑tenant‑leverans
  • Driva automatisering och standardisering av plattformstjänster
  • Samarbeta nära andra teknikområden (lagring, nätverk, säkerhet, backup och plattform)
  • Bidra till arkitektur, tekniska vägval och långsiktig utveckling

Vi erbjuder mycket goda semester-och tjänstepensionsvillkor samt förmåner för dig som är förälder. Vi är en stor IT-avdelning med cirka 1500 medarbetare, utvecklingsmöjligheterna är med andra ord många! I din anställning ingår flextid och det är en självklarhet för oss att du har balans mellan arbete och fritid.

Skatteverkets it-avdelning arbetar aktivt för att främja en inkluderande arbetsplats som präglas av jämställdhet och mångfald där alla medarbetare får lika möjligheter att bidra och utvecklas. Läs mer på Jobba med it hos oss

Placeringsort är Göteborg, Malmö eller Sundbyberg.

Om dig

För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss på Skatteverket behöver du vara lyhörd, tänka nytt och ta ansvar. I arbetet är gott omdöme och förståelse för rättssäkerhet och säkerhet viktigt. Du ska också leva upp till vår medarbetarpolicy.

I det här jobbet ska du:

  • ha god samarbetsförmåga, vara hjälpsam och ha ett gott bemötande
  • självständigt planera och driva ditt arbete framåt för att nå resultat
  • ha god problemlösningsförmåga, se mönster och kunna göra avgränsningar
  • uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska, vilket innebär att du uttrycker dig på ett enkelt, tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt i både tal och skrift

Du ska även ha:

  • flerårig aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av VMware‑baserad virtualisering i större miljöer
  • flerårig aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av arbete med VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF)
  • aktuell erfarenhet av affärskritisk infrastruktur
  • aktuell erfarenhet och förståelse för private cloud‑arkitektur och plattformstänk

Det är önskvärt om du har erfarenhet av VMware NSX. Det är även önskvärt om du har erfarenhet av nätverk, containerteknik och Infrastructure as Code samt Disaster Recovery och resiliency‑design.

Bra att veta

Anställningen är tillsvidare och kan inledas med provanställning i sex månader./Anställningen är tidsbegränsad till och med dag, månad, år.

En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.

På skatteverket.se/jobb kan du exempelvis läsa om vår samhällsbärande roll, fördelarna med att jobba hos oss och hur det går till när du söker våra jobb.

När du ansöker bifogar du ditt cv. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar och du ska därför inte bifoga det i din ansökan.

Ansvariga kontaktpersoner har begränsad tillgänglighet under semesterperioden. Om du önskar komma i kontakt med någon av oss, maila oss gärna så hjälper vi dig vidare. Intervjuer planeras att genomföras under vecka 36 och 37.

För att söka tjänsten vänligen klicka på, eller kopiera, länken nedan för att komma vidare till ansökningsformuläret. Referensnummer 2026/564

You are applying for: Senior virtualiseringsexpert – VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF)

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Skatteverket har en samhällsbärande roll. Vårt arbete berör alla privatpersoner och företag och genom vårt uppdrag bidrar vi till ett väl fungerande samhälle. Vår utveckling är kunddriven och vi samverkar med andra för att skapa effektiva lösningar. Tillsammans gör vi samhället möjligt.

title: AES - Hardware Engineer
description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.

  • Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience

  • Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence

  • Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

About the Role

As a Hardware engineer you will focus on Hardware development and software testing of automotive infotainment computer systems, automotive platforms, functional block design.

What You Will Do

  • Development, test and verification of analog and digital functional blocks (e.g. power supplies, Audio blocks, MCU/SoC units) within complex hardware architectures under considering of quality, cost and suitability for series.
  • Test and analysis of application and driver software in infotainment computer systems with the aim to ensure correct functionality of software with dedicated hardware.
  • Support in design, creation and implementation of software and hardware for infotainment computer systems.
  • Creation of measurement reports and technical documentation.
  • Schematic entry and variant management.
  • Evaluation of requirements and feasibility as well as the assistance in System Design / HW realization.
  • Assisting in the technical requirements specification of purchased parts of telematics & connectivity functional blocks and in the evaluation and selection of suitable supplier.
  • Assisting in the judgment of software feature fulfillment in dedicated hardware blocks.
  • Basic knowledge in command shell programming and shell debugging (e.g. routines to control hardware units under Harman operating system).
  • Familiar with revision control systems (eg perforce for check-in/check-out).
  • Knowledge of commonly used interfaces in infotainment systems (PCIe, UART, TDM, Video-, I2C, I2S, USB) appreciated.
  • Realization of system designs, schematics and/or schematics integration of hardware applications in the range of medium to high complexity under consideration of Harman guidelines.
  • Global cooperation with other departments as Construction, Quality, Manufacturing and Software during the development process.
  • Maintenance support.
  • Technical support for internal and/or external staff in the industrialization of function items in an international environment.
  • Perform technical measurements on customer site ( EMC, Thermal, functional).
  • Schematic integration for low to medium complexity projects
  • Design verification and Bring-up activities
  • Create project documentation for projects involved in
  • Redesign of existing analog/digital functional blocks according to change requests (customer change requests, PCN, PTN …)
  • Support RFI/RFQ phase for new projects
  • Support BIOS activities (timings, power up and power down sequences, etc)
  • Support for Schematic and Layout reviews

What You Need to Be Successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical engineering, Information Technology or appropriate graduation or technician).
  • 1 up to 3 years professional experience in the HW development and verification of analog/digital applications and standalone functional units.
  • Knowledge of Hardware and Software Technology, ideally in embedded area.
  • Basic knowledge of programming software (i.e. C#, C++, LabView, VB…).
  • Knowledge of tools for schematic/layout realization and simulation (e.g. Mentor Graphics, SPICE, Ansys) as well as Microsoft applications.
  • Basic knowledge of operating systems (i.e. Linux, Android).
  • Knowledge of the requirements inside the automotive area, especially for EMC.
  • Good knowledge in spoken and written English.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Experience with infotainment/ entertainment systems (it would be a big plus).
  • Basic Linux knowledge.
  • Knowledge of commonly used interfaces in infotainment systems (PCIe, UART, TDM, Video, I2C, I2S, USB, MOST, SDIO …) appreciated.
  • Experience with hardware debugging and using lab tools.
  • Strong communications skills, both written and oral.
  • Very good English knowledge, both written and verbal.
  • Proactivity and good communication skills.
  • Excellent task and time management.
  • Attention to detail and “can do” attitude.
  • Flexibility
  • Highly organized and multitasking.
  • Analytical & critical thinking.
  • Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines

What Makes You Eligible

title: Lehtori, käsityö, Veromäen koulu
description:
Vantaan kaupunki, Kasvatus ja oppiminen, Perusopetus
Veromäen koulu

Veromiehentie 2, 01510 Vantaa

Työsuhteen kesto: Määräaikainen 17.08.2026 - 31.07.2027

Hei sinä työstäsi innostunut käsityön opettaja! Tervetuloa loistoporukkaamme työskentelemään yhteisten oppilaittemme hyväksi! Haemme Veromäen kouluun opettajaa opettamaan käsitöitä sekä ala- että yläkoulussa.

Työpaikan kuvaus:

Veromäen koulu on 1-9 vuosiluokkien yhtenäiskoulu. Koulussamme on n. 870 oppilasta ja sata henkilökunnan jäsentä. Koulumme sijaitsee hyvien liikenneyhteyksien äärellä Aviapoliksen suuralueella Pakkalassa kauppakeskus Jumbon ja lentokentän läheisyydessä.

Työyhteisömme on positiivinen, toisiaan tukeva ja ilmapiirimme on innostunut. Henkilökunnallamme on sosiaalista pääomaa, joka näkyy mm. hyvänä yhteishenkenä. Opettajien yhteissuunnittelu ja tiimityöskentely ovat toimintamme kulmakiviä. Toteutamme yhdessä yhteisopettajuuden erilaisia muotoja. Yhdessä luomamme oppimiskulttuuri toimii toimintamme punaisena lankana, jossa opettelemme itseohjaututuutta kehittäviä työtapoja. Opetusjärjestelymme perustuvat joustavuuteen huomioiden oppilaiden erilaiset oppimisen tarpeet.

Tutustu [Veromäen](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/palveluhakemisto/toimipiste/veromaen-koulu) koulun toimintaan.

Tehtävän kuvaus:

Etsimme kouluumme lehtoria opettamaan käsitöitä sekä ala- että yläkoululaisille.

Sinulla on lähikollegana toinen käsityön lehtori sekä luokanopettajia alakoulussa. Työhön kuuluu kiinteä yhteissuunnittelu sekä suunnitelmallinen yhteisopettajuus.

Pääpaino opetuksessa on teknisen käsityön sisällöissä, mutta edellytämme molempien sisältöjen osaamista ja edellytyksiä opettaa.

Opetusta on 8vvh 7.lk:lla, 14vvh 3.-6.lk:lla, 1vvh valinnaista käsityötä (tekstiili) yläkoulussa sekä 1vvh resurssiopetusta.

Etsimme opettajaa, jolla on oppilaita yksilöinä huomioivia työskentelytapoja, näkemystä yhteisopettajuudesta, hyvät yhteistyötaidot ja kehittävä työote.

Jos kiinnostuit, katso vielä esittelyvideomme ja -materiaalimme ja laita hakemusta tulemaan.

Miksi valita Vantaa?

Vantaa on maamme neljänneksi suurin kaupunki, jossa on rohkeutta tehdä asioita uudella tavalla ja taitoa toimia yhteistyössä erilaisissa verkostoissa. Kaupunki on turvallinen työnantaja, joka tarjoaa henkilöstölle laajat mahdollisuudet osaamisen kehittämiseen. Nykyaikaisissa oppilaitoksissamme arvostetaan laadukkaan kasvatuksen ja opetuksen lisäksi kansainvälisyyttä, monikulttuurisuutta ja yhteisöllisyyttä.
