title: Consultant (APAC)
description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About The Role
As a Consultant within our Advisory Global Market Access and Pricing practice, you will play a critical role in managing and contributing to strategic and technical projects. You will support clients in navigating market access, pricing, and reimbursement challenges across ex-US geographies, with a primary focus on the APAC region.

What you'll do

  • Analyze pricing and reimbursement data and present them visually in PPT to generate strategic insights and recommendations.
  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify client challenges and develop tailored solutions.
  • Create and deliver persuasive story-boarded presentations adapted to diverse audiences.
  • Manage the day-to-day delivery of multiple, complex projects, ensuring timely and high-quality execution.
  • Oversee financial project reporting and provide performance feedback to team members.
  • Identify project risks and proactively implement solutions.
  • Act as a Project Lead on small scale projects, driving execution and guiding junior team members.
  • Develop and maintain client relationships to drive business growth.
  • Lead and/or contribute to proposals and communicate solutions effectively to clients.
  • Represent Avalere Health at partnering conferences and recruitment events when required.
  • Mentor and coach junior employees, fostering their growth within the team.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing forums such as learning groups and project management workshops.
    • Key Outputs
  • High-quality client deliverables and strategic insights.
  • Persuasive client presentations and internal knowledge-sharing materials.
  • Thought leadership on market access and pricing within the APAC region.

    • About you

  • MSc in Life Sciences, Health Economics, or a related field.
  • Significant experience in Pricing & Reimbursement or Health Economics across major markets.
  • Ability to craft story-boarded, compelling, persuasive narratives based on data-driven insights
  • Proven ability to build evidence-based value propositions across healthcare systems.
  • Strong understanding of P&R and HTA submissions.
  • Experience developing market access strategies within private/alternative funding channels.
  • Excellent project management experience, including leading cross-functional teams.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to synthesize insights from unstructured and/or complex data sets.
  • Business-level fluency in English (written and oral), with strong client presentation design and delivery skills.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, including advanced formulas and charts).
    • Desired Experience
  • Proficiency in a second language (Mandarin/Korean/Japanese preferred).
  • PhD in a relevant scientific, medical, or economic discipline, such as molecular biology, health economics
  • In-depth knowledge of P&R systems in at least one country in the APAC region.
  • A strong understanding of industry trends and competitive landscapes.
    • What we can offer

    You can opt into an enhanced central provident fund, as well as benefit from private medical insurance, dental services, and life insurance for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid working, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 25 days of annual leave plus two personal well-being days, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.

    Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. Access our employee assistance program, virtual health services, and personalized health support. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

    We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Familjehemssekreterare till Familjehemsenheten
description:
I Mölndals stad är vi stolta över att ha Sveriges viktigaste jobb där vi tillsammans skapar bästa möjliga vardag för våra medborgare. Med kunskap, mod och kreativitet utvecklar vi våra verksamheter och bidrar till att Mölndal blir en ännu bättre plats att leva och jobba i. Välkommen att göra skillnad i människors vardag varje dag!

Social- och arbetsmarknadsförvaltningen ger Mölndals invånare stöd, trygghet och nya möjligheter. Förvaltningen ansvarar för individ- och familjeomsorg, flyktingmottagande och arbetsmarknadsinsatser.

Vår ambition är att varje invånare i Mölndal ska känna sig sedd och trygg, och kunna lita på att hens rättigheter tillvaratas. Genom samarbete, mod och ett lyhört bemötande vill vi bidra till att Mölndalsbor kan leva ett självständigt liv och få möjlighet att bygga sin framtid.

Familjehemsenheten består av tolv medarbetare som är indelade i två grupper, barnsekreterare och familjehemssekreterare. Nu utökar vi enheten med ytterligare en familjehemssekreterare. Till enheten hör också två metodhandledare och en specialpedagog. Vi har olika kompetens och bakgrund, det gemensamma är att vi är engagerade och har ett starkt barnperspektiv. Vi jobbar nära varandra, är prestigelösa, har roligt på jobbet och ger varandra ett stort kollegialt stöd. Vi är en förvaltning och en enhet som kontinuerligt arbetar med utveckling för att det ska bli så bra som möjligt för dem vi är till för.

Som anställd inom Mölndals Stad erbjuds du flextid, extern handledning samt friskvårdsbidrag.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som familjehemssekreterare ansvarar du för att rekrytera, utreda, utbilda och handleda jour- och familjehem samt kontaktpersoner och kontaktfamiljer. Det ingår i arbetet att matcha barnets behov med ett lämpligt familjehem. Barnets socialsekreterare och familjehemssekreterare arbetar i team kring de placerade barnen. Arbetet är självständigt, men kräver ett nära samarbete med kollegorna på enheten samt med andra interna och externa samarbetspartners. 

I Mölndal har vi ett styrkebaserat förhållningssätt bland annat genom Signs of Safety. Det innebär vi har ett stort fokus på nätverksplaceringar och nätverksarbete. Vi arbetar också med Förälder på avstånd, det vill säga att ursprungsföräldrarna ska vara så delaktiga som möjligt i de placerade barnens liv.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är utbildad socionom. Du ska ha kunskap om de lagar och regler som styr den sociala barnavården och kunna anpassa ditt arbetssätt utifrån dessa. Det är önskvärt att du har erfarenhet av familjehemsarbete och att du har utbildning i att utreda familjehem, som Kälvesten eller liknande.  Det är meriterande om du har jobbat med barn och unga och vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning. 

Vi vill att du har förmåga att arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du ska ha lätt att samarbeta med såväl kollegor som arbetsledning. Vi önskar att du är lösningsinriktad och kreativ, inte minst vad det gäller uppdraget att hitta familjehem och matcha barn och familjehem. Samtidigt önskar vi att du är trygg och stabil och klarar av att självständigt stötta familjehemmen i deras uppdrag. Du som söker är intresserad av att arbeta för att ge våra barn och ungdomar som är placerade en trygg och förutsägbar tillvaro.

B-körkort är ett krav. 

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Vi ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Vi vill upplysa om att din ansökan är en offentlig handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen. Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du INTE söka via systemet utan kontakta ansvarig rekryterande chef för hantering av din ansökan. Kontaktuppgifter hittar du i annonsen. 

Innan en eventuell anställning kommer vi att kontrollera medborgarskap. Är du inte medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du kunna uppvisa ett giltigt uppehåll-/arbetstillstånd eller kunna styrka att du är undantagen från skyldigheten att ha arbetstillstånd.

Bakgrundskontroller kan komma att genomföras innan anställning.

I vissa tjänster krävs digital identifiering (t.ex. BankID) för att utföra arbetsuppgifter. Identifieringen används endast för att bekräfta din identitet i systemen.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

title: Weekend Room Attendant
description:
A fantastic opportunity for a Room Attendant to join our team at Kimpton Charlotte Square on a 16-hours per week contract!

In this role you will be covering weekend shifts and you will earn £13.20 per hour – equal to £10,982.40 salary

Kimpton Charlotte Square Hotel brings together traditional Edinburgh architecture with an exciting and fresh indoor feel, offering our guests a modern luxurious stay. Welcoming locals to relax in our Garden area (a must visit), experiencing mouth-watering food in BABA restaurant, or guests from far and wide being pampered in our state-of-the-art Spa – we cover it all!

What’s in it for you as our Room Attendant:

  • Becoming part of the IHG Hotels & Resorts family, one of the world’s leading hotel companies - which means global opportunities.

  • Complimentary stay for you+1 in our Hotel upon successful completion of probation, generous discounts across our F&B outlets at Kimpton Charlotte Square and InterContinental Edinburgh The George, plus Spa & Gym discounts at our Kimpton property.

  • Extensive training, opportunities for career progression across the world, plus 2 paid days volunteering per year with a cause of your choice

  • Wagestream - a financial wellbeing app giving you the opportunity to save, track and withdraw your pay as you earn it.

  • Apart from Meals whilst on duty, we also provide every employee company sick pay and life insurance, Mental Health First Aiders on Duty, and access to Employee Assistance Programs.

  • 28 days holiday each year, including bank holidays, this increases up to a maximum of 33 days (Pro Rated) & Enhanced Family Leave (you can ask more details at the interview).

  • Amazing discounts for our hotels and restaurants around the world, plus discounts from over 15,000 stores – all the way from retail to cinema!

  • Don’t forget, bring your friends and take part in our generous ‘Refer a Friend’ programme!

As a Room Attendant, you’ll be 100% you, bringing your authentic personality to everything you do; be the ultimate host, confidently leading yourself and making creative decisions that elevate every interaction; and spark joy, using every tool available to craft meaningful and memorable experiences.

Your main duties and responsibilities will be providing guests with a pristine room, meeting health and safety standards and working at pace to ensure rooms are ready for our guests to start checking into. Greeting guests with a friendly manner and communicating regularly with our Front Office team.

To succeed as a Room Attendant, you will need:

  • Experience working within Cleaning or Housekeeping would be beneficial

  • Ability to work independently, working to time deadlines and at a fast pace

  • Passionate about delivering excellent Guest experiences and going the extra mile to ensure that they are met with a room that WOWs them

  • Drive to produce results, we work together within the Kimpton family to continue to provide our guests with extremely personal experiences and human connection.

  • A warm and authentic personality, with a can-do attitude and commitment to service.

  • Overall, you will be willing to work within our team to embrace our service and delight our guests!

At IHG, we believe there’s Room for You: Room to Grow (providing career development and learning opportunities), Room to Belong (fostering an inclusive environment where diverse employees can be their authentic selves), and Room to Make a Difference (empowering employees to have an impact on the guest experience and the business).

At Kimpton, our shared mission is to make lives better through heartfelt human connections. This emotional investment drives all that we do, and it’s why you’ll love the work, too. Our colleagues are empowered and encouraged to act from the heart, to go above and beyond to create ridiculously personal experiences for each other and our guests!

Our passion is YOU…come as you are!

If you are someone who likes to march to the beat of their own drum and wants to join a company which encourages authentic individuality, apply today to join us as a Room Attendant!

You must meet the legal requirements to work in the UK.

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any adjustments or support at any stage, and your recruiter will assist you accordingly.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We firmly believe that all our colleagues deserve to be treated equally and have the same opportunities to develop and grow their skills within our business and provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and colleagues without regard to an individual's, race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or familial status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Multiverse Computing

Multiverse is a well-funded, fast-growing deep-tech company founded in 2019. We are the largest quantum software company in the EU and have been recognized by CB Insights (2023 and 2025) as one of the 100 most promising AI companies in the world.
With 180+ employees and growing, our team is fully multicultural and international. We deliver hyper-efficient software for companies seeking a competitive edge through quantum computing and artificial intelligence.
Our flagship products, CompactifAI and Singularity, address critical needs across various industries:

· CompactifAI is a groundbreaking compression tool for foundational AI models based on Tensor Networks. It enables the compression of large AI systems—such as language models—to make them significantly more efficient and portable.

· Singularity is a quantum- and quantum-inspired optimization platform used by blue-chip companies to solve complex problems in finance, energy, manufacturing, and beyond. It integrates seamlessly with existing systems and delivers immediate performance gains on classical and quantum hardware.

You’ll be working alongside world-leading experts to develop solutions that tackle real-world challenges. We’re looking for passionate individuals eager to grow in an ethics-driven environment that values sustainability and diversity.

We’re committed to building a truly inclusive culture—come and join us.

As a Software Engineer you will

· Join a world-class team of Quantum and AI experts with an extensive track record in both academia and industry.

· Work with Fortune-500 customers from government and private sectors.

· Contribute to our groundbreaking compressing tool

· Tackle high value open problems from industry.

· Take on technical leadership and work together with software and DevOps engineers as well as our machine learning and quantum experts to industrialize Multiverse’s core technologies

Required Qualifications

Software Engineering

  • Proven track record designing and implementing production-grade software running under real load

  • Solid grasp of clean architecture, separation of concerns, SOLID principles, testability and maintainability as first-class concerns

  • Experience with software design patterns and sound judgment on when (and when not) to apply them

  • Understands service-level architecture: API design, layered architectures, event-driven patterns, and how to structure code that outlives its author

  • Good grounding in software security principles: input validation, secret management, dependency auditing, container hardening, secure API design

  • Experience with containerized deployment fundamentals (Docker) and CI/CD concepts

Soft Skills

  • Proposes solutions to unfamiliar problems: research first, presents alternatives with trade-offs, doesn’t wait to be told the answer

  • Breaks complex cross-repo issues into sequenced, followable steps

  • Acts as developer, mentor, and reviewer in the same sprint – writes production code, gives PR feedback to mid-level engineers, upholds review standards

  • Communicates technical risk clearly – surfaces blockers early with context

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and working under pressure; self-directed

  • Collaborates cross-functionally (MLOps, DevOps, Platform Engineering) without needing a manager to mediate

Preferred Qualifications

ML & LLM Exposure

  • Exposure to PyTorch and/or HuggingFace Transformers (fine-tuning, inference, compression workflows)

  • Familiarity with ML infra concepts: training orchestration, experiment tracking, GPU job scheduling

  • Awareness of LLM techniques: distillation, quantization, pruning, inference serving

  • Some exposure to GPU-aware engineering (CUDA, mixed precision, multi-GPU) is a plus

Tooling & Infrastructure

  • ECR, ArgoCD/Helm, structured CI/CD pipelines beyond basic Docker

  • Async long-running job orchestration patterns

  • CLI frameworks, Python packaging, Docker multi-stage builds

  • General comfort moving across CLI tooling → API services → infra glue

Perks & Benefits

· Indefinite contract.

· Equal pay guaranteed.

· Variable performance bonus.

· Signing bonus.

· We offer work visa sponsorship (If applicable).

· Relocation package (if applicable).

· Private health insurance.

· Flexible remuneration: hospitality and public transportation.

· Eligibility for educational budget according to internal policy.

· Hybrid opportunity.

· Flexible working hours.

· Language classes and discounted lunch options

· Working in a high paced environment, working on cutting edge technologies.

· Career plan. Opportunity to learn and teach.

· Progressive Company. Happy people culture

As an equal opportunity employer, Multiverse Computing is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

title: Forward Deployed - Software Engineer (m/f/n)
description:
Currently, for one of our Partners, we are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed - Software Engineer (m/f/n) to support a new project delivered for a US-based enterprise environment.

The Opportunity

As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you embed with clients and turn ambiguous tax and business problems into working software, quickly. You scope against fuzzy requirements, prototype in front of stakeholders, and ship the applications, workflows, and interfaces that prove value inside a single engagement rather than over a multi-year roadmap. You use agentic development tooling to close the gap between an idea and a running system.

This is a hands-on role. FDE pods are two engineers, so you are the primary builder: you write most of the code yourself while coaching and growing the engineer alongside you. You are as comfortable in a working session with a tax partner as you are in the codebase. You listen first, translate between technical and business language, and own the outcome from first demo to handoff.

Responsibilities

  • Embed with client teams, pull requirements out of incomplete or shifting specs, and turn them into a working technical direction

  • Do the majority of the hands-on build: applications, workflows, and interfaces across the full stack, from front end to back end, APIs, and integrations

  • Use agentic development frameworks and AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to prototype and ship at engagement speed

  • Stand up and integrate MCP servers and LLM-powered features that connect client data and tools to AI workflows

  • Demo early and often, take feedback directly from stakeholders, and iterate in tight loops

  • Coach the second engineer on your pod, teaching as you build and reviewing their work

  • Set the architecture and make practical build-vs-buy and technology calls for each problem

  • Promote reusable patterns back to the core platform where they generalize

  • Keep quality fit for purpose: solid enough to prove value, with polish where it counts

  • Plan for handoff or retirement of engagement-built software from the start

What You Must Have

  • Bachelor's Degree

  • At least 4 years of experience

  • English C1

What Sets You Apart

  • Master's Degree preferred

  • Using agentic development frameworks and AI coding assistants fluently to move faster

  • Building with LLMs and MCP server architectures to wire client data and tools into AI applications

  • Delivering against ambiguous, shifting requirements and reframing the problem when the first spec is wrong

  • Staying hands-on as a senior engineer while coaching a less experienced teammate

  • Working directly with non-technical stakeholders: demoing, aligning, and translating between technical and business concerns

  • Listening closely to learn a new domain quickly and build what the client actually needs

  • Using good judgment on architecture, build-vs-buy, and where to spend effort under time pressure

  • Understanding responsible AI practices and sound data handling in client environments

Offer

  • Contract: B2B via SHIMI

  • Type of work: remote

  • Rate: up to 175 PLN/h net + VAT

  • Start: ASAP

  • Private medical care and sportscard

title: Apprentice Ophthalmic Assistant
description:
Who are we?

Newmedica are one of the leading providers of NHS ophthalmology services in England, providing outpatients appointments, diagnostic testing and eye surgery. We aim to change lives through better sight and eye health.


We care for thousands of NHS and private patients a year in our specialist eye clinics across the country. We have significant growth plans over the next few years as we look to establish a national footprint and open many new sites across the UK.


We are thrilled to say that following an independently conducted survey of Newmedica colleagues to tell us what it’s like to work here, we have been certified as a Great Place to Work for the second year running. The feedback has directly contributed to Newmedica being listed among the UK’s top 50 Best Workplaces™ for 2025.




Role overview
We are looking for an Apprentice Ophthalmic Assistant to join our Norwich site. This will be 40 hours per week, with 80% of time spent working on site and 20% of time spent studying.



Ophthalmic Assistants are the public face of Newmedica and are integral to the successful operation of the clinic. They are responsible for performing clinical tests and supporting the clinical assessment of each patient and for ensuring that all patients understand their treatment. Ophthalmic Assistants also play a role in our patients’ theatre journey, ensuring all paperwork is completed, drops instilled and supporting the Clinicians to ensure the procedures run as smoothly as possible.


Combining a friendly and accessible personal manner with basic clinical testing skills, they pride themselves in delivering great customer service and their ability to work within small teams to maintain and enhance processes to maximize quality and efficiency.


The post-holder will complete an 18 month apprenticeship in Healthcare Science (Level 2) with Dynamic Training alongside the position with the outcome being a Level 2 Diploma in Healthcare Science. Therefore it is expected that our Apprentice Ophthalmic Assistant will be adept at managing their own diary, ensuring that their study is completed to the best of their ability alongside the duties expected on site.



What skills and experience do I need?

  • A passion for delivering excellent service and exceptional customer care
  • Excellent administration skills
  • The ability to reassure and support patients in a healthcare setting where people may be nervous or anxious about treatment
  • Excellent computer skills. Comfortable with Microsoft Office products and the ability to learn new systems
  • Outstanding communication skills
  • A good team player - happy to jump in and support others when required
  • 5 GCSEs including Maths and English, or the willingness to undertake the functional skills programme
  • A commitment to ongoing study with support from the Newmedica team


What we're offering

  • A salary of £16,640 per annum.
  • 200 hours annual leave plus bank holidays.
  • An additional day annual leave for your birthday.
  • Death in Service scheme.
  • A company pension scheme.
  • Access to a range of benefits including free eye tests, discounted or free glasses, a free 24/7 well-being/counselling/advice service.
  • An environment where your learning and development is supported through a range of various learning tools and courses.
  • Working with a friendly multi-disciplinary team passionate about improving the lives of our patients
  • A bright, spacious and modern working environment, built to the highest standards.


If you would like an informal chat about the opportunity or to request a job description, please contact Emily Pickersgill, HR Lead at emily.pickersgill@newmedica.co.uk


Our employment offers are subject to receipt of satisfactory pre-employment checks. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK and a Disclosure and Barring Service check will be necessary in the event of a successful application which we will pay for.


At Newmedica, we actively promote diversity and equal opportunities, and we are committed to this, in both the running of our services and how we recruit out staff. We actively encourage applications from everyone with the essential requirements of the job, regardless of any protected characteristics.


Newmedica is fully committed to safeguarding the welfare of all people, irrespective of gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, race, language or social origin.

title: SAP MM Consultant
description:
About Us
Abeam Consulting is a global professional services company that specializes in delivering business transformation and technology solutions to clients across a wide range of industries. With a global presence and over 9000 employees worldwide we aim to be the transformation partner of choice for all of our clients.

About the Team
The Enterprise Transformation (EX) team is the current SAP Partner of the Year for Singapore and also SAP’s Regional Strategic Partner. The EX team is continuously looking to build its capabilities and competencies in line with SAP’s regional strategy and in working with our clients both old and new on their transformation journey.

Role Overview
As the SAP MM Lead Consultant, you will act as the primary point of contact for SAP Materials Management (MM) solution delivery, driving client engagement, solution design, and implementation activities.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Lead the design, configuration, customization, and deployment of SAP MM solutions to meet complex business requirements.
  • Facilitate client workshops, issue-resolution sessions, and blueprinting activities by explaining SAP templates, gathering requirements, and providing expert guidance on best practices.
  • Analyze business processes, identify client requirements, and define solution scope to support successful project delivery.
  • Create and maintain project documentation, including presentations, workshop materials, process flows, and solution design documents.
  • Prepare and deliver demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and presentations to showcase SAP MM capabilities and support implementation and pre-sales activities.
  • Develop demo data and validate SAP MM functions, configurations, and system processes to address business and technical issues.
  • Support customers throughout the entire SAP MM implementation lifecycle, from requirements gathering and blueprinting through testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
  • Stay current with SAP MM releases, enhancements, and industry best practices to provide informed recommendations and innovative solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, project managers, business analysts, and stakeholders, to ensure seamless integration and successful project outcomes.
  • Plan, manage, and monitor project tasks, timelines, resources, and deliverables to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and according to quality standards.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by providing business process consulting, troubleshooting complex issues, and driving continuous process improvements.

Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • At least 6 years of experience as an SAP MM Consultant, including participation in end-to-end SAP MM implementation projects.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to explain SAP processes, lead workshops, handle Q&A sessions, and engage stakeholders effectively.
  • Strong documentation and presentation skills, including the creation of PowerPoint materials for SAP solution explanations, workshops, and issue-resolution discussions.
  • In-depth knowledge of SAP MM, including configuration, customization, integration, and implementation methodologies, tools, and templates.
  • Strong understanding of material management processes, industry best practices, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex business and system issues.
  • Experience collaborating with clients and cross-functional teams, while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of SAP SD and SD-MM integration processes (e.g., sales order to purchase order flow, goods receipt, goods issue, and billing processes) is an advantage.
  • Experience in SAP implementation projects within the manufacturing industry is preferred.
  • Flexible to work on-site and attend client meetings as required.
Why Join Us
At Abeam Consulting, we place a strong emphasis on collaboration, and helping our employees grow and develop their skills, offering a supportive and empowering work environment. With a presence in multiple countries and a diverse range of clients, Abeam Consulting offers an exciting and dynamic workplace for individuals looking to build a career in consulting. Abeam Consulting has also recently joined SAP’s regional strategic partner initiative as their first regional partner in the region and has also been recognized by UiPath as a Diamond Partner in providing RPA solutions. With such accolades, we aim to continue driving enterprise and digital transformation initiatives in order to transform the way people work and communicate in the digital age. In addition, our industry team is working tirelessly in order to bring more solutions to the banking and finance sector.

title: 상품전략 리드
description:
About

[BRAND]

퓨어웰니스는 누구나 건강을 위한 소비를 똑똑하고 쉽게 하는 세상을 만들고 있는 약국 MSO 스타트업입니다.
쏟아지는 건강 정보와 수많은 제품 중에서 꼭 필요한 것만 정제하고 큐레이션하여 전달합니다.

[WHY PVREWELLNESS]

현재 외부 투자 없이 사업을 시작해 3개월 만에 월 매출 12억 원을 달성했고, 올해 10개 이상의 K-뷰티 약국 오픈을 목표로 빠르게 성장하고 있습니다.

우리의 가장 큰 차별점은 약사의 눈으로 제품과 고객을 바라본다는 것입니다.
성분을 근거로 제품을 평가하고, 고객의 피부 고민에 맞는 큐레이션을 직접 설계합니다.
단순히 잘 팔리는 제품을 진열하는 것이 아니라, 왜 이 제품이어야 하는지를 설명할 수 있는 매대를 만듭니다.

[OUR ROADMAP]

대한민국에서 제일 가고 싶은 약국의 대명사가 됩니다.

• 차별화된 압도적 고객 경험을 통해 앞서갑니다.
• 내수 시장을 대상으로 창고형 약국 카테고리를 확장합니다.
• 똑똑하고 쉬운 건강 소비를 위해 PB 상품을 개발합니다.

이 여정에서 상품을 넘어 브랜드를 만들고, 선택을 넘어 기준을 만드는 진짜 브랜드 큐레이터를 찾습니다

Responsibilities

[퓨어웰니스의 상품전략 리드는 이런 일을 해요]
• 고객 중심의 상품 전략을 통해 퓨어웰니스만의 경쟁력을 만들어요.
- 퓨어웰니스만의 상품 철학과 고객 인사이트를 바탕으로 상품 전략과 카테고리 방향성을 리드해요.
- 고객의 건강한 소비를 위한 차별화된 상품 라인업을 기획하고 운영해요.
- 고객과 시장의 변화를 반영하여 상품 포트폴리오를 지속적으로 고도화하고 새로운 상품 기회를 발굴해요.
- 상품이 퓨어웰니스를 찾는 가장 강력한 이유가 될 수 있도록 상품 경쟁력을 만들어가요.

• 데이터를 기반으로 상품 성장을 리드해요.
- 고객, 시장, 판매 데이터를 기반으로 카테고리별 성장 정략을 수립해요.
- 조직 내 핵심 지표를 분석하고 더 큰 성장을 위한 실행 전략을 도출해요.
- 상품 도입, 확대, 축소에 대한 의사결정을 리드하며 상품 운영 효율을 지속적으로 개선해요.
- 데이터와 현장의 인사이트를 연결하여 퓨어웰니스만의 MD 운영 기준을 만들어가요.

•확장 가능한 상품 운영 체계를 만들어요.
- 브랜드/벤더사와의 전략적 파트너십을 구축하고 협업을 리드해요.
- SKU 운영, 발주, 재고, 프로모션 등 상품 운영 프로세스를 지속적으로 고도화해요.
- 조직이 확장되어도 일관된 상품 경쟁력을 유지할 수 있는 운영 체계를 설계해요.
- MD의 성장을 돕고, 팀이 더 좋은 의사결정을 할 수 있는 기준과 일하는 방식을 함께 만들어가요.

Requirements

[이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요]
• 뷰티/헬스케어/리테일 카테고리 MD 경력 5년 이상 혹은 이에 준하는 역량을 갖추신 분
• 스킨케어/뷰티 카테고리에 대한 깊은 관심과 이해도가 있는 분
• 카테고리 전략부터 상품 운영까지 MD 전 과정을 리드해보신 분
• 고객과 데이터를 기반으로 전략을 수립하고 실행하여 결과를 만드신 분
• 브랜드/벤더사와 전략적인 파트너십을 구축하고 협업을 이끄신 분

Preferred

[이런 분이시라면 더 좋아요]
• 카테고리를 운영하는 것을 넘어, 하나의 브랜드를 함께 성장시키고 싶으신 분
• 정답이 없는 시장에서 새로운 리테일의 기준을 만들어보고 싶으신 분
• MD팀만의 일하는 기준과 문화를 함께 만들어가고 싶으신 분
• 국내를 넘어 글로벌 상품 전략을 리드하는 커리어를 만들어가고 싶으신 분
• H&B, 드럭스토어, 뷰티 리테일에서 카테고리 성장을 리드해보신 분
• AI툴을 적극 활용하여 업무의 생산성을 극대화한 경험이 있으신 분

Benefits

[업무 몰입과 성장을 위해 아낌없이 지원합니다]
• 인센티브 제도
• 임직원 추천 보상금 200만원
• 교육비 인당 연 180만원
• 도서비 월 1권 지원
• AI 구독·토큰 적극 지원

[건강하게 휴식하고 일하실 수 있도록 지원합니다]
• 점심 식대 1일 12,000원
• 야근 시 저녁 식대, 택시비 지원
• 일에만 몰입이 가능한 당충전 간식 지원

title: QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
description:
About inGain

inGain is a Latvian B2B fintech startup delivering an end-to-end, no-code SaaS platform for launching and running lending operations from digital application flows and underwriting to servicing and debt collection. Established and based in Riga, we have steadily scaled since our foundation in 2022, now comprising a team of over 30 talents serving clients across 11 markets in Europe, Africa and Middle East.


Our Tech Stack:

  • Backend: PHP 8.3 with custom modular framework that extensively leverages Symfony and Illuminate components to support complex, large-scale SaaS workflows;
  • Frontend: Laravel Blade, focused on clarity, performance, and maintainability;
  • Databases: MySQL 8 as our primary relational datastore;
  • Testing: Backend tests running with PHPUnit 12 (Feature, integration, unit tests) and Postman for API testing;
  • Caching & Performance: Redis for caching and fast data access;
  • Observability & Monitoring: Sentry for error tracking, Grafana and Prometheus for metrics and system visibility
  • Infrastructure & Local Development: Docker-based development environments for consistency and ease of setup
  • Version Control: Self-hosted GitLab with full CI/CD pipelines;
  • Project Management: We use Jira for managing tickets and Confluence for storing up-to-date information;
  • Collaboration: Slack for day-to-day communication and coordination;
  • Engineering Process: A well-defined SDLC with code reviews, manual/automated testing, and controlled releases.


In this role you will:

  • Perform both manual and automated testing.
  • Participate in improving and defining the organization-wide manual and automated testing strategy while actively writing and executing tests.
  • Guide the junior QA, handle workload planning, and align QA metrics with business KPIs.
  • Collaborate with the CTO to review system design, evaluate architectural risks, and ensure testability is built-in.
  • Manage test data frameworks, validate large-scale data migrations, and ensure high database performance.
  • Create highly detailed bug reports, documentation, and dashboards that give the development team immediate clarity on how to resolve issues.


You are going to be a great fit if you:

  • Have 4+ years of experience in both manual and test automation engineering.
  • Are fully self-sufficient, when you receive a ticket/task, you see the bigger picture, know exactly what actions to take, and can independently solve complex issues.
  • Possess an advanced understanding of database structures, optimization principles, indexes, and feel confident querying multiple tables with complex subqueries.
  • Have a global view of software architecture, understanding exactly how different services, functions, and modules interact and depend on each other.
  • Exhibit excellent communication skills, with the ability to argue your technical points logically and give constructive feedback to team members.
  • Are fluent in English to seamlessly communicate with colleagues and clients.


You will get plus points if you have:

    • Experience working with lending (or other fintech) products.
    • Previous experience supervising and guiding junior colleagues.
    • Knowledge of CI/CD integration for automated test suites and experience with large data warehousing validation.
    • Experience in designing reusable test libraries from scratch that optimize test execution times.


    In your first months, you will:

    • Month 1: Start getting onboarded into our system architecture, start learning our product and industry standards, get to know your colleagues (QA and Developers), and take ownership of your first incoming tickets.
    • Month 2: Dive deeper into our databases and core application logic. You will handle complex manual testing tasks independently, begin guiding the junior QA on daily workloads, and help identify areas where system testability can be improved.
    • Month 3: Become a core, self-sufficient member of the team. You will actively assist in mapping out our upcoming automation strategy, help validate large-scale data migrations, and build detailed bug-tracking dashboards to give the development team immediate clarity.


    Our offer to you:

    • Compensation: A gross monthly salary of €3000-€3500 based on your experience
    • Share Options: Earn share options, giving you a stake in our success.
    • Health insurance (and critical illness insurance) policies after probation period.
    • Hybrid work model: 3 days per week in-office (Tuesdays, Thursdays, and 3rd day of your choice)
    • A-Class office: Elemental Business Centre in Skanste.
    • Free parking at the office.
    • Lunch allowance to cover your lunches whilst working from the office
    • Complimentary snacks in the office to keep you energized throughout the day.
    • Training to expand your industry knowledge.
    • A birthday gift


    Join us and contribute to reshaping the fintech landscape!

title: Reliability Engineer
description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Reliability Engineer for our Crane Services team. In this role you will report to our Maintenance Manager and sit within our Mill Services function.

As a Reliability Engineer, you'll help take the plant from construction to stable operations. You'll oversee the installation and commissioning of cranes, conductor systems, monorails and other lifting equipment, ensuring safe, high-quality delivery. Once the plant is running, you'll improve the reliability and performance of our lifting equipment by developing maintenance strategies, solving technical challenges and driving continuous improvements.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

  • Oversee the installation and commissioning of EOT cranes, conductor systems, monorails and other lifting equipment.

  • Work with contractors, OEMs and internal teams to deliver safe, high-quality installations.

  • Prepare maintenance plans, spare parts strategies and documentation to support a smooth handover to operations.

  • Investigate equipment failures, identify root causes and implement long-term improvements.

  • Develop preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to increase equipment reliability and reduce downtime.

  • Use maintenance and performance data to improve the reliability, availability and lifetime of cranes and lifting equipment.

What you’ll bring

You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking - and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience installing, commissioning, maintaining or improving the reliability of cranes or industrial lifting equipment.

  • Experience from heavy industry, manufacturing or industrial maintenance.

  • Good understanding of crane systems, electrical and mechanical equipment, and relevant industry standards.

  • Experience with reliability methods such as RCA, FMEA and preventive or predictive maintenance, as well as CMMS/EAM systems (e.g. SAP PM, Hexagon or Maximo).

  • Good English communication skills. Swedish is an advantage.

Benefits at Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Boden Site

Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.

title: Field Chief Technology Officer
description:
About Workato

Workato delivers enterprise infrastructure for the agentic era, redefining iPaaS and helping enterprises unify data, applications, processes, and AI into a single, governed platform. A leader in Enterprise MCP and trusted by 50% of the Fortune 500, Workato’s cloud-native architecture connects every application, data source, and process to power real-time orchestration at scale. With enterprise-grade security and continuous innovation at its core, Workato provides the trusted foundation for organizations to automate with confidence and operationalize AI across the business. To learn more, visit www.workato.com

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company.

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”

  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world

  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America

  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Field CTO to serve as the most senior technology voice to our largest customers, prospects, and the market.

The Field CTO is a C-suite-caliber technology executive who operates as a peer to the CIOs, CTOs, and CDOs of our Fortune 500 customers and a credible presence in their boardrooms. You are not a pre-sales architect with a bigger title. You are an executive who has sat in their chair: you have owned enterprise technology budgets of $50M+, presented to Boards, and made the platform, vendor, and transformation investment decisions our customers' CIOs face today. You know firsthand why those bets succeed or stall.

You will shape how the world's largest enterprises adopt agentic AI and automation at scale, translating Workato's platform vision into boardroom-ready strategy, influencing executive committees, and bringing field intelligence back to inform Workato's product roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

Success in this role is measured by your ability to build trusted executive relationships, influence strategic customer outcomes, accelerate enterprise platform adoption, and position Workato as the category leader in enterprise AI and automation.

What You'll Own

  • Trusted Advisor to the C-Suite. Serve as the senior technology counterpart to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and Boards at our top strategic accounts. Lead executive briefings, advisory councils, strategic visioning sessions, and architecture reviews that shape multi-year transformation roadmaps.
  • Boardroom Engagement. Present to customer Boards and executive committees on AI execution strategy, agentic operating models, governance, and the economics of enterprise automation. Build alignment across business and technology stakeholders so organizations can make complex transformation decisions with confidence.
  • Strategic Deal Acceleration. Partner with Sales leadership on Workato's largest, most strategic, and most complex enterprise pursuits. Strengthen executive sponsorship, expand the strategic scope of opportunities, and unlock seven- and eight-figure platform investments.
  • Transformation Strategy. Advise customers on enterprise AI adoption, intelligent automation, modern integration architecture, governance models, and organizational readiness. Help executive teams define pragmatic roadmaps that extend beyond implementation toward sustainable business transformation.
  • Voice of the Market. Serve as a primary spokesperson at industry events (including Gartner symposia and leading industry summits), analyst briefings, executive forums, and customer advisory councils. Author keynotes, executive point-of-view papers, and strategic content that establish Workato as the definitive leader in enterprise AI execution.
  • Product & Strategy Influence. Translate field signals into direct input to the CEO, CPO, CTO, and Product organization on roadmap priorities, platform strategy, competitive positioning, and emerging customer requirements, including Enterprise MCP, agentic AI frameworks, and governance.
  • Field Enablement. Coach Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales leadership on executive engagement, strategic technology positioning, and boardroom storytelling. Build repeatable frameworks that scale Workato's executive motion.

Who You Are

You are a rare profile: an enterprise operator with genuine commercial range. You have led transformation inside a Fortune 500 organization, and you know how to represent a platform to executive buyers, whether you built that muscle on the vendor side or by carrying your own company's capabilities to its largest customers. You understand how executive technology decisions are made, how enterprise transformation succeeds, and what it takes to create lasting business value.

  • Enterprise Chief Information Officer (CIO) or Chief Technology Officer (CTO) experience at a Fortune 500 / Global 2000 organization, with ownership of enterprise architecture, application portfolios, technology strategy, and transformation at scale.
  • Commercial experience on either side of the table. Strongly preferred: executive-level experience at an enterprise software vendor selling into the Fortune 500 (iPaaS, AI/ML, cloud platforms, data, ERP, or adjacent infrastructure). Also compelling: a customer-facing operator role in which you regularly represented your company's products, platform, and capabilities to enterprise customers, advisory boards, and industry analysts. Either way, you understand how executive buying decisions are made.
  • 15+ years of senior technology leadership, including 5+ years at the C-suite or equivalent executive level.
  • Deep fluency in enterprise integration architecture, AI and agentic systems, data platforms, cloud architecture, and the modern enterprise application ecosystem (Salesforce, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, NetSuite, Oracle, Microsoft).
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale digital transformation with measurable business outcomes.
  • A compelling storyteller and communicator, with executive presence proven through Board work, public speaking, analyst engagement, media, or published thought leadership.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, influencing without formal authority, navigating matrixed organizations, and moving at the pace of a high-growth platform company.
  • Naturally curious and commercially minded, energized by helping customers solve complex strategic challenges, with the judgment and executive maturity the world's largest enterprises expect.

Location & Travel

  • Remote, based anywhere in the United States (proximity to a major airport hub strongly preferred).
  • Approximately 60% travel to customer sites, executive briefing centers, industry events, and Workato headquarters.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you are a trusted advisor to Workato's most strategic customers: leading executive strategy engagements, shaping transformational AI and automation initiatives, influencing the direction of major enterprise opportunities, and strengthening Workato's relationships with senior technology leaders. You contribute directly to product strategy through market intelligence and executive customer feedback, and you represent Workato as a recognized thought leader in enterprise AI and automation.

What We Offer

A platform-defining role at the most strategic moment in enterprise software in a generation. Direct visibility to and influence with Workato’s CEO and executive team. Compensation commensurate with C-suite executive talent - competitive base, performance incentives, and meaningful equity. The opportunity to shape the category that will define how the Fortune 500 operates for the next decade.

title: 브랜드 커뮤니케이션 매니저 (뉴미디어/콘텐츠)
description:
About

[오렌지스퀘어를 소개합니다]
2천만 외국인 관광객이 한국에서 쓰는 돈, 그 전부가 하나의 플랫폼 위에서 움직입니다.

오렌지스퀘어는 그동안 제각각 흩어져 있던 한국 여행의 모든 순간을 처음으로 한자리에 모았습니다. 결제는 물론 교통과 통신, K-뷰티 쇼핑과 K-POP 덕질, K-브랜드·맛집·핫플레이스 추천, 그리고 여행자들이 후기와 정보를 나누는 커뮤니티까지.

이 모든 걸 한 손에 쥐게 하는 서비스가 '와우패스(WOWPASS)'입니다.

와우패스는 일본인 관광객 3명 중 1명, 중화권 관광객 4명 중 1명, 전체 방한객 9명 중 1명이 사용하는 국내 최초 결제·교통·환전을 통합한 올인원 선불카드로 출발하였고, 이제 그 무게 중심은 커머스 플랫폼으로 옮겨가고 있습니다.

외국인이 한국에서 무엇을 사고, 무엇을 먹고, 어디에서 머무는지. 국내 외국인 소비 데이터를 선점하며 새로운 시장을 만들어 갑니다.

△누적 앱 가입자 330만 명 △카드 발급 280만 장 △무인 키오스크 430여 대 △누적 거래액 1조7,000억 원 △20222025 매출 약 30배 성장(253억 원) △3년 연속 영업흑자 유지

정부가 '방한 외국인 3,000만 시대'를 향해 달려가는 지금, 이 시장은 이제 막 문을 열었습니다. 그리고 그 출발선 맨 앞에 우리가 서 있습니다.

이 시장엔 아직 정답이 없습니다. 그 답을 함께 만들어갈 브랜드 커뮤니케이션 매니저를 찾습니다.

Responsibilities

[우리는 이런 일을 해요]
1. 뉴미디어 채널 전략 수립 및 운영
• 링크드인, 유튜브, 인스타그램, 블로그, 스레드 등 뉴미디어 채널의 운영 전략 수립 및 채널별 성장 목표 설계
• 회사·서비스·구성원의 이야기를 발굴하고, 채널 특성에 맞는 콘텐츠로 재가공하여 확산
• 채널별 성과 데이터 분석 및 콘텐츠 방향성 개선, 신규 채널 확장 검토

2. 브랜드 콘텐츠 기획 및 제작
• 브랜드 방향성에 부합하는 콘텐츠 기획부터 제작까지 직접 실행
• AI 툴을 활용한 콘텐츠 제작 효율화 및 다양한 포맷(숏폼, 카드뉴스, 아티클 등)의 실험적 시도
• 영상 제작사, 콘텐츠 프리랜서 등 외부 파트너 발굴 및 협업 관리

3. 언론홍보 및 대외 커뮤니케이션 협업
• 언론홍보 담당자와 협업하여 언론홍보와 뉴미디어 채널 간 메시지 일관성 관리
• 보도자료·기획자료 등 미디어 콘텐츠 작성 지원
• 경영진 메시지, 발표 자료 등 대외 커뮤니케이션 콘텐츠 기획 지원

4. 이슈 모니터링 및 커뮤니케이션 지원
• 회사·산업 관련 온라인 여론 및 뉴미디어 트렌드 상시 모니터링
• 대내외 이슈 발생 시 채널별 대응 커뮤니케이션 실행 지원
• IR, 마케팅, 사업부서 등 유관 부서와 협업하여 커뮤니케이션 니즈 대응

Requirements

[우리는 이런 분과 같이 일하고 싶어요]
• 뉴미디어 채널 운영, 콘텐츠 마케팅, 브랜드 커뮤니케이션 등 관련 업무 경력 3년 이상
• 뉴미디어 채널의 문법을 이해하고, 콘텐츠 기획부터 제작까지 직접 실행할 수 있는 분
• 채널을 직접 성장시켜 본 경험이 있고, 그 과정을 데이터로 설명할 수 있는 분
• 실험적 시도를 두려워하지 않고, 결과를 통해 학습하며 빠르게 방향을 조정할 수 있는 분
• 내부 유관 부서 및 외부 파트너사와 적극적이고 명확하게 커뮤니케이션할 수 있는 분

Preferred

[우리는 이런 분이면 더 좋아요]
• 언론홍보(PR) 실무 경험 또는 보도자료·기획자료 작성 경험
• 여행·관광, 핀테크, 결제, 커머스 등 유관 산업에서의 커뮤니케이션 경험
• 상장사 또는 IPO를 경험한 조직에서 커뮤니케이션 업무를 수행해 본 경험
• 커뮤니케이션 전략 수립부터 실행까지 전 과정을 주도하거나 팀을 리딩해 본 경험
• AI 툴을 활용한 콘텐츠 제작 또는 업무 효율화 경험
• 빠르게 성장하는 조직에서 브랜드 채널을 처음부터 만들어 보고 싶은 분

Benefits

[성과와 노력에 대한 보상을 아끼지 않아요]
• 최고의 동료들과 함께 성장: 구성원들이 네이버, 라인 카카오, SKT, IBM 등 탑 IT기업 출신이에요.
• 수평적 문화: 직급이 없는 역할조직, 호칭은 모두 "님"으로 통일돼요.
• 식대 / 복지카드 지원: 매월 20만원의 복지카드를 통해 점심 식사를 지원해요. 야근시, 저녁 식사비용 지원을 지원해요.
• 리프레시 휴가 & 해외여행 지원금: 2년 근속시 2주간 리프레시 휴가와 해외여행 지원금 100만원을 제공해요.
• 성과급: 사업 및 개인별 퍼포먼스에 따라 합리적인 보상을 제공해요.

title: Commercial Pricing Analyst
description:
As a Commercial Pricing Analyst at TMS Global, part of DS Smith, you'll play a key role in supporting profitable growth across a diverse international customer portfolio. Working with stakeholders across EMEA, APAC, LATAM and North America, you'll transform complex commercial data into actionable insights, influence pricing strategy and support critical decision-making that drives business performance and long-term customer value.

Working closely with Sales, Procurement and Commercial Finance teams, you'll develop benchmarking models and provide commercial analysis to support contract renewals, RFP activity, raw material indexation and strategic pricing decisions across our global business

Key Responsibilities:

Commercial Strategy & Planning

  • Analyse customer and supplier pricing data to provide actionable insights and support informed commercial decision making.
  • Ensure pricing decisions align with margin objectives, customer agreements and overall commercial strategy.
  • Monitor raw material indices and market trends, providing insight and recommendations on potential pricing impacts.
  • Identify opportunities to improve pricing performance, operational efficiency and commercial effectiveness.

Process & Systems Optimization

  • Drive automation initiatives and process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy and scalability across commercial operations.
  • Manage the implementation of contract events within internal systems, including contract anniversaries and raw material index (RMI) adjustments.
  • Develop, enhance and maintain pricing models, ensuring effective deployment and adoption across the business.

Internal Support & Governance

  • Partner with implementation and account teams on contract execution, onboarding and pricing-related issue resolution.
  • Provide data management, pricing administration and commercial policy support to sales and finance teams.
  • Equip Operations and Shared Service teams with tools and guidance to ensure accurate product pricing.
  • Ensure adherence to internal controls and commercial governance processes, reporting any identified risks to senior management.

About You

This role would suit someone who thrives in a fast-paced, matrix environment and enjoys collaborating across teams and geographies. You’ll bring strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

The ideal candidate will have experience in the following areas:

  • A background in the Packaging industry, with Print experience is essential.
  • Proven experience within pricing and commercial analytics
  • Strong experience developing and maintaining pricing models and analytical tools.
  • Strong understanding of commercial pricing methodologies, supply chain dynamics and operational delivery.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering across commercial, finance and operational teams.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including modelling and data analysis.
  • Experience using Power BI or similar visualisation tools would be advantageous.

If this role sounds like an exciting opportunity and you believe you have the skills and experience to succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

“To achieve our aim of being among the most successful, sustainable and responsible companies in the world, we aim to build a diverse, motivated, and engaged workforce. Our goal is to create a culture of inclusion where everyone is treated fairly, differences are valued, and everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed.

Our people come from diverse backgrounds, bring different perspectives, ideas and experiences to generate unique solutions focused on present and future sustainability challenges. We welcome all candidates to apply, even those not meeting all criteria.”

title: Market Risk Developer - Market Data
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a Market Data Developer to design and implement solutions for sourcing, storing, and delivering end-of-day (EOD) market data used in pricing and risk calculations. This role requires strong technical skills in Python, SQL, Snowflake, AWS, and deep domain knowledge of market data across multiple asset classes. The candidate will work closely with the Risk Orchestration team to provide accurate and timely market data inputs for pricing engines and risk models.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Data Sourcing & Integration
    • Source EOD market data by region from various front-office marking systems and external providers.
    • Validate and normalize data across asset classes for pricing and risk consumption.
  • Data Modeling & Storage
    • Design and implement data models in Snowflake to persist: End-of-day prices, Volatility surfaces, Credit spread curves, Discount curves and other risk-related market data
  • Infrastructure Development
    • Provide solutions to pricing engines to deliver market data by region with high reliability and performance.
    • Build scalable, cost-efficient Snowflake infrastructure and optimize queries for performance.
    • Implement data quality checks and ensure auditability.
    • Integrate with AWS SQS messaging for data readiness events.
  • Collaboration
    • Work closely with Market Data and Risk teams to define canonical market observables and maintain data lineage.
    • Work closely with Risk Orchestration team to ensure all market data inputs meet requirements for pricing and risk analytics.

Essential Experience/ Skills:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in developing applications using Relational Databases and Big-data platforms.
  • Technical
    • Strong Python (pandas, numpy, data engineering best practices).
    • Advanced SQL and Snowflake (schema design, warehouse management, streams/tasks, query optimization).
    • ETL/ELT pipeline development
  • Domain Knowledge
    • Market data concepts across multiple asset classes (Rates, FX, Credit, Equities, Commodities).
    • Understanding of EOD pricing and risk inputs for VaR, sensitivities, and stress testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or similar technical discipline

Personal Attributes:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex data related issues
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Self-starter and entrepreneurial in approach
  • Ability to escalate and follow-up proactively
  • Good time management skills

title: Butikskonsulent i Arvika!
description:
Vi är ett rikstäckande företag som hjälper butiker och leverantörer inom dagligvaruhandeln
med säljdrivande tjänster! Vi har cirka 300 duktiga medarbetare ute i butik varje vecka. Vi
hjälper våra kunder med alla typer av butiksarbete - men vi har också, som vårt namn
antyder, en bransch-unik kompetens inom just dryckeskategorin.

Som familjeföretag är det otroligt viktigt för oss att skapa en arbetsmiljö där trivsel och
gemenskap är i fokus. Hos oss är det högt i tak, och vi uppmuntrar att alla ska kunna vara
sig själva och bidra med sina idéer. Vi tror på att ett gott arbetsklimat ger de bästa resultaten,
så vi jobbar för att skapa en avslappnad och rolig miljö där alla känner sig välkomna och
respekterade.

Här får du både möjlighet att utvecklas och ha kul – vi växer tillsammans! 

- Vi har tyvärr inte möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via mejl.
- Dryckeskonsult har noggrant valt sina rekryteringskanaler och undanber sig vänligt men bestämt kontakt från rekryteringssajter eller liknande.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som att jobba i butik - fast lite roligare!

I ditt arbete hos oss kommer du att ta dig an vanligt förekommande butiksarbete i dagligvaruhandeln, med fokus på brödplock, varuplock och dryckesplock. 

Det som gör den här tjänsten lite roligare, är variationen. Utöver ovanstående arbetsuppgifter kan även inventering, varudemonstration eller lösviktsplock förekomma, och dessutom besöker du oftast flera butiker per dag.

Vi tror att du som kommer att trivas bäst hos oss har butikserfarenhet, en förmåga att självständigt ta dig an arbetsuppgifter, en social personlighet och en framåtanda.

Dryckeskonsult erbjuder ett varierande jobb på en härlig arbetsplats med möjligheter att utvecklas och växa för den som vill.

Vi har kollektivavtal med Handels.

Tjänsten är en timanställning utefter behov, på ca 15h per vecka, med start i augusti. Arbetstiden är dagtid vardagar samt varannan lördag. Arbetsplats Arvika med omnejd. 

Butikserfarenhet, B-körkort och tillgång till egen bil är ett skallkrav. 

Det ska bli så kul att höra från dig!

KVALIFIKATIONER
Butikserfarenhet

B-körkort

Tillgång till egen bil

title: Mechatronics Engineer Sustainable Infrastructure - Tires

  • przygotowywanie business case’ów, analiz finansowych i rekomendacji wspierających decyzje biznesowe oraz inwestycyjne,
  • współpraca przy planowaniu architektury sieci oraz łączeniu perspektywy produktowej, technologicznej i rynkowej,
  • rozwijanie produktów we współpracy z zespołami technicznymi, sprzedażowymi, finansowymi, marketingowymi, prawnymi, customer experience oraz partnerami zewnętrznymi,
  • koordynowanie działań go-to-market i dbanie o to, aby produkt był dobrze przygotowany do sprzedaży, wdrożenia i obsługi klienta,
  • monitorowanie wyników produktów oraz optymalizacja marży, EBITDA i efektywności na różnych etapach cyklu życia produktu,
  • zarządzanie wiedzą produktową, dokumentacją wymagań oraz informacjami potrzebnymi zespołom pracującym z klientami,
  • identyfikowanie obszarów do usprawnień i proponowanie działań, które realnie wspierają rozwój produktu oraz doświadczenie klientów B2B.

Z jakimi technologiami i usługami możesz pracować?

W tej roli ważna będzie dobra znajomość rozwiązań z obszaru connectivity, w szczególności takich jak SD-WAN, SD-LAN, MPLS, Internet Access, FWA, Wi-Fi oraz Campus Network 5G.

To obszar, w którym produkt nie istnieje w oderwaniu od technologii. Dlatego szukamy osoby, która rozumie zależności między ofertą, infrastrukturą, modelem biznesowym, klientem i możliwościami technicznymi.

Dlaczego warto do nas dołączyć?

  • Bo to nie jest rola, w której wchodzisz tylko w utrzymanie istniejącego produktu. To moment, w którym obszar B2B connectivity jest rozwijany i porządkowany na nowo - technologicznie, procesowo i biznesowo.
  • Będziesz mieć wpływ na decyzje produktowe, kierunek rozwoju portfolio, sposób współpracy z technologią i biznesem oraz na to, jak będziemy odpowiadać na potrzeby klientów B2B. To dobra przestrzeń dla osoby, która lubi budować, porządkować i brać odpowiedzialność za coś więcej niż pojedynczy projekt.

Jeśli dobrze czujesz się na styku technologii, rynku, sprzedaży i strategii produktowej - porozmawiajmy.

Szukamy Ciebie, jeśli:

  • masz minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w roli Product Managera/Product Managerki, najlepiej przy produktach technologicznych, telekomunikacyjnych lub connectivity,
  • dobrze znasz branżę telekomunikacyjną i rozumiesz, jak działają produkty oraz usługi sieciowe dla klientów biznesowych,
  • masz praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z business case’ami, analizami finansowymi, roadmapami produktowymi, strategiami cenowymi i oceną potencjału rynkowego,
  • współpracowałeś/aś z operatorami, dostawcami technologii, partnerami infrastrukturalnymi lub innymi podmiotami z rynku telco,
  • rozumiesz modele biznesowe w obszarze wireless, cykl życia urządzeń, wskaźniki efektywności abonentów, trendy konkurencyjne oraz środowisko operatorów sieci komórkowych / MNO,
  • prowadziłeś/aś inicjatywy produktowe wymagające współpracy z wieloma zespołami, np. Engineering, Network Operations, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Experience oraz partnerami zewnętrznymi,
  • potrafisz analizować problemy techniczne i biznesowe, a następnie przekładać je na konkretne rekomendacje, decyzje i działania,
  • jesteś samodzielny/a, odpowiedzialny/a i dobrze odnajdujesz się w tematach, w których trzeba nie tylko „prowadzić produkt”, ale też poukładać sposób pracy, zależności i priorytety.

Ważne: w tej roli kluczowe jest doświadczenie blisko technologii i rynku telco/connectivity. Jeśli Twoje doświadczenie produktowe dotyczy głównie marketingu, bankowości, aplikacji digitalowych lub produktów niezwiązanych z infrastrukturą/telekomunikacją, ta rola może nie być najlepiej dopasowana.

title: Asystent / Asystentka ds. sprzedaży
description:
Nasza sprzedaż pędzi do przodu, dlatego szukamy energii i zaangażowania – ambitnej osoby studiującej, która wejdzie do naszego teamu handlowego, odciąży naszą Team Leaderkę, przejdzie u nas prawdziwą szkołę biznesu i z czasem wyrośnie na samodzielnego asa międzynarodowej sprzedaży.

Dlaczego warto do nas dołączyć właśnie teraz?

  • Rośniemy jak szaleni: Od trzech lat co roku podwajamy nasze obroty (x2 rok do roku!). My nie stoimy w miejscu – my lecimy!
  • Szkoła biznesu w praktyce: Nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę bez koła ratunkowego. Będziesz pracować ramię w ramię z naszą Team Leaderką sprzedaży, ucząc się od podstaw, jak wygląda nowoczesny, międzynarodowy proces B2B.
  • Wychowamy własnego managera: Szukamy kogoś na dłużej. Chcemy Cię wyszkolić i dać Ci narzędzia, byś po studiach (lub w ich trakcie) stał/a się w pełni samodzielnym Account Managerem z własnym portfolio dużych, zagranicznych klientów.
  • Pełna elastyczność: Wiemy, czym są kolokwia i sesja. U nas bez problemu połączysz naukę z pracą – działamy zdalnie i dopasowujemy grafik do Twojego planu zajęć.

🔎 Kogo szukamy?

Szukamy osoby na starcie swojej drogi w biznesie, która ma w sobie naturalną ciekawość, "głód" wiedzy i chce szybko chłonąć praktyczne umiejętności. Nie musisz mieć wieloletniego doświadczenia – najważniejsza jest dla nas Twoja postawa, zaangażowanie i to, czy złapiemy wspólny vibe.


Będzie nam po drodze, jeśli:

  • Posiadasz status studenta i szukasz miejsca, w którym realnie rozwiniesz skrzydła (a nie tylko „odbębnisz” staż).
  • Swobodnie rozmawiasz i piszesz po angielsku oraz polsku (must-have) – działamy międzynarodowo, więc codzienny kontakt z zagranicznymi klientami to u nas standard.
  • Jesteś osobą świetnie zorganizowaną i skrupulatną – potrafisz samodzielnie zarządzać swoim czasem w pracy zdalnej, nie gubisz wątków i dbasz o porządek w dokumentach oraz systemach.
  • Chcesz się uczyć sprzedaży i obsługi klienta B2B – pierwsze doświadczenia w kontakcie z ludźmi (np. obsługa klienta, gastronomia, call center, wolontariaty) będą super atutem, ale najważniejsza jest chęć do nauki.
  • Stawiasz na szczerość i otwartą komunikację – pracujemy zdalnie, więc jasny przepływ informacji to dla nas podstawa. U nas mówi się wprost, co działa, a co nie.

title: Reconciliation Specialist
description:
Job Summary

The Reconciliation Specialist (L5) is responsible for the daily cash and transactions reconciliations between internal books and the custodian, providing treasury with opening balance adjustments, and completing daily holdings reconciliations between the internal and external records. They also provide daily reporting of discrepancies to securities accounting and treasury.

Position Responsibilities

The Reconciliation Specialist will be responsible for efficient reconciliation and review of Manulife Investment Management portfolios and provision of investigative support to related business units and Portfolio Managers. This includes timely and accurate comparison of security position, cash balance and cash transaction with custodians. Establish and maintain cordial relationships with various stakeholders including internal and external parties.

The Reconciliation Specialist is also responsible for the administration of the assigned investment portfolio activity including:

Reconciliation of securities holdings, cash balances and cash transactions across all portfolios. Perform initial investigation and coordinate resolution with the different operations team and external parties. Serve as a backup reviewer of reconciliation exceptions of the cash balance, cash transactions and holdings for all portfolios. Continuously work with other departments within Investment Division to ensure all outstanding items are resolved in a timely manner. Maintain daily and monthly reconciliations filing with proper back up documentation. Sign off all daily reconciliations to meet deadlines stipulated in Service Level Agreement Work within existing procedures and processes ensuring clear and concise documentation is created and maintained as such procedures and processes evolve over time Assist in providing training to junior colleagues and new joiners. Prepare MIs, lead and participate on business governance calls. Recommend and initiate process improvements and improved controls / service. Aid in the successful delivery of compliance, audit, and regulatory facilitated requirements. Participate in projects such as system transitions (UAT), process transformations etc. Remain updated with relevant industry development and market-specific best practices. Remain familiar with relevant securities industry developments specifically those impacting the activities of assigned portfolios and/or internal clients and custodial service provider Exercise initiative to assist department management in review and analysis of established procedures and processes, making recommendations to ensure that efficient and flexible service is provided to clients at all times Provide assistance to other team members and management team when required. Adhere to and reinforce established SOX documentation. Participate in inter-department cross training to ensure continuity of service. Additional duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree related to Investment and Finance, Accounting, and similar fields with minimum 3 years work experience in reconciliation in a banking or securities administration environment
  • Knowledge of securities instruments, foreign exchange and other alternative investment.
  • Investments accounting knowledge is an advantage
  • CISI designation or any equivalent is a plus.
  • Computer literate with proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
  • Knowledge of back-office accounting systems such as SimCorp Dimension, Bloomberg, DUCO, Aladdin and custodian reporting systems is an advantage.
  • Experience with PowerBI, PowerApps, automation tools (VBA, robotics), or machine learning is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Keen attention to details and with a strong analytical ability
  • Capability to resolve complex problems and takes perspective on existing solutions.
  • Critical thinking and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • High level of accuracy and attention to details.
  • Ability to react quickly and meet tight deadlines maintaining accuracy and thoroughness
  • Excellent English skills, both oral and written, with strong comprehension skills to effectively communicate with internal and external parties
  • Demonstrate initiative and team player
  • Ability to adapt to changes, and set priorities

When you join our team:

• We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.

• We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.

• As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.
