title: Group Product Manager
description:
YOUR CHALLENGE

At Blacklane, we're redefining what premium mobility looks like and making it sustainable in the process. As we scale globally, the systems that power our chauffeur network are becoming as important as the experience we deliver to guests. That's where you come in.

We are looking for a Group Product Manager to lead our Chauffeur Domain: the engine behind how chauffeurs join our platform, how supply is managed, how rides are priced and dispatched, and how our marketplace operates at scale. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role at the intersection of operations, data, and product and it's one of the most complex and consequential domains in the company.

What you will own

You will lead a domain of five teams and five Product Managers, each with their own roadmap and KPIs. Your job is to set the direction, sharpen the strategy, and focus on improving the business.

  • Define and drive the product vision and priorities for the Chauffeur Domain, ensuring every team is working on the highest-impact problems
  • Manage, mentor, and grow five Product Managers across different seniority levels
  • Partner closely with engineering, data science, and operations to solve genuinely hard technical problems
  • Balance chauffeur and partner needs against guest experience requirements, making smart trade-offs at pace
  • Stay close to market dynamics and partner behaviour to keep the strategy sharp and the roadmap grounded
  • Serve as the domain's senior voice across the business with leadership, with partners, and with the teams building alongside you

ABOUT YOU

  • 5+ years in product management, with at least 4 years managing Product Managers
  • A track record of owning complex product domains end-to-end and shipping data-driven improvements that moved the needle
  • Strong analytical instincts, you're comfortable in the data and know how to use it to make decisions and influence others
  • Excellent communication skills, whether you are aligning a cross-functional team or presenting strategy to the executive team
  • Experience working in fast-paced, technically complex environments where the problems don't come with obvious answers
  • Bonus: background in ride-hailing, logistics, marketplace, or operations products

Why this role

The Chauffeur Domain is where supply meets demand, where technology meets operations, and where getting it right has a direct impact on Blacklane's ability to grow. This is a perfect role if you want to lead a high-performing team, tackle problems with real complexity, and help shape the future of sustainable mobility.

About Blacklane

Our mission is simple but powerful: to become the world’s leading premium, global chauffeur service. Operating in 50+ countries, we reimagine chauffeur-driven rides by prioritizing reliability, innovation, and first-class service at every step. Blacklane is also at the forefront of sustainable mobility efforts, continuously working to reduce our operational impact on the planet.

Our Company Culture & Values

Blacklane has grown from a two-person startup in Berlin to a global team of over 300 people representing 54+ nationalities. Our culture is powered by our commitment to three core values: Care, Drive and Excellence.

  • Care - We are invested in each other's well-being and professional growth.

  • Drive - We act with pace and determination. We are ambitious, committed to a growth mindset, and champion ownership and delivery.

  • Excellence - We understand our customers so we can exceed expectations.

We support our people through initiatives like Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), mentorship programs that bring our values to life.

We welcome—and actively support—employees to create or join the communities that are important to them.

✨ Why join Blacklane?

At Blacklane, our Compensation and Benefits strategies are designed to be fair and market-aligned. We combine base salary with variable elements and long-term incentives as part of our overall rewards framework.

In addition, we offer a benefits package tailored to each location, supporting health, wellbeing, time off, learning, and local needs. Some of the benefits for this role and country include:

Local perks – UK (London)
💙 100% employer-paid health insurance for you and your dependents, with 24hr GP access
🌴 28 vacation days per year, increasing with tenure
🏦 Company pension with up to 5% employer contribution

🎓 Continuous learning & certified coaching

🚀 Fair pay and benefits tailored to local markets
🏆 Long-term incentive scheme
🚘Mystery Rides: Quarterly Voucher to enjoy personal trips around the world with Blacklane and experience our service from a guest’s perspective.

title: Statistical Scientist Director
description:
Premier Research is looking for a Statistical Scientist Director to join our Biostatistics team.

You will help biotech, medtech, and specialty pharma companies transform life-changing ideas and breakthrough science into new medicines, devices, and diagnostics. What we do is profoundly connected to saving and improving lives, and we recognize our team members are the most valuable asset in delivering success.

  • We are here to help you grow, to give you the skills and opportunities to excel at work with the flexibility and balance your life requires.

  • Your ideas influence the way we work, and your voice matters here.

  • As an essential part of our team, you help us deliver the medical innovation that patients are desperate for.

Join us and build your future here.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Serve as lead statistician on complex, key client studies, acting as point-of-contact, ensuring cohesive communication with sponsors and internal teams, and leading project-level statistical strategy from protocol/SAP planning through reporting, ensuring alignment of design, analyses, and data interpretation.

  • Communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly to non-statistical stakeholders—including sponsor leadership, regulatory representatives, and clinical teams.

  • Develops sample size estimation, modeling approaches, adaptive or Bayesian frameworks, and innovative trial designs.

  • Develops or provides senior oversight for statistical deliverables, including: statistical selection of protocols, statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), randomization specifications and Statistical contributions to CSRs, publications, and regulatory documents

  • Identify risks related to study design, sample size, or analysis approaches and proactively propose mitigation strategies.

  • Acts as project manager for biostatistics stand-alone work and drive high-quality statistical deliverables while managing budget, scope, and timeline expectations.

  • Advise clients on regulatory guidelines, statistical principles for submissions, and global expectations (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.).

  • Support business development through participation in bid defenses, capabilities presentations, RFP strategy and build trusted scientific relationships with sponsors and influence decision-making through evidence-based recommendations.

  • Acts as an independent biostatistician on DSMBs and DMCs

What We Are Searching For

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) from accredited college or university, in statistics or closely related field. Equivalent combination of education, training and experience will be considered.

  • 15+ years’ experience in clinical trials design and analysis, preferably in a CRO environment

  • At least 1 yr technical experience in clinical trials design and analysis implementing innovative statistical analysis.

  • Previous experience implementing innovative statistical designs

  • Strong knowledge of regulatory, scientific, technical and clinical expertise in conduct of clinical trials in the respective area of focus as demonstrated by past positions related to the therapeutic area in the CRO and Pharma/Biotech sector

  • Strong computer skills, with knowledge of advanced programming skills with standard software, including SAS, R

  • Excellent working knowledge of CDISC standards and application of these standards to projects.

title: Weekend begeleider forensische kliniek
description:
Ben jij flexibel inzetbaar, waarbij je graag voornamelijk in de weekenden werkt? Weet jij om te gaan met een complexe doelgroep en vind je het leuk om met onze patiënten te werken? Lees dan verder!

Dit ga jij doen

Als parttime weekendbegeleider ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor het creëren en bevorderen van een veilig en gestructureerd behandel- en leefklimaat. Je begeleidt patiënten in hun dagelijkse leefsituatie en helpt hen om grip op hun leven te krijgen met minimale dwang. Je observeert patiënten doelgericht, signaleert veranderingen en zorgt voor de orde en veiligheid binnen de afdelingen. Bij patiënten in crisis pas je de-escalerende technieken toe.

Je werkt onder supervisie van de verpleegkundige en begeleiders van de afdeling. Je geeft vorm aan dagactiviteiten, draagt bij aan de uitvoering van het behandelplan en creëert een open leefklimaat. Je bent actief op verschillende units binnen de FPA den Haag. Als je een doorzetter bent en voornamelijk beschikbaar in de weekenden, dan kijken we uit naar je sollicitatie!

Hier kom jij te werken

In deze dynamische parttime rol, waarbij je voornamelijk in de weekenden werkt, kom jij te werken bij de Forensisch Psychiatrische Afdeling in Den Haag. Hier behandelen we mensen met gedragsproblemen die voortkomen uit psychiatrische problematiek. Een deel van onze patiënten is hierdoor in aanraking gekomen met politie en justitie.

De kliniek bestaat uit vijf units voor opname, behandeling en resocialisatie. Daarnaast heeft FPA Den Haag een Forensische High Intensive Care (FHIC), waar cliënten tijdelijk worden opgenomen wanneer zij in crisis zitten of zijn vastgelopen op een andere behandelplek. Samen met je collega’s draag je bij aan een veilig behandel- en leefklimaat en werk je eraan dat patiënten zo veilig en succesvol mogelijk kunnen terugkeren in de maatschappij, eventueel via de reguliere psychiatrie.

Dat vraagt van jou betrokkenheid, duidelijkheid en het vermogen om professioneel te handelen in complexe situaties.

Dit ben jij

Een afgeronde opleiding in de zorg is voor deze functie noodzakelijk. Er zijn mogelijkheden op mbo-4 niveau en hbo-niveau. Afhankelijk van je opleidingsniveau en ervaring wordt de functie anders ingericht zodat deze past bij jou als persoon, je ervaring en je ambitie. Opleidingsrichtingen die goed passen bij deze functie zijn onder andere:
• social work (uitstroomprofiel Zorg of GGZ Agoog),
• maatschappelijk werk,
• verpleegkunde,
• begeleider specifieke doelgroepen,
• toegepaste psychologie.

Dit krijg jij van ons

Wij bieden jou een contract volgens cao GGZ voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling. Deze functie is ingedeeld in functiegroep 40/45 met een maximaal salaris van €3.917,-/€4.273,- bruto per maand o.b.v. 36-urige werkweek. Het uiteindelijke salaris is afhankelijk van jouw opleiding en werkervaring.

Let op, wij ontvangen graag een cv inclusief motivatiebrief.

title: Senior AI Quality Analyst
description:
Your role

Information Technology - IT Systems & Software Development - P3 - IND

What you'll be doing

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, business analysts, data engineers, and development teams to understand reporting, AI, and data quality requirements, translating them into comprehensive test strategies and validation plans.
  • Design, develop, and execute detailed test cases to validate Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models, AI-powered applications, APIs, and data integration processes.
  • Verify the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and visual presentation of reports, dashboards, KPIs, calculations, filters, drill-through functionality, and business metrics.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, compliance, business usability, and identify risks such as bias, hallucinations, and data quality issues.
  • Reconcile reports and AI outputs against source systems, data warehouses, APIs, and business-defined metrics to ensure data integrity and reliability.
  • Develop benchmark datasets, business validation scenarios, acceptance criteria, and testing frameworks for AI, analytics, and reporting solutions.
  • Perform regression testing to ensure enhancements, data pipeline changes, report modifications, and AI model updates do not negatively impact existing functionality.
  • Define and implement data quality rules, validation controls, monitoring processes, and governance standards to improve overall data reliability.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by coordinating business validation, documenting findings, and ensuring successful solution adoption.
  • Assist in preparing, organizing, and maintaining business knowledge assets, metadata, documentation, and business glossaries that support AI and reporting initiatives.
  • Monitor reporting quality, AI performance, and data quality metrics, recommending continuous improvements to business processes, data pipelines, governance practices, and development lifecycle to prevent issues at the source.
  • Document test plans, test cases, validation results, defects, and quality assurance activities to maintain complete audit and compliance records.
  • Participate in AI governance, compliance, audit, and continuous improvement initiatives while promoting best practices for AI adoption, reporting standards, and data quality.
  • Communicate testing progress, quality status, risks, and defects effectively with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
  • Continuously learn emerging technologies, share best practices, and contribute to the enhancement of testing methodologies, AI quality assurance, and reporting excellence.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data analytics, information technology, engineering or related field
  • Master’s degree preferred.
  • 6+ years’ experience in reporting, data analytics and QA function
  • Familiarity with reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Proficiency in SQL or relevant query languages for data validation and analysis within reporting environments.
  • Understanding of AI, machine learning, generative AI, and enterprise AI use cases.
  • Strong analytical skills to identify, report, and troubleshoot issues related to reporting accuracy and visual presentation.
  • Meticulous attention to detail to ensure accurate validation of reporting elements, including data, charts, and graphs.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey testing information and collaborate with reporting teams and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to adapt to changing reporting requirements, priorities, and project timelines.

  • Tar initiativ och driver arbete självständigt hela vägen i mål

Malmköpings Mekaniska Werkstad AB grundades 2010 då nuvarande ägare tog över Elmo, ett bolag med anor från 1946. title: Staff Software Engineer - Experimentation
description:
Staff Software Engineer – Experimentation team

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to play a pivotal role in evolving M&S’s Experimentation platform. This team provides the experimentation capabilities that empower teams across the business to identify savings and drive revenue. Your customers are product teams, engineers, content teams – everyone who works on customer-facing functionality – and your mission is to enable them to run more experiments, more easily and confidently, by creating a robust experimentation platform.

This is a role for an engineer who is excited by platform thinking, enablement at scale, and revolutionising how experimentation capabilities are modelled, delivered, and accessed across a large organisation.

Due to high interest, this role may close earlier than advertised. We recommend applying as soon as possible.

What you’ll do

Your key accountabilities will include:

  • Design, build, and evolve backend‑heavy platform capabilities for experimentation, including APIs, services, automation pipelines, and developer tooling.
  • Set technical direction for the Experimentation platform, influencing architecture and standards beyond your team.
  • Champion a self‑service platform model, building tools, scripts, and automation (including emerging agentic AI use cases) that reduce toil and dependencies.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and content teams to understand needs, pain points, and future demand.
  • Mentor engineers at all levels, helping develop strong technical judgement, platform thinking, and engineering craft.
  • Demonstrate a production‑first mindset: observability, resilience, and safe change are core design concerns.
  • Produce clear, high‑quality documentation for APIs, systems, standards, and operational processes.

Who You Are

  • A strong platform mindset: you build capabilities and tools that power many teams, not just individual features.
  • Deep backend engineering experience with Java/Kotlin, including designing and running distributed systems in production.
  • Strong experience on the Azure cloud platform, building and operating scalable, reliable services.
  • Solid understanding of experimentation solutions (Optimizely experience is a strong plus).
  • Hands‑on experience with GraphQL — schema design, federation, evolution, and API governance (must have).

What’s in it for you?

Working at M&S means being part of something bigger - helping to deliver quality, value and service to millions of customers every day. We’re inclusive, fast-moving and always evolving, with a strong sense of purpose and a focus on doing the right thing.

Everyone’s Welcome

Marks & Spencer strives to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers, and suppliers.

title: Lead Commercial Foreman
description:
Minimum 5 Years of Commercial Electrical Experience

Reli Electric is looking for an experienced Lead Commercial Electrician who is capable of running commercial electrical projects from start to finish.

This position is for someone who can take ownership of a project, understand the complete electrical scope, coordinate the daily work, and lead apprentices and other electricians in the field. The right candidate must also be willing to work hands-on alongside the crew when needed.

Types of Projects:
Our commercial work commonly includes:
  • Commercial tenant improvement projects.
  • White-box and shell build-outs.
  • Ground-up commercial buildings.
  • Ground-up restaurants and commercial kitchens.
  • Office build-outs and remodels.
  • Retail stores and shopping center remodels.
  • Projects at Easton Town Center and other occupied commercial locations.
  • Electrical service, panel, lighting, and equipment installations.
  • Fire alarm installations and modifications as required.
  • Commercial remodels and renovation projects.

Position Responsibilities:
The Lead Commercial Electrician will be responsible for:
  • Running commercial electrical projects from layout through completion.
  • Reading and understanding electrical plans, specifications, and project scope.
  • Planning daily work and assigning responsibilities to the crew.
  • Leading, training, and working alongside apprentices.
  • Coordinating with the general contractor, project manager, superintendent, and other trades.
  • Keeping projects organized and moving according to schedule.
  • Identifying material, equipment, and manpower needs ahead of time.
  • Installing conduit, wiring, panels, lighting, devices, fire alarm equipment, and commercial kitchen equipment connections.
  • Completing accurate job documentation and communicating project updates.
  • Ensuring installations meet NEC requirements, project specifications, and Reli Electric’s quality standards.
  • Maintaining a safe, professional, and organized jobsite.
  • Reviewing completed work and correcting issues before inspections or project turnover.

Required Experience:
Applicants must have:
  • At least 5 years of commercial electrical experience.
  • Previous experience leading commercial projects and managing a crew.
  • Experience with tenant improvements, restaurants, retail stores, offices, or similar commercial projects.
  • The ability to read and work from electrical blueprints.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial electrical systems and the National Electrical Code.
  • Experience bending and installing EMT conduit.
  • Experience with electrical services, panels, feeders, branch circuits, lighting, controls, and equipment connections.
  • The ability to communicate professionally with customers, general contractors, inspectors, and other trades.
  • A valid driver’s license and dependable transportation.
  • The ability to work independently and make responsible field decisions.
  • Experience with fire alarm installations, commercial kitchens, ground-up construction, and occupied remodel projects is strongly preferred.

Benefits:
Reli Electric offers:
  • Paid vacation and holidays.
  • Paid sick leave.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Health, dental, vision, and life insurance.
  • Overtime opportunities.
  • Bonus opportunities.
  • Paid certifications and specialized training.
  • Opportunities for advancement as the company continues to grow.

Why Join Reli Electric?
Reli Electric is a growing electrical contractor serving the Central Ohio area. We perform a wide variety of commercial projects, which gives our electricians the opportunity to work on more than the same type of installation every day.
We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, communicates well, can lead a crew, and wants to play an important role in the continued growth of our commercial division.

Job Type: Full-time
Pay: based on experience and ability

Compensation:
  • Competitive hourly pay.
  • Overtime and double-time opportunities when applicable.
  • Bonus opportunities.

Schedule:
Monday through Friday.
Primarily day shift.
Typical 8-hour shifts.
Occasional overtime may be available or required depending on project schedules.
Work Location: Commercial jobsites throughout Central Ohio

Reli Electric is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

title: Product Designer
description:
Product Designer - Indigo Platform

LevelBlue/Cybereason · Tokyo, Japan

The Challenge

We are building Indigo: a next-generation security operations platform unifying EDR, XDR, SIEM, MDR, and SOAR. Our users are cybersecurity analysts working under high pressure to stop active threats. We process massive volumes of real-time data, and we need a designer to turn that back-end complexity into a clean, intuitive interface.

We are an English-speaking company based in Tokyo. In this role, you will own core platform experiences end-to-end.

What You'll Do

  • Design Complex Workflows: Lead the UX, information architecture (IA), and visual layout for high-stakes features like alert triage, incident timelines, and multi-tenant dashboards.
  • Visualize Big Data: Create intuitive data visualizations and interaction designs that help analysts understand complex attack paths at a glance.
  • AI First Design: Design interfaces with AI agents across the platform enabling both semi-automatic and fully automatic workflows built on top of the latest AI technology.
  • Collaborate End-to-End: Partner with Product and Engineering from early discovery through to final shipping, ensuring high design fidelity in the final code.
  • Validate Designs: Run usability sessions and reviews with internal analysts and customers to test your prototypes.
  • Scale the System: Maintain and evolve our component-driven Figma design system.

What You'll Bring

  • Enterprise Experience: 3 years designing data-dense B2B SaaS.
  • System Thinking: Ability to translate ambiguous, heavy technical requirements into logical user flows and clear mental models.
  • Figma Skills: High proficiency in Figma, including component architecture, auto-layout, and design system management.

title: Lab Engineer - Husqvarna Group
description:
You will join the Product Test Lab for Landscape Maintenance Equipment products within the R&D Handheld organization – a team of experienced and curious test engineers working close to the products and the development projects behind them.

As a team, we support several development projects in parallel, sharing test responsibility, knowledge, and problem-solving. The work is hands-on and varied, combining laboratory testing, field testing, and analysis. Collaboration and technical discussions are a natural part of everyday work, and you will have colleagues who are just as interested in how and why things work as you are.

About the role

In this role, you work with testing and verification of 2-stroke handheld products such as grass trimmers, brush cutters, leaf blowers and hedge trimmers.

The position is broad and gives you influence across large parts of the product development cycle. You are involved from planning and setting up tests to executing, analyzing, and following up results, making sure the products meet performance, functionality, and quality requirements before they reach the user.

Your work includes:

  • Mechanical, functional, and performance testing, as well as developing and improving test methods and measurement techniques
  • Verifying and documenting technical performance in different phases of product development
  • Close collaboration with design engineers, project teams, and other R&D functions – often acting as a coordinating link between different technical specialists
  • Designing fixtures and test rigs, and analyzing and reporting test results

Field testing is a natural part of the job and takes place both in Sweden and, when needed, internationally. If you enjoy seeing how products perform in real-life conditions – not just in the lab – this role offers exactly that.

Overall, the position offers high variation, a strong hands-on element, and good opportunities to grow within testing and verification of technical complex products.

Your profile

We are looking for someone with a technical interest and a broad technical understanding. You enjoy combining practical testing with analysis and documentation, and you feel comfortable collaborating with different functions in a development environment. You work in a structured way but can adapt quickly when priorities change. You have:

  • a technical education, for example within mechanical engineering, physics or similar – or have gained equivalent technical competence through professional experience
  • 2+ years experience from testing and verification, laboratory environments, or product development
  • Curiosity, technical interest, and a hands-on mindset
  • Fluent in both Swedish and English, spoken and written

Location

Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application

Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:

Hiring Manager: Marina Karlsson, marina.karlsson@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

  • Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
  • Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
  • Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

title: AI Solution Lead
description:
We are Kaizen Gaming

Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 20 markets. We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2.700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents.

Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Solution Lead to act as the strategic-technical bridge between our Optimization function and Engineering. This is a Principal Individual Contributor role — not hands-on engineering — focused on ensuring what gets built is the right thing, designed the right way, with the foundations to scale.

You'll help the Optimization function transition from rule-based automation to AI-native, agentic execution, reporting directly to the Head of Optimization while also providing technical mentorship to fellow Individual Contributors.

What You'll Do

Solution Architecture & Technical Design (70%)

  • Translate validated business requirements into scalable solution architectures — data flows, integration patterns, AI model selection, exception paths, and monitoring.
  • Justify design decisions against an Eliminate → Anticipate → Agent → Assist hierarchy.
  • Own the architecture sign-off gate before any solution enters the engineering backlog .

Technical Feasibility & Build-vs-Buy (10%)

  • Assess the technical feasibility, complexity, and platform fit for new initiatives, evaluating build vs. configure vs. buy options.
  • Identify opportunities for reuse across approximately 110 active solutions and maintain the Solution Catalogue.

AI Governance & Standards (10%)

  • Own technical standards: design patterns, AI tool governance tiers, AI registry entries, and quality frameworks for "production-ready" AI.
  • Develop reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and decision trees for the wider organisation.

Cross-Functional Enablement (10%)

  • Translate architecture into business language—and business requirements into technical architecture—while facilitating architecture reviews and design workshops.
  • Champion AI-native thinking by promoting principles such as Eliminate before Automate and Anticipate before Build, while mentoring colleagues and helping raise technical capability across the organisation.

What We're Looking For

  • BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related (MSc in Architecture/AI/Systems Design is considered a plus)
  • TOGAF or an equivalent enterprise architecture certification. Familiarity with Lean and Six Sigma methodologies is desirable. AIGP certification is encouraged.
  • Strong familiarity with:
  • Python
  • REST APIs and webhooks
  • Jira, Confluence, and Miro
  • AI platforms such as Claude Enterprise, Gemini, Vertex AI, and OpenAI
  • Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, Make, and n8n
  • RPA and workflow automation platforms
  • GitLab or GitHub
  • Docker fundamentals

How You'll Operate

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, making architectural decisions within agreed roadmaps and engineering standards, while having the authority to depart from established patterns when justified by a strong technical case.

Novel situations will be the norm. As the organisation transitions towards agentic AI, success will depend less on precedent and more on first-principles thinking, sound technical judgement, and pragmatic decision-making.

  • 🕑 Hybrid way of working
  • 🏃 A buddy will support you with your onboarding
  • 💸 Competitive pay and bonus scheme
  • 💰 Monthly meal allowance
  • ⭐Developmental 360° feedback framework
  • 📚 Unlimited access to Udemy & continuous training
  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Support
  • #LI-Hybrid
  • #LI-ap1
